2.4: esikaShefathiya sasingamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lambili (372),
2.5: esika-Ara sasingamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lanhlanu (775),
2.6: esikaPhahathi-Mowabi (ngosendo lukaJeshuwa loJowabi) sasizinkulungwane ezimbili lamakhulu ayisificaminwembili letshumi lambili (2,812),
2.7: esika-Elamu sasiyinkulungwane elamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu lane (1,254),
2.8: esikaZathu sasingamakhulu ayisificamunwemunye lamatshumi amane lanhlanu (945),
2.9: esikaZakhayi sasingamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi ayisithupha (760),
2.10: esikaBhani sasingamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amane lambili (642),
2.11: esikaBhebhayi sasingamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amabili lantathu (623),
2.12: esika-Azigadi sasiyinkulungwane elamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amabili lambili (1,222),
2.13: esika-Adonikhamu sasingamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi ayisithupha lasithupha (666),
2.14: esikaBhigivayi sasizinkulungwane ezimbili lamatshumi amahlanu lasithupha (2,056),
2.15: esika-Adini sasingamakhulu amane lamatshumi amahlanu lane (454),
2.16: esika-Atheri (ngoHezekhiya) sasingamatshumi ayisificamunwemunye lasificaminwembili (98),
2.17: esikaBhezayi sasingamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amabili lantathu (323),
2.18: esikaJora sasilikhulu letshumi lambili (112),
2.19: esikaHashumi sasingamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amabili lantathu (223),
2.20: esikaGibhari sasingamatshumi ayisificamunwemunye lanhlanu (95),
2.21: amadoda
2.22: eNethofa ayengamatshumi amahlanu lasithupha (56),
2.23: e-Anathothi ayelikhulu lamatshumi amabili lasificaminwembili (128),
2.24: e-Azimavethi ayengamatshumi amane lambili (42),
2.25: eKhiriyathi-Jeyarimi, eKhefira leBherothi ayengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amane lantathu (743),
2.26: eRama leGebha ayengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amabili lanye (621),
2.28: eBhetheli le-Ayi ayengamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amabili lantathu (223),
2.31: kweyinye i-Elamu ayeyinkulungwane elamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu lane (1,254),
2.33: eLodi, eHadidi le-Ono ayengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amabili lanhlanu (725),
2.34: eJerikho ayengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amane lanhlanu (345),
2.35: eSenaya ayezinkulungwane ezintathu lamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amathathu (3,630).
2.38: kwesikaPhashuri babeyinkulungwane elamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amane lasikhombisa (1,247),
2.59: Abalandelayo laba bavela emadolobheni aseTheli Mela, eTheli Hasha, eKherubi, e-Adani, lase-Imeri, kodwa behluleka ukuveza ukuthi usendo lwabo lwaphuma ko-Israyeli:
2.62: Laba baphenya imibhalo yembali yezimuli zabo, kodwa bayiswela ngakho basuswa ebuphristini kwathiwa bangcolile.
2.63: Umbusi wabalaya ukuthi bangakudli loba yikuphi ukudla okungcwele kuze kube lomphristi wokubuza inkatho i-Urimi leThumimi.
2.64: Ixuku lonke lalilinani elifika izinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lambili, lamakhulu amathathu alamatshumi ayisithupha (42,360),
2.65: ngaphandle kwezinceku lezincekukazi zabo ezizinkulungwane eziyisikhombisa lamakhulu amathathu alamatshumi amathathu lasikhombisa (7,337); njalo babe labahlabeleli besilisa labesifazane abangamakhulu amabili (200).
2.66: Babelamabhiza angamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amathathu lasithupha (736), lezimbongolo ezingamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu lanhlanu (245),
2.67: lamakamela angamakhulu amane lamatshumi amathathu lanhlanu (435) kanye labobabhemi abazinkulungwane eziyisithupha ezilamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amabili (6,720).
2.68: Bathi ukufika kwabo endlini kaThixo eJerusalema abanye bezinhloko zezimuli benza umnikelo wokuzizwela waba ngowokwakha indlu kaNkulunkulu endaweni yayo.
2.69: Banikela esikhwameni esikhulu ngokwamandla abo ukwenza umsebenzi lo banika amadrakhima azinkulungwane ezingamatshumi ayisithupha lanye egolide (61,000) lesiliva esifika izinkulungwane ezinhlanu samamina (5,000) lezembatho zobuphristi ezilikhulu (100).
2.70: Abaphristi, labaLevi, labahlabeleli, labalindi bamasango kanye lezinceku zethempelini bahlala emadolobheni akibo, ndawonye labanye abantu, labo bonke abako-Israyeli bahlala emadolobheni akibo.

3.1: Kwathi sekufika inyanga yesikhombisa, lapho abako-Israyeli sebehlezi emizini yakibo, abantu babuthana njengomuntu munye eJerusalema.
3.2: Kwasekusithi uJeshuwa indodana kaJozadaki labaphristi ayesebenza labo kanye loZerubhabheli indodana kaSheyalithiyeli labakhula bakhe baqalisa ukwakha i-alithari likaNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli ukwenza umhlatshelo womnikelo wokutshiswa kulo, mayelana lalokho okulotshiweyo eMthethweni kaMosi umuntu kaNkulunkulu.
3.3: Lokuba babesesaba abantu bendawo, balakha i-alithari esisekelweni salo benza iminikelo yokutshiswa kuThixo kulo, yomibili imihlatshelo yokusa lowokuhlwa.
3.4: Kwathi njalo belandela okulotshiweyo bawugubha uMkhosi weziHonqo besenza inani elifaneleyo leminikelo yokutshiswa elungiselwe lelo lalelo ilanga.
3.5: Emva kwalokho baletha iminikelo yenjayelo eyokutshiswa, iminikelo yokuThwasa kweNyanga leminikelo yayo yonke imikhosi kaThixo emisiweyo engcwele, kanye laleyo eyayilethwa njengeminikelo yokuzithandela eyalethwa kuThixo.
3.6: Ngelanga lokuqala lenyanga yesikhombisa baqalisa ukuletha iminikelo yokutshiswa kuThixo, lokuba isisekelo sethempeli likaThixo sasingakabekwa.
3.7: Basebesipha ababazi bamatshe lababazi nje imali, bapha ukudla lokunathwayo lamafutha ebantwini baseThire leSidoni, ukuze balethe izigodo zemisedari ngendlela yolwandle kusuka eLebhanoni kusiya eJopha njengoba kwakuvunyelwe nguKhurosi inkosi yasePhezhiya.
3.8: Ngenyanga yesibili ngomnyaka wesibili bebuyile endlini kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema, uZerubhabheli indodana kaSheyalithiyeli, loJeshuwa indodana kaJozadaki labo bonke abafowabo (abaphristi labaLevi labo bonke ababuyayo eJerusalema bevela ebugqilini) bawuqalisa umsebenzi, bakhetha abaLevi abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili kusiya phezulu ukuthi baphathe umsebenzi wokwakha indlu kaThixo.
3.9: UJeshuwa lamadodana akhe labafowabo loKhadimiyeli lamadodana akhe (abazukulu bakaHodaviya) lamadodana kaHenadadi kanye lamadodana abo labafowabo, bonke bengabaLevi, bahlangana ndawonye ukukhangela labo ababesebenza endlini kaNkulunkulu.
3.10: Kwathi abakhi sebesibekile isisekelo sethempeli likaThixo abaphristi bagqoka izembatho zabo, baphatha amachacho, kanye labaLevi (amadodana ka-Asafi) bephethe izigubhu, bonke bema ezindaweni zabo ukudumisa uThixo njengokwamiswa nguDavida inkosi yako-Israyeli.
3.11: Badumisa bebonga, bahlabelela uThixo bathi:
3.12: Kodwa abanengi babaphristi abadala labaLevi kanye lezikhulu zezimuli ababelibonile ithempeli lakuqala, bakhala kakhulu bebona isisekelo saleli ithempeli sibekwa, ikanti abanye babo bamemeza ngokuthaba.
3.13: Kakho owayengawehlukanisa umsindo wokumemeza kokuthokoza lomsindo wokukhala ngoba abantu benza umsindo omangalisayo. Njalo umsindo lowo wezwakala kude.

4.1: Kwathi lapho izitha zakoJuda lakoBhenjamini sezizwile ukuthi ababeyizithunjwa basebesakha ithempeli likaThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli
4.2: beza kuZerubhabheli lakulabo ababezinhloko zezimuli bathi, “Yekelani silincedise ukwakha ngoba lathi, njengani, siyamdinga uNkulunkulu wenu njalo kukade sisenza imihlatshelo kuye kusukela esikhathini sika-Esarihadoni inkosi yase-Asiriya, onguye owasiletha lapha.”
4.3: Kodwa uZerubhabheli, loJeshuwa labo bonke ababezinhloko zezimuli zako-Israyeli baphendula bathi, “Kalilani lakho ukwakhisana lathi ithempeli likaNkulunkulu wethu. Thina sodwa sizalakha, silakhela uThixo, uNkulunkulu wako-Israyeli, njengokulaywa kwethu nguKhurosi, inkosi yasePhezhiya.”
4.4: Kwasekusithi abantu balelolizwe baqalisa ukubadondisa abantu bakoJuda babenza besaba ukuqhubeka besakha.
4.5: Bathenga abacebisi bokudunga umsebenzi bawunyampise ngasosonke isikhathi sokubusa kukaKhurosi inkosi yasePhezhiya kwaze kwaba sekubuseni kukaDariyu inkosi yasePhezhiya.
4.6: Ekuqaleni kokubusa kuka-Ahasuweru bethesa abantu bakoJuda labaseJerusalema icala.
4.7: Njalo kwathi ngezinsuku zika-Athazekisisi inkosi yasePhezhiya uBhishilamu, loMithiredathi loThabheli labo bonke abangane babo baloba incwadi isiya ku-Athazekisisi. Incwadi leyo yayibhalwe ngolimi lwesi-Aramayikhi ngendlela yokuloba kwawo ama-Aramu.
4.8: URehumi umlawuli webutho loShimishayi unobhala babhala incwadi isiya ku-Athazekisisi inkosi besola iJerusalema besithi:
4.9: URehumi umlawuli webutho loShimishayi unobhala kanye labo bonke abahlangene labo, abehluleli lezinduna zabantu abasuka eThripholi, ePhezhiya, e-Ereki leBhabhiloni lama-Elamu aseSusa,
4.10: kanye labanye abantu inkosi enkulu ehloniphekayo u-Ashuribhaniphali (u-Osinaphari) eyabaxotshayo yayabahlalisa edolobheni laseSamariya lakwezinye izindawo ngaphetsheya kweYufrathe.
4.11: (Nanka amazwi encwadi leyo abayibhalayo.)
4.12: Inkosi ifanele yazi ukuthi amaJuda afikayo kithi lapha evela kuwe aseye eJerusalema njalo sebelakha kutsha idolobho lelo elihlamukayo, elibi kakhulu. Sebevusa imiduli bevuselela lezisekelo.
4.13: Phezu kwalokho inkosi kufanele ukuba yazi ukuthi aluba idolobho leli lingaze lakhiwe lemiduli yalo imiswe njalo, kakusayikubhadalwa imithelo lenkongozelo yenkosi, lomthetho wokungenisa impahla ezweni, besekusithi-ke isikhwama senkosi sisilele izimali.
4.14: Pho njengoba thina silomlandu ophuma esigodlweni njalo kungafanelanga ukuthi sibone inkosi idelelwa, sithumela umbiko lo ukuyazisa inkosi,
4.15: ukuze kuhlolisiswe ezingwalweni zezindaba ezatshiywa yilabo abakwandulelayo. Kulezongwalo uzathola ukuthi idolobho leli lidolobho lokuhlamuka, lilohlupho emakhosini lakwezinye izigaba zombuso, liyindawo yokuhlamuka kulokhu kwasukela endulo. Yilokho okwabangela ukubhidlizwa kwalelidolobho.
4.16: Inkosi siyazisela ukuthi aluba idolobho leli lingakhiwa, imiswe njalo imiduli yalo, izakube ingasasalanga lalutho ngaphetsheya kweYufrathe.
4.17: Inkosi yathumela impendulo le:
4.18: Incwadi elasithumela yona isiguqulwe ulimi yabalwa phambi kwami.
4.19: Ngakhupha ilizwi kwaphenywa, kwafunyanwa ukuthi idolobho leli lilembali ende eyokuvukela amakhosi, liyindawo yokuhlamuka lokuxhwala.
4.20: IJerusalema isike yaba lamakhosi alamandla ayebusa kulolonke elangaphetsheya kweYufrathe, kubhadalwa kuwo imithelo, inkongozelo yenkosi lemithelo yokungenisa impahla elizweni.
4.21: Manje-ke khuphani umlayo kulawomadoda ukuthi kabamise umsebenzi, ukuze idolobho leli lingakhiwa ngize ngitsho mina.
4.22: Nanzelelani ukuthi lingayilibali indaba le. Kuyekelelwani indaba le ikhula yona ilimaza izifiso zenkosi?
4.23: Incwadi yeNkosi u-Athazekisisi yonela ukubalelwa uRehumi loShimishayi unobhala lalabo ababephathisa bahle bahamba masinyane kubaJuda eJerusalema bababamba ngamandla ukumisa umsebenzi.
4.24: Kanjalo umsebenzi wendlu kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema wema kwaze kwaba ngumnyaka wesibili wokubusa kukaDariyu inkosi yasePhezhiya.

5.1: Ngalesosikhathi uHagayi umphrofethi loZakhariya umphrofethi, umzukulu ka-Ido babephrofitha kubaJuda laseJerusalema ngebizo likaNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli onguye owayephezu kwabo.
5.2: Kwasekusithi uZerubhabheli indodana kaShelathiyeli loJeshuwa indodana kaJozadaki baqalisa ukwakha kutsha indlu kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema. Abaphrofethi bakaNkulunkulu babelabo bebancedisa.
5.3: Ngalesosikhathi uThathenayi umbusi wangaphetsheya kweYufrathe loShethari-Bhozenayi labaphathisi babo baya kubo bababuza bathi, “Ngubani olivumeleyo ukwakha kutsha ithempeli leli lokuvuselela lesisakhiwo?”
5.4: Babuza njalo bathi, “Ngobani amabizo amadoda ayakhayo indlu le na?”
5.5: Kodwa ilihlo likaNkulunkulu wabo lalibalindile abadala babaJuda njalo kabazange beme kuze kuyefika umbiko kuDariyu kubuye njalo impendulo yakhe ibhaliwe.
5.6: Le yiyo incwadi eyathunyelwa nguThathenayi umbusi wangaphetsheya kweYufrathe loShethari-Bhozenayi labasekeli babo, izinduna zaphetsheya kweYufrathe yaya kuDariyu iNkosi.
5.7: Umbiko abawuthumelayo wawubhalwe kanje:
5.8: Inkosi kufanele yazi ukuthi saya esiqintini sakoJuda, ethempelini likaNkulunkulu omkhulu. Abantu bayalakha ngamatshe amakhulu, kunqunyiswa imijabo emidulini. Umsebenzi uqhutshwa ngokukhuthala, njalo uyaphambili ngokuphangisa ukhokhelwa yibo.
5.9: Sabuza abadala bakhona sathi, “Ngubani oliphe imvumo yokwakha kutsha leli ithempeli lokuvuselela isakhiwo lesi?”
5.10: Njalo sababuza amabizo abo ukuze sibhale amabizo abakhokheli babo sisenzela ukukwazisa.
5.11: Nansi impendulo abasipha yona:
5.12: Kodwa ngenxa yokuthi okhokho bethu bamthukuthelisa uNkulunkulu wasezulwini, wabanikela ezandleni zikaNebhukhadineza umKhaladiya, inkosi yaseBhabhiloni owalibhidlizayo lelithempeli abantu wabaxotshela eBhabhiloni.
5.13: Kodwa ngomnyaka wokuqala kaKhurosi inkosi yaseBhabhiloni, iNkosi uKhurosi wakhupha isimemezelo sokuthi kwakhiwe indlu kaNkulunkulu.
5.14: Wabuye wasusa ethempelini laseBhabhiloni impahla zegolide lesiliva ezendlu kaNkulunkulu ezazithethwe nguNebhukhadineza ethempelini eJerusalema waziletha ethempelini eBhabhiloni. Kwathi iNkosi uKhurosi yazinika indoda eyayithiwa nguSheshibhazari, eyamkhetha ukuba ngumbusi,
5.15: wamtshela wathi, ‘Thatha impahla lezi uhambe lazo uyezibeka ethempelini eJerusalema. Njalo yakha kakutsha indlu kaNkulunkulu endaweni yayo.’
5.16: Yikho uSheshibhazari weza wabeka izisekelo zendlu kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema. Kusukela ngalelolanga kuze kube manje ibilokhu isakhiwa kodwa kayikapheli.”
5.17: Ngakho-ke nxa kulungile enkosini, kakudingisiswe ezincwadini zezindaba zamakhosi aseBhabhiloni kubonwe ingabe yikho na ukuthi iNkosi uKhurosi wayesenzile isimemezelo sokuthi yakhiwe indlu le kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema. Lapho-ke inkosi kayisithumele isinqumo sayo ngendaba le.

6.1: INkosi uDariyu wasekhupha umlayo, basebephenya ezincwadini ezaziqoqwe ndawonye endlini yenotho yesizwe eBhabhiloni.
6.2: Kwafunyanwa khona umqulu womgoqwa enqabeni yase-Ekhibhathana elizweni laseMediya kulotshwe lokhu kuwo:
6.3: Ngomnyaka wokuqala weNkosi uKhurosi, inkosi yakhupha isimemezelo mayelana lethempeli likaNkulunkulu eJerusalema:
6.4: kwakhiwe imizila emithathu yamatshe amakhulu lomzila owodwa wezigodo. Izindleko zonke zizabhadalwa yisikhwama sesikhosini.
6.5: Akuthi njalo impahla zegolide lesiliva uNebhukhadineza azithatha ethempelini eJerusalema waziletha eBhabhiloni zibuyiselwe ezindaweni zazo ethempelini eJerusalema; zimele zibekwe endlini kaNkulunkulu.
6.6: Ngakho-ke wena Thathenayi, mbusi wangaphetsheya kweYufrathe, loShethari-Bhozenayi labaphathisi benu bakulowo umango, sukani lapho.
6.7: Lingaphazamisi umsebenzi wethempeli lelo likaNkulunkulu. Yekelani umbusi wamaJuda labadala bamaJuda bakhe kutsha indlu kaNkulunkulu endaweni yayo.
6.8: Njalo sengimisa umlayo walokho okumele lina likwenzele abadala bamaJuda ekwakhiweni kwendlu kaNkulunkulu:
6.9: Loba yini efunekayo, amajongosi, inqama, amazinyane amaduna eminikelo yokutshiswa kuNkulunkulu wezulu, lengqoloyi, itswayi, iwayini lamafutha okuyabe kucelwe ngabaphristi eJerusalema, kabakuphiwe nsuku zonke kungaphuthi,
6.10: ukuze benze imihlatshelo ethokozisayo kuNkulunkulu wezulu njalo bakhulekele impilakahle yenkosi lamadodana ayo.
6.11: Phezu kwalokho ngibeka umthetho othi nxa ekhona ozaguqula lesisimiso, kakuhwatshwe uthungo endlini yakhe aphakanyiswe axhonxwe kulo. Akuthi ngenxa yalelicala indlu yakhe ibhidlizwe ibe yinqwaba yenhlabathi.
6.12: Sengathi uNkulunkulu owenza ukuthi iBizo lakhe lihlale khona, angayichitha loba yiphi inkosi loba ngabantu abaphakamisa isandla sabo ukuguqula umlayo lo loba ukudiliza ithempeli leli eliseJerusalema.
6.13: Kwathi-ke, ngenxa yomthetho iNkosi uDariyu eyase iwuthumele, uThathenayi umbusi wangaphetsheya kweYufrathe, loShethari-Bhozenayi labasekeli babo bakwenza lokho ngenkuthalo.
6.14: Yikho-ke abadala bamaJuda baqhubeka ngokwakha bephumelela betshunyayezwa nguHagayi umphrofethi loZakhariya, umzukulu ka-Ido. Baqeda ukulakha ithempeli belandela umlayo kaNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli kanye lezimiso zikaKhurosi, loDariyu lo-Athazekisisi, amakhosi asePhezhiya.
6.15: Ithempeli laqedwa ngosuku lwesithathu enyangeni ka-Adari, ngomnyaka wesithupha wokubusa kweNkosi uDariyu.
6.16: Kwasekusithi abantu bako-Israyeli, abaphristi, labaLevi labo bonke ababethunjiwe benza umkhosi.
6.17: Ukunikela indlu kaNkulunkulu le bapha umnikelo wenkunzi ezilikhulu, inqama ezingamakhulu amabili, amazinyane amaduna angamakhulu amane njalo lempongo ezilitshumi lambili njengomnikelo wesono ka-Israyeli wonke.
6.18: Njalo bagcoba abaphristi ezigabeni zabo labaLevi ngamaxuku abo ukwenza umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema, njengokulotshiweyo eNcwadini kaMosi.
6.19: Ngelanga letshumi lane lenyanga yokuqala, izithunjwa zathakazelela iPhasika.
6.20: Abaphristi labaLevi babezihlambulule behlanzekile ngokomkhuba. AbaLevi balihlaba izinyane lePhasika elabo bonke ababethunjiwe, labafowabo abaphristi njalo bezihlabela labo ngokwabo.
6.21: Ngakho abako-Israyeli ababebuyile ebugqilini balidla, kanye labo bonke labo abasebezehlukanisile emikhutsheni engcolileyo yabomakhelwane beZizwe ukuze badinge uThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
6.22: Bathakazelela uMkhosi weSinkwa esingelaMvubelo okwensuku eziyisikhombisa bethokoza, ngoba uThixo wayebagcwalise ngokuthokoza ngokuguqula ingqondo yenkosi yase-Asiriya ukuthi ibancedise emsebenzini wendlu kaNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.

7.1: Ngemva kwalezizinto, ngesikhathi sokubusa kuka-Athazekisisi inkosi yasePhezhiya, u-Ezra indodana kaSeraya, indodana ka-Azariya, indodana kaHilikhiya,
7.2: indodana kaShalumi, indodana kaZadokhi indodana ka-Ahithubi,
7.3: indodana ka-Amariya, indodana ka-Azariya, indodana kaMerayothi,
7.4: indodana kaZerahiya, indodana ka-Uzi, indodana kaBhukhi,
7.5: indodana ka-Abhishuwa, indodana kaFinehasi, indodana ka-Eliyazari, indodana ka-Aroni umphristi omkhulu,
7.6: u-Ezra lo weza evela eBhabhiloni. Wayeyisifundiswa esazi kakhulu ngoMthetho kaMosi, owawuphiwe nguThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli. Inkosi yayimuphe konke ayekucelile, ngoba isandla sikaThixo uNkulunkulu wakhe sasiphezu kwakhe.
7.7: Abanye abako-Israyeli, labaphristi, lamaLevi, labahlabeleli, labalindi bamasango lezinceku zethempelini labo babuya eJerusalema ngomnyaka wesikhombisa wokubusa kwenkosi u-Athazekisisi.
7.8: U-Ezra wafika eJerusalema ngenyanga yesihlanu ngomnyaka wesikhombisa wenkosi.
7.9: Wayeqalise uhambo lwakhe esuka eBhabhiloni ngelanga lakuqala lenyanga yokuqala, wafika eJerusalema ngelanga lakuqala lenyanga yesihlanu, ngoba isandla somusa sikaNkulunkulu sasiphezu kwakhe.
7.10: Ngoba u-Ezra wayezinikele ekufundeni lokugcina uMthetho kaThixo lokufundisa izimiso zawo ko-Israyeli.
7.11: Nansi incwadi iNkosi u-Athazekisisi ayeyiphe u-Ezra umphristi lomabhalane, indoda eyayifundile ezindabeni zemithetho lezimiso zikaThixo ku-Israyeli:
7.12: Athazekisisi, nkosi yamakhosi,
7.13: Manje-ke ngimisa umthetho wokuthi ingqe ngubani wako-Israyeli osembusweni wami, kugoqela abaphristi labaLevi, ofisa ukuhamba lawe eJerusalema, kahambe.
7.14: Uthunywa yinkosi labacebisi bayo abayisikhombisa ukuba uyofunisisa ngoJuda langeJerusalema mayelana loMthetho kaNkulunkulu wakho, owuphetheyo.
7.15: Njalo ubothatha isiliva legolide elinikwe ngesihle yinkosi labacebisi bayo kuNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, ohlala eJerusalema,
7.16: kanye lesiliva legolide lonke ongalizuza elizweni laseBhabhiloni kanye leminikelo yokuzizwela eyabantu labaphristi benikelela ithempeli likaNkulunkulu wabo eJerusalema.
7.17: Ngaleyomali umele uthenge inkunzi, lenqama, lamazinyane ezimvu amaduna, ndawonye leminikelo yabo yamabele leyokunathwayo, konke kunikelwe e-alithareni lethempeli likaNkulunkulu wenu eJerusalema.
7.18: Wena labazalwane bakho abangamaJuda selingenza lokho okuyabe kufanele ngesiliva legolide eliseleyo, mayelana lentando kaNkulunkulu wenu.
7.19: Hambisani kuNkulunkulu weJerusalema zonke impahla eliziphathisiweyo ezokukhonza ethempelini likaNkulunkulu wenu.
7.20: Akuthi loba yini efunekayo ethempelini likaNkulunkulu wenu elifuna ukuthi izuzakale, kayidingwe ngendleko ephuma esikhwameni senkosi.
7.21: Mina, iNkosi Athazekisisi ngimisa umthetho wokuthi bonke abaphathi bezikhwama abangaphetsheya kweYufrathe baphe u-Ezra umphristi, umfundisi woMthetho kaNkulunkulu wasezulwini ngokuphangisa loba yini ayicelayo kini,
7.22: kuze kube ngamathalenta esiliva alikhulu, lamasaka alikhulu engqoloyi, imigqomo elikhulu yewayini, imigqomo elikhulu yamafutha e-oliva, letswayi elingelakulinganiswa.
7.23: Ingqe yini emiswe nguNkulunkulu wasezulwini, kakwenziwe ngokukhuthala kusenzelwa ithempeli likaNkulunkulu wasezulwini. Kakudingeki ukuthi ulaka luze lwehliselwe phezu kwenkosi lamadodana ayo.
7.24: Yazini njalo ukuthi kalilamvumo yokubiza imithelo loba inkongozelo yenkosi kumbe imbadalo yokungenisa impahla elizweni kubaphristi, labaLevi, labahlabeleli, labalindimasango, lezinceku zethempelini loba kwezinye izisebenzi zale indlu kaNkulunkulu.
7.25: Yikho wena Ezra, ngokuhlakanipha olakho okukaNkulunkulu wakho, beka abathonisi labehluleli ukwahlulela kuhle bonke abantu abangaphetsheya kweYufrathe, bonke abayaziyo imithetho kaNkulunkulu wenu. Kumele ufundise labo abangayaziyo.
7.26: Lowo ongawulaleliyo umthetho kaNkulunkulu wenu lomthetho wenkosi ngeqiniso umele ajeziswe ngokufa, loba ngokuxotshwa, loba ngokuhluthunelwa impahla loba ngokufakwa entolongweni.
7.27: Udumo kalube kuThixo, uNkulunkulu wabokhokho bethu, okufakileyo enhliziyweni yenkosi ukuletha inhlonipho endlini kaThixo eJerusalema ngale indlela
7.28: njalo otshengise umusa wakhe kini phambi kwenkosi labeluleki bakhe lazozonke izinduna zakhe ezilamandla. Ngenxa yokuthi isandla sikaThixo uNkulunkulu wami besiphezu kwami, ngaba lesibindi ngaqoqa amadoda angabakhokheli ko-Israyeli ukuthi bahambe lami.

8.1: Laba bazinhloko zezimuli lalabo ababhalisa kubo abeza lami sisuka eBhabhiloni ngesikhathi sokubusa kweNkosi u-Athazekisisi:
8.2: abesizukulwane sikaFinehasi,
8.3: owesizukulwane sikaShekhaniya;
8.4: abesizukulwane sikaPhahathi-Mowabi:
8.5: abesizukulwane sikaZathu,
8.6: abesizukulwane sika-Adini,
8.7: abesizukulwane sika-Elamu,
8.8: abesizukulwane sikaShefathiya,
8.9: abesizukulwane sikaJowabi,
8.10: abesizukulwane sikaBhani,
8.11: abesizukulwane sikaBhebhayi,
8.12: abesizukulwane sika-Azigadi,
8.13: abesizukulwane sika-Adonikhamu,
8.14: abesizukulwane sikaBhigivayi,
8.15: Ngababuthanisa eMgelweni wamanzi agelezela ku-Ahava, samisa khona okwensuku ezintathu. Ngathi sengihlola phakathi kwabantu labaphristi, kangitholanga loyedwa wamaLevi khona.
8.16: Yikho ngasengibiza u-Eliyezari, lo-Ariyeli, loShemaya, lo-Elinathani, loJaribi, loNathani, loZakhariya loMeshulami ababengabakhokheli, loJoyaribi lo-Elinathani ababengabantu abafundileyo,
8.17: ngabathumela ku-Ido, lezihlobo zakhe, izinceku zethempelini eKhasifiya, ukwenzela ukuthi basilethele izikhonzi zendlu kaNkulunkulu.
8.18: Ngoba isandla somusa sikaNkulunkulu sasiphezu kwethu, basilethela uSherebhiya, indoda emadodeni, owesizukulwane sikaMahili indodana kaLevi, indodana ka-Israyeli, lamadodana kaSherebhiya labafowabo, amadoda alitshumi lasificaminwembili (18);
8.19: loHashabhiya, kanye loJeshaya owesizukulwane sikaMerari, kanye labafowabo labantwababo, bonke babengamadoda angamatshumi amabili (20).
8.20: Bona beza lezinceku zethempelini ezingamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amabili (220) ezazimiswe nguDavida lezinduna zakhe ukuncedisa abaLevi. Bonke babhalwa phansi amabizo abo.
8.21: Khonapho, ekhunjini loMgelo we-Ahava, ngamemezela ukuzila ukudla, ukuze sizehlise phambi kukaNkulunkulu wethu simcele asiphe uhambo oluhle, thina labantwabethu, lempahla zethu zonke.
8.22: Ngaba lenhloni ukucela enkosini amabutho labagadi bamabhiza ukuthi basivikele ezitheni endleleni ngoba inkosi sasiyitshele sathi, “Isandla somusa sikaNkulunkulu wethu siphezu kwakhe lowo okhangele kuye, kodwa ulaka lwakhe olukhulu luyavutha kulabo abamfulathelayo.”
8.23: Ngakho sazila ukudla, samncenga uNkulunkulu wethu ngakho lokhu, wawuphendula umkhuleko wethu.
8.24: Ngasengisehlukanisa kwabanye abaphristi abalitshumi lambili abangabakhokheli, ndawonye loSherebhiya, loHashabhiya labalitshumi labafowabo,
8.25: ngabalinganisela umnikelo wesiliva legolide lempahla ezaziyizipho ezasisuka enkosini, labacebisi bayo, lezikhulu zayo labako-Israyeli bonke ababekhona lapho, siyisipho sendlu kaNkulunkulu.
8.26: Ngabalinganisela amathalenta angamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amahlanu (650) esiliva, impahla zesiliva ezilobunzima obungamathalenta alikhulu (100), amathalenta alikhulu (100) egolide,
8.27: imiganu yegolide engamatshumi amabili (20) kuthiwa intengo yayo ingaba ngamadariki ayinkulungwane (1,000), lezitsha ezimbili ezethusi elilolongiweyo eliligugu njengegolide.
8.28: Ngathi kubo, “Lina kanye lempahla lezi lingcwelisiwe eNkosini. Isiliva legolide kungumnikelo wokuzithandela kuThixo, uNkulunkulu wabokhokho benu.
8.29: Kulindeni ngonanzelelo lize liyokulinganisa emakamelweni endlu kaThixo eJerusalema phambi kwabakhokheli babaphristi lamaLevi labayizinhloko zezimuli zako-Israyeli.”
8.30: Kwathi-ke abaphristi labaLevi basemukela isiliva legolide lempahla ezingcwele ezazilinganisiwe ukuze zisiwe endlini kaNkulunkulu wethu eJerusalema.
8.31: Ngosuku lwetshumi lambili lwenyanga yokuqala saphakama sasuka eMgelweni we-Ahava saqonda eJerusalema. Isandla sikaNkulunkulu wethu sasiphezu kwethu, wasivikela ezitheni lasezigebengwini indlela yonke.
8.32: Ngakho safika eJerusalema, saphumula khona okwensuku ezintathu.
8.33: Ngosuku lwesine sangena endlini kaNkulunkulu salinganisa isiliva legolide lempahla zonke ezingcwelisiweyo sazibeka ezandleni zikaMeremothi indodana ka-Uriya umphristi. U-Eliyezari indodana kaFinehasi laye wayekhona, labaLevi oJozabhadi indodana kaJeshuwa loNowadiya indodana kaBhinuwi.
8.34: Konke kwakukhona ngenani lakho langesisindo, kwathi isisindo sonke salotshwa phansi ngasonaleso isikhathi.
8.35: Yikho izithunywa ezabuya ebugqilini zenza umnikelo wokutshiswa kuNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli: inkunzi ezilitshumi lambili ezika-Israyeli wonke, inqama ezingamatshumi ayisificamunwemunye lesithupha, amawundlu amaduna angamatshumi ayisikhombisa lesikhombisa kanye lomnikelo wesono oyizimpongo ezilitshumi lambili. Konke lokhu kwakungumnikelo wokutshiswa kuThixo.
8.36: Bathi njalo bethula imilayo yenkosi kuzikhulu zenkosi lakubabusi bangaphetsheya kweYufrathe, okwathi-ke bona bancedisa abantu kanye lasendlini kaNkulunkulu.

9.1: Sezenziwe zonke lezi izinto, abakhokheli beza kimi bathi, “Abantu bako-Israyeli bonke, labaphristi, labaLevi kabazehlukanisanga labantu bezizwe abalezenzo ezinengekayo, abanjengamaKhenani, amaHithi, amaPherizi, amaJebusi, ama-Amori, amaMowabi, amaGibhithe lama-Amoni.
9.2: Bathatha amanye amadodakazi abo aba ngomkabo bathathela lamadodana abo, baxubanisa isizwe esingcwele labantu abahlezi labo. Njalo abakhokheli lezikhulu yibo abakhokheleyo kulokhu kungathembeki.”
9.3: Ngathi ngikuzwa lokho ngadabula isigqoko sami lejazi lami, ngadonsa inwele ekhanda lami lezindevu zami ngahlala phansi ngididekile.
9.4: Kwasekusithi wonke lowo owethuswa ngamazwi kaNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli waziqoqa phansi kwami ngenxa yalokhu ukona kwezithunjwa. Ngahlala khonapho ngididekile kwaze kwaba ngumhlatshelo wakusihlwa.
9.5: Kwathi-ke ngomhlatshelo wakusihlwa, ngaphakama ekuzehliseni kwami, isigqoko sami lejazi lami kudabukile, ngaguqa, izandla zami zivuliwe kuThixo uNkulunkulu wami
9.6: ngakhuleka ngathi:
9.7: Kusukela ensukwini zabokhokho bethu kuze kube manje, icala lethu likhulu. Ngenxa yezono zethu, thina lamakhosi ethu labaphristi bethu sesilokhu sidliwa yinkemba njalo sigqilazwa, siphangwa njalo siyangiswa ngamakhosi ezizwe, njengoba kunjalo lalamuhla.
9.8: Kodwa khathesi, okwesikhatshana nje, uThixo uNkulunkulu wethu ube lomusa ngokusitshiyela insalela lokusipha indawo eqinileyo endlini yakhe engcwele, okuthi ngakho uNkulunkulu wethu uletha ukukhanya emehlweni ethu lokukhululeka kancinyane ekugqilazweni kwethu.
9.9: Lokuba siyizigqili, uNkulunkulu wethu kasidelanga ebugqilini bethu. Usitshengise umusa emehlweni amakhosi asePhezhiya; usiphile impilo entsha ukuba sakhe kutsha indlu kaNkulunkulu wethu sivuselele amanxiwa ayo, njalo usesiphile umduli wokusivikela koJuda laseJerusalema.
9.10: Kodwa manje, awu Nkulunkulu wethu, kuyini esingakutsho sekwenzakale lokhu? Ngoba siyidelile imilayo
9.11: owayinika ngezinceku zakho abaphrofethi uze uthi: ‘Ilizwe eselingena kulo ukulithatha yilizwe elingcolisiweyo ngokuxhwala kwabantu balo. Ngemikhuba yabo enengekayo sebeligcwalise ngamanyala abo kusukela ngapha kwalo kuze kufike ekucineni ngale.
9.12: Ngakho-ke lingendiseli amadodakazi enu emadodaneni abo kumbe amadodana enu athathe amadodakazi abo. Lingadingi isibopho sobudlelwano labo loba nini, ukuze liqine lidle izinto ezinhle zelizwe elizalitshiyela abantwabenu njengelifa laphakade.’
9.13: Osekwenzakele kithi kungumvuzo wezenzo zethu ezimbi lecala lethu elikhulu, ikanti wena Nkulunkulu wethu usijezise okunganeno kwezono zethu wasipha abayinsalela kanje.
9.14: Sizaphinda njalo sephule imilayo yakho sendiselane labantu bezizwe abagila imikhuba eyenyanyekayo kangaka na? Ungaze wasizondela kakhulu na usibhubhise ungasitshiyeli lansalela loba abasindileyo na?
9.15: Oh Thixo, Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, ulungile! Namhlanje sisele njengensalela. Nanku silapha phambi kwakho ngecala lethu, lokuba engekho ongema ebukhoneni bakho ngenxa yalo icala lethu.”

10.1: Lapho u-Ezra wayekhuleka njalo evuma izono, ekhala eziwisela phansi phambi kwendlu kaNkulunkulu, ixuku elikhulu labako-Israyeli kubalisa amadoda labafazi labantwana, babuthana kuye. Labo bakhala kabuhlungu.
10.2: Yikho uShekhaniya indodana kaJehiyeli, omunye wesizukulwane sika-Elamu, wathi ku-Ezra, “Kasizange sithembeke kuNkulunkulu wethu ngoba sathatha abafazi bezizweni ebantwini esakhelene labo. Kodwa loba kunjalo ithemba lisekhona ngo-Israyeli.
10.3: Manje kasenzeni isivumelwano phambi kukaNkulunkulu wethu ukubalahla bonke labobafazi labantwababo njengeseluleko senkosi yami lalabo abayesabayo imilayo kaNkulunkulu wethu. Kakwenziwe ngendlela yoMthetho.
10.4: Sukuma; indaba le isezandleni zakho. Thina sizakusekela, yikho yiba lesibindi ukwenze.”
10.5: Ngakho u-Ezra waphakama wafungisa bonke abakhokheli babaphristi labaLevi lo-Israyeli wonke ukwenza lokho okwakumisiwe. Basenza lesosifungo.
10.6: U-Ezra wasesuka endlini kaNkulunkulu waya endlini kaJehohanani indodana ka-Eliyashibi. Elapho kadlanga lutho njalo kazange anathe manzi, ngoba waqhubeka elilela ukungathembeki kwezithunjwa.
10.7: Kwasekukhutshwa isimemezelo kulolonke elakoJuda kanye leJerusalema ukuthi zonke izithunjwa kaziqoqane eJerusalema.
10.8: Ingqe ngubani ongafikanga phakathi kwensuku ezintathu wayezathathelwa yonke impahla alayo, kulandelwa isinqumo sezinduna labadala, kuthi yena ngokwakhe axotshwe emphakathini walabo ababethunjiwe.
10.9: Phakathi kwalezonsuku ezintathu wonke amadoda akoJuda lakoBhenjamini ayesebuthene eJerusalema. Kwathi ngelanga lamatshumi amabili lenyanga yesificamunye bonke abantu babehlezi esigcawini phambi kwendlu kaNkulunkulu, bekhathazekile ngombuthano lowo njalo begxanxwa lizulu elalisina.
10.10: Kwathi u-Ezra umphristi wasukuma wathi kubo, “Kalithembekanga; lisuke lathatha abafazi bezizweni, lengeza icala lika-Israyeli.
10.11: Manje-ke vumani izono zenu kuThixo, uNkulunkulu wabokhokho benu, lenze intando yakhe. Zahlukaniseni kulababantu elakhelene labo lasebafazini benu abezizwe.”
10.12: Inkundla yonke yaphendula ngelizwi elikhulu yathi: “Uqondile! Kumele senze njengoba usitsho.
10.13: Kodwa kulabantu abanengi lapha futhi lesi yisikhathi sezulu; ngakho ngeke sime lapha phandle. Futhi indaba le ingazake iphethwe ngosuku olulodwa kumbe ezimbili, ngoba sonile kakhulu ngento le.
10.14: Akuthi izinduna zethu zisimele thina sonke. Akuthi wonkemuntu emizini yethu othethe umfazi wabezizwe eze ngesikhathi esimisiweyo, eze labadala kanye labehluleli balowomuzi, luze ludede kithi ulaka olwesabekayo lukaNkulunkulu wethu.”
10.15: Kwaba nguJonathani kuphela, indodana ka-Asaheli loJahizeya indodana kaThikhiva, besekelwa nguMeshulami loShabhethayi umLevi abakuphikisayo lokhu.
10.16: Ngakho izithunjwa zenza njengokwakumisiwe. U-Ezra umphristi wakhetha amadoda ayeyizinhloko zezimuli, oyedwa emulini, bonke baqanjwa ngamabizo. Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yetshumi bahlala phansi bawahlolisisa lawomacala,
10.17: kwathi ngelanga lokuqala ngenyanga yokuqala baqeda ukuphatha indaba yamadoda ayethethe abafazi bezizweni.
10.18: Phakathi kwezizukulwane zabaphristi, laba abalandelayo yibo ababethethe abafazi bezizweni:
10.19: (Bonke baphakamisa izandla zabo bafunga ukubalahla abafazi babo, kwathi ngenxa yecala labo ngulowo wakhupha inqama emhlambini ukuba ngumnikelo wesono.)
10.20: Abesizukulwane sika-Imeri:
10.21: Abesizukulwane sikaHarimi:
10.22: Abesizukulwane sikaPhashuri:
10.44: Bonke laba bathatha abafazi bezizweni, abanye babo bazala abantwana labafazi labo.

1.1: Umbono omayelana ngoJuda leJerusalema owabonwa ngu-Isaya indodana ka-Amozi ensukwini zokubusa kuka-Uziya, loJothamu, lo-Ahazi loHezekhiya amakhosi akoJuda.
1.2: Zwanini, mazulu! Lalelani, mhlaba!
1.3: Inkabi iyamazi umniniyo,
1.4: Maye kuso isizwe esonayo,
1.5: Kungani kumele litshaywe futhi?
1.6: Kusukela ngaphansi kwentende yonyawo lwakho kusiya esicholo sekhanda
1.7: Ilizwe lenu lichithekile,
1.8: Indodakazi yaseZiyoni isele
1.9: Aluba uThixo uSomandla
1.10: Zwanini ilizwi likaThixo,
1.11: “Ubunengi bemihlatshelo yenu
1.12: Lapho lisiza phambi kwami,
1.13: Yekelani ukuletha iminikelo eyize!
1.14: Umphefumulo wami uyawazonda
1.15: Lapho lichaya izandla zenu likhuleka,
1.16: Gezani libe ngabahlambulukileyo.
1.17: Fundani ukwenza okulungileyo; funani ukwahlulela okuhle.
1.18: Wozani, siqondisane sindawonye,”
1.19: Nxa livuma njalo lilalela,
1.20: kodwa nxa linqaba, lihlamuka,
1.21: Khangelani ukuthi idolobho elithembekileyo
1.22: Isiliva senu sesingamanyele,
1.23: Ababusi benu bangabahlamuki,
1.24: Ngakho-ke iNkosi, uThixo uSomandla,
1.25: Ngizaphakamisela isandla sami kini;
1.26: Ngizabuyisa abehluleli benu njengezinsukwini zakudala,

2.1: Lokhu yikho okwabonwa ngu-Isaya indodana ka-Amozi mayelana loJuda leJerusalema:
2.2: Ngezinsuku zokucina
2.3: Abantu abanengi bazakuza bathi,
2.4: Uzakwahlulela phakathi kwezizwe,
2.5: Woza, ndlu kaJakhobe,
2.6: Wena, Thixo, usubalahlile abantu bakho,
2.7: Ilizwe labo ligcwele isiliva legolide;
2.8: Ilizwe labo ligcwele izithombe;
2.9: Ngakho abantu bazakwehliselwa phansi
2.10: Ngenani ezimbalwini zamatshe lasemhlabathini,
2.11: Amehlo omuntu oziphakamisayo azathotshiswa,
2.12: UThixo uSomandla ulosuku alubekele
2.13: olwazo zonke izihlahla zemisedari zaseLebhanoni ezinde leziphakemeyo,
2.14: olwazo zonke izintaba ezindekazi
2.15: olwayo yonke imiphotshongo ephakemeyo
2.16: olwemikhumbi yonke yaseThashishi
2.17: Ukuziphakamisa kwabantu kuzakwehliselwa phansi,
2.18: izithombe zizanyamalala zithi nya.
2.19: Abantu bazabalekela ezimbalwini zamatshe
2.20: Ngalolosuku abantu bazazilahlela
2.21: Bazabalekela ezimbalwini zamatshe
2.22: Yekelani ukwethemba umuntu

3.1: Khangelani khathesi UThixo,
3.2: iqhawe lebutho,
3.3: induna yebutho labangamatshumi amahlanu
3.4: “Ngizakwenza abafana babeyizikhulu zabo;
3.5: Abantu bazancindezelana,
3.6: Indoda izabamba omunye wabafowabo
3.7: Kodwa ngalolosuku uzakhala athi,
3.8: IJerusalema liyadiyazela,
3.9: Ukukhangeleka kobuso babo kufakaza kubi ngabo;
3.10: Tshela abalungileyo ukuthi kuzakuba kuhle kubo,
3.11: Maye kwababi!
3.12: Abatsha bancindezela abantu bami,
3.13: UThixo uphakama ukuba afakaze indaba yakhe,
3.14: UThixo uqalisa ukwahlulela
3.15: Litshoni ngokuchoboza abantu bami
3.16: UThixo uthi,
3.17: Ngakho-ke uThixo uzakwenza amakhanda
3.18: Ngalolosuku uThixo uzahluthuna imiceciso yabo: amasongo, imincwazi, lemigaxo yentanyeni
3.19: amacici, izigqizo lezimbombozo,
3.20: amaqhiye, izigetsho lamabhanti; amambodlela amakha lezintebe,
3.21: indandatho ezilophawu lamasongo empumulo,
3.22: izembatho ezinhle lezingubo lezigqoko, izikhwama
3.23: lezibuko, lezigqoko zelineni, imiqhele lamaveli.
3.24: Endaweni yephunga elimnandi
3.25: Amadoda akini azakuwa ngenkemba,

4.1: Ngalolosuku abesifazane abayisikhombisa
4.2: Ngalolosuku uGatsha lukaThixo luzakuba luhle lube yinkazimulo, lezithelo zelizwe zizakuba ligugu lenkazimulo kwabasindayo ko-Israyeli.
4.3: Labo abatshiywe eZiyoni, abasele eJerusalema, kuzathiwa bangcwele, labo bonke abalotshiweyo phakathi kwabaphilayo eJerusalema.
4.4: INkosi izagezisa ingcekeza yabesifazane baseZiyoni, izahlambulula amachatha egazi eJerusalema ngomoya wokwahlulela langomoya womlilo.
4.5: Lapho-ke, phezu kwayo yonke iNtaba iZiyoni langaphezulu kwabo bonke abahlangana khona, uThixo uzakwenza iyezi lentuthu emini, lokukhanya kwamalangabi omlilo ebusuku; ngaphezu kwenkazimulo yonke kuzakuba lesivikelo esinjengophahla.
4.6: Sizakuba yisisitho lomthunzi wokuvika ukutshisa kwemini, isiphephelo lendawo yokucatshela isiphepho lezulu.

5.1: Ngizahlabelela lowo engimthandayo
5.2: Wasigebha, wasusa amatshe kuso,
5.3: “Manje-ke lina abahlala eJerusalema lani madoda akoJuda,
5.4: Kuyini okudlula lapho okwakumele kwenziwe esivinini sami
5.5: Khathesi-ke sengizalitshela
5.6: Ngizasenza sibe liganga
5.7: Isivini sikaThixo uSomandla
5.8: Maye kini elengeza izindlu ngezindlu
5.9: UThixo uSomandla usetshilo ngisizwa wathi:
5.10: Izindima ezilitshumi zesivini
5.11: Maye kulabo abavuka ngovivi ekuseni
5.12: Balamachacho lemihubhe emadilini abo,
5.13: Ngakho-ke abantu bami bazakuya ekuthunjweni
5.14: Ngakho indawo yabafileyo izakwelula imihlathi yayo,
5.15: Abantu bazakwehliselwa phansi,
5.16: Kodwa uThixo uSomandla uzaphakanyiswa
5.17: Lapho-ke izimvu zizakudla angathi kusemadlelweni azo,
5.18: Maye kulabo abahudula isono ngentambo zenkohliso
5.19: kulabo abathi, “UNkulunkulu kaphangise,
5.20: Maye kulabo abathi okubi kuhle
5.21: Maye kulabo abahlakaniphileyo emehlweni abo
5.22: Maye kulabo abangamaqhawe ekunatheni iwayini
5.23: abakhulula abalamacala ngenxa yokufunjathiswa.
5.24: Ngakho-ke, njengalokhu umlilo utshisa inhlanga,
5.25: Ngakho ulaka lukaThixo luzavutha ebantwini bakhe;
5.27: Kakho omunye wabo odinwayo loba okhubekayo,

6.1: Ngomnyaka inkosi u-Uziya eyafa ngawo, ngabona uThixo ehlezi esihlalweni sobukhosi esiphezulu esiphakemeyo, injobo yesembatho sakhe igcwele ithempeli.
6.2: Ngaphezu kwakhe kwakulamaserafimu, elinye lelinye lilempiko eziyisithupha. Ayegubuzele ubuso bawo ngezimpiko ezimbili, egubuzele inyawo zawo ngezimbili, ephapha ngezimbili.
6.3: Elinye lamemezela kwelinye lisithi:
6.4: Ekuzwakaleni kwamazwi awo imigubazi lombundu kwanyikinyeka, kwathi ithempeli lagcwala intuthu.
6.5: Mina ngakhala ngathi, “Maye mina! Sengibhujisiwe! Ngoba ngingumuntu olezindebe ezingcolileyo, njalo ngihlala phakathi kwabantu abalezindebe ezingcolileyo, lamehlo ami asebone iNkosi, uThixo uSomandla.”
6.6: Lapho-ke elinye lamaserafimu laphaphela kimi liphethe ilahle elivuthayo esandleni salo elalilithethe ngodlawu e-alithareni.
6.7: Lathinta umlomo wami ngalo lathi, “Khangela, lokhu sekuthinte izindebe zakho; icala lakho selisusiwe, njalo lesono sakho sesihlawulelwe.”
6.8: Ngasengisizwa ilizwi leNkosi lisithi, “Ngizathuma bani na? Ngubani na ozasihambela?”
6.9: Yasisithi, “Hamba uyetshela abantu uthi:
6.10: Yenza inhliziyo yalababantu ibe lukhuni;
6.11: Ngasengisithi, “Koze kube nini, Nkosi?”
6.12: uThixo aze axotshele umuntu wonke khatshana
6.13: Lanxa ingxenye eyodwa etshumini isala elizweni

7.1: Kwathi u-Ahazi indodana kaJothamu, indodana ka-Uziya, eyinkosi yakoJuda, uRezini inkosi yase-Aramu loPhekha indodana kaRemaliya inkosi yako-Israyeli basuka bayahlasela iJerusalema, kodwa kabalinqobanga.
7.2: Indlu kaDavida yatshelwa kwathiwa, “I-Aramu isimanyene lo-Efrayimi,” inhliziyo ka-Ahazi lezabantu bakhe zanyikinyeka njengezihlahla zegusu zinyikinywa ngumoya.
7.3: UThixo wasesithi ku-Isaya, “Hamba wena lendodana yakho uSheyari-Jashubi ukuba lihlangabeze u-Ahazi ekucineni komgelo wamanzi oweChibi Elingaphezulu, emgwaqweni oya Ensimini Yomgezisi.
7.4: Lithi kuye, ‘Nanzelela, hlala ngokuthula, njalo ungesabi. Inhliziyo yakho kayingadeli ngenxa yolaka olwesabekayo lukaRezini lo-Aramu lolwendodana kaRemaliya.’ ”
7.5: U-Aramu lo-Efrayimi lendodana kaRemaliya sebecebe ukukutshabalalisa besithi,
7.6: “Kasihlaseleni ilizwe lakoJuda; kasilidabuleni phakathi silabelane, senze indodana kaThabheli ibe yinkosi yalo.”
7.7: Kodwa-ke lokhu yikho okutshiwo nguThixo Wobukhosi ukuthi:
7.8: ngoba inhloko ye-Aramu yiDamaseko,
7.9: Inhloko ka-Efrayimi yiSamariya,
7.10: UThixo wakhuluma njalo ku-Ahazi wathi,
7.11: “Cela isibonakaliso kuThixo uNkulunkulu wakho, ingabe ekujuleni kwezulu loba phezulu engqongweni.”
7.12: Kodwa u-Ahazi wathi, “Angiyikucela. Angiyikulinga uThixo.”
7.13: U-Isaya wasesithi, “Khathesi-ke zwana wena lendlu kaDavida. Akwenelanga na ukulinga ukubekezela kwabantu? Uzalinga lokubekezela kukaNkulunkulu wami njalo na?
7.14: Ngakho-ke iNkosi ngokwayo izanika isibonakaliso: Intombi egcweleyo izakhulelwa izale indodana bayibize ngokuthi ngu-Emanuweli.
7.15: Uzakudla amasi loluju lapho eselolwazi olwaneleyo ukuba ale okubi akhethe okulungileyo.
7.16: Kodwa-ke umfana engakazi okwaneleyo ukuba ale okubi akhethe okulungileyo, ilizwe lamakhosi amabili owesabayo lizachithwa.
7.17: UThixo uzakwehlisela phezu kwakho laphezu kwabantu bakho, laphezu kwendlu kayihlo, isikhathi esingafani lesinye kusukela u-Efrayimi ebhazuka kuJuda, uzaletha inkosi yase-Asiriya.”
7.18: Ngalelolanga uThixo uzatshaya ikhwelo ebiza impukane ezisekudabukeni kwezifula zaseGibhithe lezinyosi eziselizweni lase-Asiriya.
7.19: Zizakuza zonke zihlale ezingoxweni ezingamawa, ezimbalwini zamadwala, ezihlahleni zonke zameva kuwo wonke amagodi amanzi.
7.20: Ngalolosuku iNkosi izasebenzisa impuco ebolekwe enkosini yase-Asiriya ngaphetsheya koMfula iYufrathe ukuphuca ikhanda lakho loboya obusembaleni yakho, lokugunda indevu zakho lazo.
7.21: Ngalolosuku umuntu uzafuya ithokazi elilodwa lembuzi ezimbili.
7.22: Ngenxa yobunengi bochago oluzavela kuzo, uzakuba lamasi azawadla. Bonke abazasala elizweni bazakudla amasi loluju.
7.23: Ngalolosuku, ezindaweni zonke lapho okwakulamavini ayinkulungwane alingana amashekeli esiliva ayinkulungwane, kuzakuba lokhula lameva kuphela.
7.24: Abantu bazakuya khona belamadandili lemitshoko ngoba ilizwe lizakuba seligcwele ukhula lameva.
7.25: Emaqaqeni wonke ake alinywa ngekhuba kawusayikuya khona ngenxa yokwesaba ukhula lameva, azakuba yindawo yokwelusela inkomo lamadlelo ezimvu.

8.1: UThixo wathi kimi, “Thatha isibhebhedu selitshe esikhulu ulobe kuso ngolimi olujwayelekileyo ukuthi: Maheri-Shalali-Hashi-Bhazi (okutsho ukuthi: abaphanga ukuhuquluza okuphangiweyo).
8.2: Ngizabiza u-Uriya umphristi loZakhariya indodana kaJebherekhiya njengabofakazi bami abathembekileyo.”
8.3: Ngemva kwalokho ngaya kumphrofethikazi, wathatha isisu, wazala indodana. UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Mbize ngokuthi nguMaheri-Shalali-Hashi-Bhazi.
8.4: Kuzakuthi umfana engakakwazi ukuthi ‘Ubaba’ loba ‘Umama,’ inotho yaseDamaseko lempahla ethunjwe eSamariya kuzathathwa yinkosi yase-Asiriya.”
8.5: UThixo wakhuluma kimi futhi wathi:
8.6: “Ngenxa yokuthi abantu laba sebewalile
8.7: ngakho-ke iNkosi isiseduze ukubalethela
8.8: afohlele koJuda, agcwale kulo,
8.9: Hlabani umkhosi wempi lina zizwe, lichithwe!
8.10: Lungisani icebo lenu, kodwa kalisoze liphumelele:
8.11: UThixo wakhuluma kimi isandla sakhe esilamandla siphezu kwami, engixwayisa ukuba ngingalandeli indlela yalababantu. Wathi:
8.12: “Ungabokuthi kungamacebo amabi
8.13: UThixo uSomandla
8.14: Uzakuba yisiphephelo;
8.15: Inengi labo lizakhubeka;
8.16: Bopha ubufakazi besixwayiso,
8.17: Ngizamlindela uThixo,
8.18: Mina ngilapha, kanye labantwana uThixo angiphe bona. Siyizibonakaliso lempawu ku-Israyeli ezivela kuThixo uSomandla, ohlala entabeni iZiyoni.
8.19: Nxa abantu bekutshela ukuthi buza abalamadlozi labalemimoya yobuthakathi, labanyenyezayo bengunguza, kambe abantu akumelanga babuzisise uNkulunkulu wabo na? Kungani abaphilayo libabuzela kwabafayo na?
8.20: Emthethweni lakubo ubufakazi! Nxa bengakhulumi ngokumayelana lelizwi leli, kabalakho ukukhanya kokusa.
8.21: Bazazula lelizwe behlulukelwe, belambile. Lapho sebephalwe yindlala, bazathukuthela, bathuke inkosi yabo loNkulunkulu wabo bekhangele phezulu.
8.22: Emva kwalokho bazakhangela emhlabeni babone usizi kuphela, lomnyama owesabekayo, njalo bazaphoselwa emnyameni opheleleyo.

9.1: Kodwa-ke akusayikuba khona ukudangala kulabo ababesosizini. Ensukwini ezedlulayo walithobisa ilizwe likaZebhuluni lelizwe likaNafithali. Kodwa ensukwini ezizayo uzayipha udumo iGalile yabezizweni, eNdleleni eya oLwandle elandela iJodani:
9.2: Abantu abahamba emnyameni
9.3: Usikhulisile isizwe
9.4: Ngoba njengamhla wokwehlulwa kukaMidiyani
9.5: Lonke inyathela lebutho elisetshenziswe empini,
9.6: Ngoba sizalelwe umntwana,
9.7: Ukwanda kombuso wakhe lokuthula
9.8: INkosi isithumele ilizwi lesixwayiso kuJakhobe
9.9: Abantu bonke bazakwazi
9.10: “Izitina sezidilikele phansi,
9.11: Kodwa uThixo usebaqinisele izitha zikaRezini,
9.12: Ama-Aramu avela empumalanga lamaFilistiya avela entshonalanga
9.13: Kodwa abantu abakabuyeli kuye owabatshayayo.
9.14: Ngakho uThixo uzaquma ko-Israyeli ikhanda lomsila,
9.15: abadala lezikhulu balikhanda,
9.16: Labo abakhokhela abantu laba bayabalahlekisa,
9.17: Ngakho iNkosi kayiyikuthokoza ngezinsizwa zabo,
9.18: Ngeqiniso ububi butshisa njengomlilo,
9.19: Ngolaka lukaThixo uSomandla
9.20: Bazaqeda kwesokudla
9.21: UManase uzakudla u-Efrayimi, u-Efrayimi adle uManase;

10.1: Maye kulabo abenza imithetho emibi,
10.2: ukuba kwamukwe abayanga amalungelo abo
10.3: Lizakwenzani ngosuku lokuthonisiswa
10.4: Akukho okuzasala, kodwa ukuba baquthe phakathi kwabathunjiweyo
10.5: “Maye kumʼAsiriya, intonga yentukuthelo yami,
10.6: Ngimthumela ukuyamelana lesizwe esingelankulunkulu,
10.7: Kodwa lokhu akusikho akujongileyo,
10.8: Uthi, ‘Izinduna zami zebutho kazisimakhosi zonke na?
10.9: IKhalino kaliphumelelanga njengeKharikhemishi na?
10.10: Lanjengoba isandla sami sabamba imibuso yezithombe,
10.11: angiyikuliphatha iJerusalema lezithombe zalo
10.12: Lapho uThixo esewuqedile wonke umsebenzi wakhe mayelana lentaba iZiyoni leJerusalema uzakuthi, “Ngizayijezisa inkosi yase-Asiriya ngenxa yokuzigqaja kwayo lokuzazisa okubonakala emehlweni ayo.”
10.13: Ngoba uthi:
10.14: Njengomuntu efinyelela isidleke senyoni,
10.15: Konje ihloka liyaziphakamisela ngaphezu kwalowo olizulisayo na,
10.16: Ngakho-ke, iNkosi, uThixo uSomandla,
10.17: Ukukhanya kuka-Israyeli kuzakuba ngumlilo,
10.18: Ubuhle bamahlathi akhe lamasimu akhe avundileyo,
10.19: Izihlahla zamahlathi ezisalayo zizakuba zilutshwana,
10.20: Ngalolosuku insalela yako-Israyeli,
10.21: Insalela izabuyela, insalela kaJakhobe
10.22: Loba abantu bakho, we Israyeli, benjengetshebetshebe olwandle,
10.24: Ngakho-ke lokho yikho iNkosi, uThixo uSomandla akutshoyo:
10.27: Ngalolosuku imithwalo yabo izasuswa emahlombe enu,

11.1: Ihlumela lizavela esidindini sikaJese;
11.2: UMoya kaThixo uzakuba phezu kwakhe,
11.3: njalo uzathokoziswa yikwesaba uThixo.
11.4: kodwa abaswelayo uzabehlulela ngokulunga
11.5: Ukulunga kuzakuba libhanti lakhe,
11.6: Impisi izahlala lezinyane lemvu,
11.7: Inkomokazi izakudla lebhele,
11.8: Usane luzadlalela phansi komlindi webululu,
11.9: Abayikulimaza loba badilize
11.10: Ngalolosuku iMpande kaJese izakuma njengophawu ebantwini; izizwe zizabuthana kuye, indawo yakhe yokuphumula izakuba lodumo.
11.11: Ngalolosuku uThixo uzakwelula isandla sakhe okwesibili ukuba abuyise insalela zabantu bakhe abasala e-Asiriya, eGibhithe, ePhathrosi, eTiyopiya, eKhushi, e-Elamu, eShinari, eHamathi lasezihlengeni zolwandle.
11.12: Uzaphakamisela izizwe uphawu
11.13: Ubukhwele buka-Efrayimi buzaphela,
11.14: Bazahwitha phansi emithezukweni yaseFilistiya ngasentshonalanga;
11.15: UThixo uzacitsha
11.16: Kuzakuba lomgwaqo omkhulu wezinsalela zabantu bakhe

12.1: Ngalolosuku wena uzakuthi:
12.2: Ngeqiniso uNkulunkulu uyinsindiso yami;
12.3: Ngentokozo uzakukha amanzi
12.4: Ngalolosuku uzakuthi:
12.5: Hlabelelani kuThixo, ngoba wenze izinto ezinhle kakhulu;
12.6: Memezani kakhulu lihlabele ngokuthokoza, bantu baseZiyoni,

13.1: Leli yilizwi elimayelana leBhabhiloni elaboniswa u-Isaya indodana ka-Amozi:
13.2: Phakamisa uphawu phezu koqaqa oluligceke,
13.3: Sengibalayile abangcwele bami,
13.4: Lalelani, umsindo phezu kwezintaba,
13.5: Bavela emazweni akude,
13.6: Lilani ngoba usuku lukaThixo seluseduze.
13.7: Ngenxa yalokhu izandla zonke zizakuba buthakathaka,
13.8: Bazakuba lokwesaba okukhulu,
13.9: Khangelani usuku lukaThixo luyeza,
13.10: Izinkanyezi zezulu lemithala yazo
13.11: Umhlaba ngizawujezisa ngenxa yobubi bawo,
13.12: Ngizakwenza abantu basweleke okudlula igolide elicengekileyo,
13.13: Ngakho-ke ngizakwenza amazulu anyikinyeke;
13.14: Njengempala ezingelwayo,
13.15: Lowo ozathunjwa uzagwazwa;
13.16: Izingane zabo zizamahlazelwa phambi kwamehlo abo;
13.17: Khangelani, ngizabavusela amaMede
13.18: Imitshoko yawo izabulala izinsizwa;
13.19: IBhabhiloni, igugu lemibuso,
13.20: Akuyikuhlalwa kulo futhi
13.21: Kodwa izinyamazana zeganga zizahlala khona,
13.22: Impisi zizakhala ezinqabeni zakhona,

14.1: UThixo uzakuba lesihawu kuJakhobe;
14.2: Izizwe zizabathatha
14.3: Ngosuku uThixo azaliphumuza ngalo ekuhluphekeni, ekutshikatshikeni, lasebugqilini obulesihluku,
14.4: lizakutsho la amazwi okukloloda enkosini yaseBhabhiloni lithi:
14.5: UThixo useyephule intonga yababi,
14.6: abatshaya abantu ngokuthukuthela,
14.7: Amazwe wonke alokuphumula lokuthula;
14.8: Lezihlahla zamaphayini lemisedari yaseLebhanoni
14.9: Ithuna ngaphansi liyanyakaza
14.10: Bazaphendula bonke,
14.11: Bonke ubukhosi bakho sebehliselwe phansi ethuneni,
14.12: Yeka ukuwa kwakho uvela ezulwini,
14.13: Wathi enhliziyweni yakho,
14.14: Ngizakwenyukela phezu kwezindawo
14.15: Kodwa ulethwe phansi ethuneni,
14.16: Labo abakubonayo bakudonsela amehlo,
14.17: umuntu owenza umhlaba waba lugwadule,
14.18: Wonke amakhosi ezizwe alele ebukhosini,
14.19: Kodwa wena uphoselwe ngaphandle kwethuna
14.20: kawuyikuhlangana labo ekungcwatshweni;
14.21: Lungisa indawo yokubulalela abantwabakhe
14.22: “Ngizabavukela,”
14.28: Ilizwi leli lafika nyakana kusifa inkosi u-Ahazi:
14.31: Lila wena sango! Bubula wena dolobho!

15.1: Isiqalekiso esimayelana leMowabi:
15.2: IDibhoni iya phezulu ethempelini layo;
15.3: Ezindleleni bagqoka amasaka,
15.4: IHeshibhoni le-Eliyale kuyakhala,
15.5: Inhliziyo yami ikhalela iMowabi,
15.6: Amanzi aseNimirimi acitshile,
15.7: Ngakho inotho abayizuzileyo bayigcina,
15.8: Ukuklabalala kwabo kuzwakele emngceleni waseMowabi,
15.9: Amanzi aseDimoni agcwele igazi

16.1: Thumelani izimvu njengendlela yokuhlonipha
16.2: Njengenyoni ephaphazelayo
16.3: UMowabi uthi, “Zinzisani ingqondo zenu
16.4: Vumelani iziphepheli zamaMowabi zihlale kini;
16.5: Ngothando, kuzamiswa isihlalo sobukhosi;
16.6: Sizwile ngokuzigqaja kukaMowabi.
16.7: Ngakho-ke abaseMowabi bayalila,
16.8: Amasimu aseHeshibhoni ayabuna,
16.9: Ngakho ngiyakhala njengalokhu iJazeri ikhala,
16.10: Ukuthokoza lokuthaba akusekho ezivinini;
16.11: Inhliziyo yami ikhalela uMowabi njengechacho,
16.12: Lapho uMowabi evela endaweni yakhe ephakemeyo
16.13: Leli yilizwi uThixo avele eselikhulumile ngoMowabi.
16.14: Kodwa khathesi uThixo uthi: “Phakathi kweminyaka emithathu, njengesisebenzi esibotshwe yisivumelwano singayibala, udumo lukaMowabi labantu bakhe bonke abanengi kuzakweyiswa, njalo abazasinda bakhona bazakuba balutshwana kakhulu njalo bengelamandla.”

17.1: Isiqalekiso esimayelana leDamaseko:
17.2: Amadolobho ase-Aroyeri azatshiywa,
17.3: Idolobho elivikelweyo lizanyamalala ko-Efrayimi
17.4: “Ngalolusuku udumo lukaJakhobe luzakwehla;
17.5: Kuzakuba njengalapho umvuni evuna amabele amiyo
17.6: Ikanti ezinye izikhwebu zizasala,
17.7: Ngalolosuku abantu bazathembela kuMenzi
17.8: Abayikuthembela ema-alithareni,
17.9: Ngalolosuku amadolobho abo aqinileyo, abawatshiyayo ngenxa yama-Israyeli azafana lezindawo ezatshiyelwa izixukwana lezihlahlanyana. Konke kuzakuba yincithakalo.
17.10: Selimkhohliwe uNkulunkulu uMsindisi wenu,
17.11: lanxa lingawenza akhule ngelanga
17.12: Maye, ukuhlokoma kwezizwe ezinengi,
17.13: Lanxa izizwe zihuba njengokugubhuza kwamanzi,
17.14: Kusihlwa kuba lokuthuthumela.

18.1: Maye ngelizwe elilokuphaphazela kwempiko
18.2: elithuma izithunywa zihamba olwandle
18.3: Lonke lina bantu bomhlaba,
18.4: Lokhu yikho uThixo akutshoyo kimi:
18.5: Ngoba kungakavunwa, lapho ukukhahlela sekudlule,
18.6: Zonke zizatshiyelwa izinyoni zasezintabeni ezidla inyama,
18.7: Ngalesosikhathi izipho zizalethwa kuThixo uSomandla

19.1: Isiphrofethi esimayelana leGibhithe sithi:
19.2: “Ngizadunga umGibhithe alwe lomGibhithe,
19.3: AbaseGibhithe bazaphelelwa lithemba,
19.4: AbaseGibhithe ngizabanikela
19.5: Amanzi omfula azakutsha,
19.6: Imigelo izanuka,
19.7: kanjalo lezihlahlanyana emakhunjini kaNayili
19.8: Abagoli benhlanzi bazabubula balile,
19.9: Labo abasebenzisa isikusha bazadangala,
19.10: Izisebenzi zasemalenjini zizadana,
19.11: Izikhulu zaseZowani azisilutho kodwa izithutha nje;
19.12: Khathesi bangaphi abantu bakini abahlakaniphileyo?
19.13: Izikhulu zaseZowani sezibe yizithutha,
19.14: UThixo usethele umoya wesiyezi phakathi kwabo;
19.15: Akulalutho iGibhithe engalwenza,
19.16: Ngalolosuku abaseGibhithe bazafana labesifazane. Bazathuthumela ngokwesaba isandla esiphakanyisiweyo uThixo uSomandla abaphakamisele sona.
19.17: Lelizwe lakoJuda lizaletha ukwesaba kwabaseGibhithe. Bonke okuzakhulunywa kubo ngoJuda bazathuthumela, ngenxa yalokho uThixo uSomandla aceba ukukwenza kubo.
19.18: Ngalolosuku amadolobho amahlanu aseGibhithe azakhuluma ulimi lwaseKhenani, afungele ukwethembeka kuThixo uSomandla. Elinye lawo lizathiwa liDolobho leNcithakalo.
19.19: Ngalolosuku kuzakuba le-alithari likaThixo phakathi kwelizwe laseGibhithe, lelitshe lesikhumbuzo sikaThixo emngceleni walo.
19.20: Lizakuba yisibonakaliso lobufakazi kuThixo uSomandla elizweni laseGibhithe. Lapho bekhalaza kuThixo ngenxa yabancindezeli babo, uzabathumela umsindisi lomvikeli, abahlenge.
19.21: Kanjalo uThixo uzakwenza ukuba azakale kwabaseGibhithe, njalo ngalolosuku bazamvuma uThixo. Bazakhonza ngemihlatshelo langeminikelo yamabele; bazakwenza izifungo kuThixo, bazigcine.
19.22: UThixo uzatshaya iGibhithe ngesifo; uzabatshaya aphinde abasilise. Bazaphendukela kuThixo, njalo uzakuzwa imikhuleko yabo abasilise.
19.23: Ngalolosuku bazakuba lomgwaqo osuka eGibhithe usiya e-Asiriya. Abase-Asiriya bazakuya eGibhithe, abeGibhithe labo baye e-Asiriya. AbaseGibhithe labase-Asiriya bazakhonza ndawonye.
19.24: Ngalolosuku i-Israyeli izakuba ngeyesithathu kanye leGibhithe le-Asiriya kube yisibusiso emhlabeni.
19.25: UThixo uSomandla uzababusisa esithi, “Kayibusiswe iGibhithe abantu bami, i-Asiriya umsebenzi wezandla zami le-Israyeli ilifa lami.”

20.1: Ngomnyaka indunankulu yebutho eyafika ngawo e-Ashidodi, ithunywe nguSagoni inkosi yase-Asiriya, yahlasela i-Ashidodi yayithumba,
20.2: ngalesosikhathi uThixo wakhuluma ngo-Isaya indodana ka-Amozi wathi kuye, “Susa isaka oligqokileyo emzimbeni wakho ukhuphe lamanyathela ezinyaweni zakho.” Wenza njalo, wahamba nqunu njalo engagqokanga lutho ezinyaweni.
20.3: UThixo wasesithi, “Njengoba inceku yami u-Isaya ihambe nqunu njalo ingagqokanga lutho ezinyaweni okweminyaka emithathu njengesibonakaliso lomhlolo kwabaseGibhithe labaseKhushi,
20.4: ngokunjalo inkosi yase-Asiriya izabaqhuba benqunu njalo bengafakanga manyathela ezinyaweni abaseGibhithe abathunjiweyo labaseKhushi abaxotshwayo elizweni lakibo, abatsha labadala, izibunu zisegcekeni, kube lihlazo eGibhithe.
20.5: Labo ababethembe iKhushi bezincoma ngeGibhithe, bazakwesaba bayangiswe.
20.6: Ngalolosuku abantu abahlala kulelicele eliseduze kolwandle bazakuthi, ‘Khangelani osokwenzakale kulabo ebesigwaba ngabo, labo esabalekela kubo ukuba sithole usizo lokukhululwa enkosini yase-Asiriya! Pho sizaphepha kanjani na?’ ”

21.1: Isiphrofethi mayelana leNkangala engasoLwandle:
21.2: Ngitshengiswe umbono owesabekayo.
21.3: Ngalokhu umzimba wami uyafuthelwa,
21.4: Inhliziyo yami iphela amandla,
21.5: Itafula bayilungisile,
21.6: Lokhu yikho uThixo akutshoyo kimi:
21.7: Angabona izinqola zempi,
21.8: Umlindi wasememeza esithi,
21.9: Khangela, nangu umuntu esiza esenqoleni yempi
21.10: Awu bantu bami elibhulelwe esizeni,
21.11: Isiphrofethi esimayelana leDuma:
21.12: Umlindi uphendula esithi,
21.13: Isiphrofethi esimayelana le-Arabhiya:
21.14: lethelani abomileyo amanzi;
21.15: Babalekela inkemba,
21.16: Lokhu yikho uThixo akutshoyo kimi ukuthi: “Phakathi komnyaka owodwa nje, njengendlela isisebenzi esiqhatshiweyo esingawubala ngayo, lonke udumo lweKhedari luzaphela.
21.17: Abasindayo kwabemitshoko, amabutho aseKhedari, bazakuba balutshwana.” UThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, usekhulumile.

22.1: Isiphrofethi ngesiGodi soMbono:
22.2: wena dolobho eligcwele iziphithiphithi,
22.3: Bonke abakhokheli bakho babaleke bebonke,
22.4: Ngakho ngathi, “Sukani kimi;
22.5: INkosi, uThixo uSomandla, ulosuku
22.6: I-Elamu ithatha isikhwama semitshoko,
22.7: Izigodi zakho ezinhle kakhulu zigcwele izinqola zempi,
22.8: Ukuvikeleka kukaJuda kususiwe,
22.9: wabona ukuthi iDolobho likaDavida
22.10: Wabala izindlu zaseJerusalema,
22.11: Phakathi kwemiduli yomibili wakha indawo yokugcinela
22.12: Ngalolosuku iNkosi, uThixo uSomandla,
22.13: Kodwa khangela, kulokuthaba lokuthokoza,
22.14: UThixo uSomandla usekuvezile lokhu ngisizwa: “Lesisono kasiyikuthethelelwa kuze kube lusuku lwakho lokufa,” kutsho iNkosi, uThixo uSomandla.
22.15: Lokhu yikho okutshiwo yiNkosi, uThixo uSomandla, uthi:
22.16: Wenzani lapha, njalo ngubani okuphe imvumo ukuba
22.17: Qaphela, sekuseduze ukuthi uThixo akubambe aqinise,
22.18: Uzakugoqa ngokuqinisa akubumbe njengebhola
22.19: Ngizakususa esikhundleni sakho,
22.20: Ngalolosuku ngizabiza inceku yami, u-Eliyakhimu indodana kaHilikhiya.
22.21: Ngizamgqokisa izembatho zakho, ngimbophe ngebhanti lakho, ngimnike amandla akho. Uzakuba nguyise walabo abahlala eJerusalema lakwabendlu kaJuda.
22.22: Ngizabeka phezu kwamahlombe akhe isivulo sendlu kaDavida; akuvulayo kakho ongakuvala.
22.23: Ngizambethela njengesikhonkwane endaweni eqinileyo; uzakuba yisihlalo sobukhosi sasendlini kayise.
22.24: Lonke udumo lwakwabo luzakuba kuye, inzalo yakhona lezizukulwane zonke, izitsha zakhona ezincinyane, kusukela emiganwini kusiya enkonxeni zonke.
22.25: “Ngalolosuku,” kutsho uThixo uSomandla, “isikhonkwane esabethelwa endaweni eqinileyo sizakhumuka; sizaqunywa siwe, umthwalo ophezu kwaso uzawela phansi.” UThixo usekhulumile.

23.1: Isiqalekiso esimayelana leThire:
23.2: Thulani lina bantu basesihlengeni
23.3: Amabele aseShihori
23.4: Woba lenhloni wena Sidoni, lawe wena nqaba yasolwandle
23.5: Lapho ilizwi lifika eGibhithe
23.6: Khuphukelani ngaseThashishi;
23.7: Leli yilo na idolobho lenu lentokozo,
23.11: UThixo useselulele isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle
23.15: Ngalesosikhathi iThire izakhohlakala okweminyaka engamatshumi ayisikhombisa, ibanga lokuphila kwenkosi. Kodwa ekupheleni kwaleyominyaka engamatshumi ayisikhombisa, eThire kuzakwenzakala okunjengokutshiwo yingoma yewule ukuthi:
23.17: Ekupheleni kweminyaka engamatshumi ayisikhombisa uThixo uzakhumbula iThire. IThire lizabuyela ekuthengiseni kwalo njengesifebe, njalo lizabuyela emsebenzini walo wokuthengiselana lemibuso yonke esemhlabeni.
23.18: Inzuzo lemiholo yalo kuzakwahlukaniselwa uThixo; kakuyikulondolozwa loba kubuthelelwe. Inzuzo yalo izakuya kulabo abahlala loThixo ukuba babe lokudla okunengi lezigqoko ezinhle.

24.1: Khangela, uThixo
24.2: Kuzafanana
24.3: Umhlaba uzatshabalaliswa nya
24.4: Umhlaba uyoma ubune,
24.5: Umhlaba ungcoliswa ngabantu bawo.
24.6: Ngakho-ke umhlaba uchithwa yisiqalekiso;
24.7: Iwayini elitsha liyaphela, amavini ayabuna;
24.8: Ukukhala kwamagedla kuthulisiwe,
24.9: Kabasanathi iwayini behlabela,
24.10: Idolobho elidilikileyo litshabalele;

25.6: Phezu kwale intaba uThixo uSomandla uzakwenzela

26.1: Ngalolosuku ingoma le izahlatshelwa elizweni lakoJuda:
26.8: Yebo, Thixo, sihamba endleleni yemithetho yakho,
26.11: Oh Thixo, isandla sakho siphakanyiselwe phezulu,
26.13: Oh Thixo, Nkulunkulu wethu, amanye amakhosi ngaphandle kwakho ake asibusa,
26.20: Hambani bantu bami, ngenani ezindlini zenu,
26.21: Khangelani, uThixo uyaphuma lapho ahlala khona

27.12: Ngalolosuku uThixo uzabhula kusukela kuYufrathe ogelezayo kusiya eMhotsheni waseGibhithe, njalo lina abako-Israyeli lizabuthwa munye ngamunye.
27.13: Njalo ngalolusuku kuzakhaliswa icilongo elikhulu. Labo ababelahlekele elizweni lase-Asiriya lababexotshelwe elizweni laseGibhithe bazabuya bakhonze uThixo phezu kwentaba engcwele eJerusalema.

28.3: Umqhele lowo wamaluba, iqhono lezidakwa zako-Efrayimi
28.13: Ngakho ilizwi likaThixo kubo lizakuba ngelithi:
28.14: Ngakho-ke zwanini ilizwi likaThixo lina bantu abaklolodayo,
28.16: Ngakho lokhu yikho okutshiwo nguThixo woBukhosi:
28.20: Umbheda mfitshane kakhulu ukuba unabe kuwo,
28.21: UThixo uzavuka njengalokho akwenzayo entabeni iPherazimu;
28.24: Lapho umlimi elima ukuba ahlanyele, ulima kokuphela na?
28.28: Amabele kumele acholwe ukuba kwenziwe isinkwa,
28.29: Konke lokhu lakho kuvela kuThixo uSomandla

29.7: Lapho-ke amaxuku ezizwe zonke ezilwa le-Ariyeli,
29.11: Kini umbono wonke lo kawusilutho kodwa amazwi nje avalelwe encwadini egoqiweyo. Njalo nxa incwadi leyo liyiqhubela umuntu okwaziyo ukubala lithi kuye, “Ake ubale lokhu,” uzaphendula athi, “Anganelisi, ngoba ivaliwe.”
29.12: Loba nxa incwadi leyo liyiqhubela umuntu ongakwaziyo ukubala lithi kuye, “Ake ubale lokhu,” uzaphendula athi, “Angikwazi ukubala.”
29.21: labo abenza umuntu abe lecala ngokufakaza amanga,
29.22: Ngakho-ke lokhu yikho uThixo owahlenga u-Abhrahama akutshoyo kwabendlu kaJakhobe:

30.3: Kodwa-ke ukuvikelwa nguFaro kuzakuba lihlazo kini,
30.8: Hamba khathesi nje, ubalobele khona esibhebhedwini,
30.13: isono lesi kini sizafana lomduli ophakemeyo,
30.15: Lokhu yikho okutshiwo nguThixo Wobukhosi, oNgcwele ka-Israyeli, ukuthi:
30.18: Kodwa uThixo ulangatha ukuba lomusa kini;
30.19: Awu bantu baseZiyoni, abahlala eJerusalema, alisayikulila. UThixo uzakuba lomusa kini nxa licela usizo. Uzaliphendula khonokho nje ekulizweni kwakhe.
30.20: Lanxa nje uThixo elinika isinkwa sokuhlupheka lamanzi osizi, abalifundisayo kabayikucatsha futhi; lizababona ngamehlo enu.
30.21: Loba liphambukele kwesokudla kumbe kwesenxele lizalizwa ilizwi ngemva kwenu lisithi, “Le yiyo indlela; hambani ngayo.”
30.22: Lapho-ke lizangcolisa izithombe zenu ezihuqwe ngesiliva lezifanekiso zenu ezinanyekwe ngegolide; lizazilahlela khatshana njengelembu lowesifazane obesesikhathini, lithi kuzo, “Sukani lapha!”
30.23: UThixo uzalehlisela izulu lenhlanyelo yenu eliyihlanyele emhlabathini, lamabele azavela emhlabathini azakuba mahle njalo emanengi. Ngalolosuku inkomo zenu zizakudla emadlelweni abanzi.
30.24: Inkabi labobabhemi elilima ngakho umhlabathi kuzakudla utshani lamabele ahlungulwe ngefologwe langefotsholo.
30.25: Ngosuku lokubulawa okukhulu, lapho imiphotshongo isiwa, izifula zamanzi zizageleza kuzozonke izintaba ezinde lakuwo wonke amaqaqa adephileyo.
30.26: Inyanga izakhanya njengelanga, ukukhanya kwelanga kukhanye ngokuphindwe kasikhombisa, njengokukhanya kwensuku eziyisikhombisa ezigcweleyo, lapho uThixo esebopha amanxeba abantu bakhe, epholisa lezilonda ezabangwa nguye.
30.30: UThixo uzakwenza abantu balizwe ilizwi lakhe lobukhosi,

31.1: Maye kulabo abaya eGibhithe ukuyafuna usizo,
31.2: Ikanti laye uhlakaniphile njalo angaletha incithakalo;
31.4: Lokhu yikho okutshiwo nguThixo kimi, ukuthi:
31.6: Awu bantu bako-Israyeli, buyelani kulowo elamhlamukela kakubi.
31.7: Ngoba ngalolosuku lonke lizazilahla izithombe zenu zesiliva lezegolide elizenze ngezandla zenu ezonayo.

32.2: Umuntu ngamunye uzakuba njengesihonqo sokuvikela umoya,
32.8: Kodwa umuntu ohloniphekayo wenza amacebo ahloniphekayo,
32.12: Zitshayeni izifuba zenu ngenxa yamasimu amahle,
32.15: umoya uze uthelwe phezu kwethu uvela phezulu,
32.16: Ukwahlulela kuhle kukaThixo kuzakuba khona enkangala,

33.4: Elakuthumbayo, lina zizwe, kubuthwa sengangathi kuqoqwa yisikhongwane,
33.7: Khangelani, amaqhawe akibo ahlaba umkhosi emigwaqweni!
33.17: Amehlo enu azayibona inkosi ebuhleni bayo,
33.18: Ezingqondweni zenu lizakhumbula ukwesaba kwakuqala lithi:

34.12: Izikhulu zalo kaziyikuba lalutho olungathiwa ngumbuso,
34.15: Isikhova sizakwakha isidleke khona sibekele amaqanda,

36.1: Ngomnyaka wetshumi lane wokubusa kwenkosi uHezekhiya, uSenakheribhi inkosi yase-Asiriya wahlasela wonke amadolobho avikelweyo akoJuda wawathumba.
36.2: Emva kwalokho inkosi yase-Asiriya yathuma umlawuli wayo lebutho elikhulu lisuka eLakhishi lisiya enkosini uHezekhiya eJerusalema. Kwathi umlawuli webutho esemi emgelweni wechibi elingaphezulu, elisendleleni eya eNsimini yoMgezisi,
36.3: u-Eliyakhimu indodana kaHilikhiya umgcini wesigodlo, loShebhina umabhalane kanye loJowa indodana ka-Asafi umbhali, baya kuye.
36.4: Umlawuli webutho wathi kubo, “Tshelani uHezekhiya ukuthi,
36.5: Uthi ulamaqhinga lamandla ebutho kodwa ukhuluma amazwi ayize. Uthembe bani uze ungihlamukele nje?
36.6: Khangela, ngiyazi uthembe iGibhithe, yona enjengomhlanga ozimvava osika isandla somuntu umlimaze nxa eweyamile. Unjalo uFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe kubo bonke abathembele kuye.
36.7: Njalo nxa lisithi kimi, “Thina sithembe uThixo uNkulunkulu wethu,” kasuye yini uHezekhiya asusa izindawo zakhe eziphakemeyo lama-alithare akhe, esithi kuJuda leJerusalema, “Kumele likhonzele phambi kwaleli i-alithari”?
36.8: Khathesi woza wenze isivumelwano lenkosi yami, inkosi yase-Asiriya: Ngizakunika amabhiza azinkulungwane ezimbili nxa bekhona abazawagada!
36.9: Pho ungayehlula njani induna eyodwa yezikhulu ezincane zenkosi yami, lanxa uthembele eGibhithe ekutholeni izinqola zempi labagadi bamabhiza na?
36.10: Phezu kwalokho, kanti ngizehlasela lokuzochitha ilizwe leli kungatshongo uThixo na? UThixo uqobo nguye othe ngizohlasela ilizwe leli ngilichithe.’ ”
36.11: Ngakho u-Eliyakhimu loShebhina loJowa bathi kumlawuli webutho, “Ake ukhulume ezincekwini zakho ngesi-Aramayikhi ngoba siyasizwa. Ungasikhulumisi ngesiHebheru lababantu abasemdulini besizwa.”
36.12: Kodwa umlawuli webutho waphendula esithi, “Inkosi yami ingithume ukuba izinto lezi ngizitsho kuphela enkosini yenu lakini, hatshi ebantwini abahlezi emdulini okuzakuthi labo njengani badle ubulongwe babo banathe lomchamo wabo na?”
36.13: Umlawuli webutho wasukuma wasememeza ngesiHebheru esithi, “Zwanini amazwi enkosi enkulu, inkosi yase-Asiriya!
36.14: Lokhu yikho okutshiwo yinkosi: Lingamvumeli uHezekhiya ukuba alikhohlise. Angeke alikhulule.
36.15: Lingamvumeli uHezekhiya elincenga ukuba lithembele kuThixo lapho esithi ‘Ngempela uThixo uzasikhulula; idolobho leli kaliyikuphiwa esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya.’ ”
36.16: Lingamlaleli uHezekhiya. Nanku okutshiwo yinkosi yase-Asiriya: Yenza isivumelwano sokuthula lami, uphume uze kimi. Lapho-ke omunye lomunye uzakudla esivinini sakhe lasemikhiweni yakhe, anathe lamanzi emthonjeni wakhe,
36.17: ngize ngifike ngilithathe, ngilise elizweni elifanana lelakini, ilizwe lamabele lewayini elitsha, ilizwe lesinkwa lezivini.
36.18: “Lingavumeli uHezekhiya ukuthi alikhohlise esithi, ‘UThixo uzasikhulula.’ Kulonkulunkulu wesinye isizwe osewake wakhulula ilizwe lakhe esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya na?
36.19: Bangaphi onkulunkulu baseHamathi le-Ariphadi na? Bangaphi onkulunkulu baseSefavayimi na? Bayikhululile iSamariya esandleni sami na?
36.20: Nguphi kubo bonke onkulunkulu bamazwe la oke wenelisa ukukhulula ilizwe lakhe kimi na? Pho uThixo angayikhulula njani iJerusalema esandleni sami na?”
36.21: Kodwa abantu bathula kabazange batsho lutho, ngoba inkosi yayilaye yathi, “Lingamphenduli.”
36.22: U-Eliyakhimu indodana kaHilikhiya umgcini wesigodlo loShebhina umabhalane loJowa indodana ka-Asafi umbhali, baya kuHezekhiya izigqoko zabo zidabukile bamtshela okwakutshiwo ngumlawuli webutho.

37.1: Kwathi lapho uHezekhiya, inkosi, esezwe lokhu, wadabula izigqoko zakhe wagqoka amasaka, wasesiya ethempelini likaThixo.
37.2: Wathuma u-Eliyakhimu umphathi wesigodlo, uShebhina umabhalane labaphristi abangabakhokheli, bonke begqoke amasaka, baya kumphrofethi u-Isaya indodana ka-Amozi.
37.3: Bathi kuye, “UHezekhiya uthi: ilanga lanamhla lusuku losizi lokusolwa kanye lehlazo njengalapho abantwana sekufike isikhathi sokuthi bazalwe kodwa amandla okubeletha engekho.
37.4: Mhlawumbe uThixo uNkulunkulu wakho izawezwa amazwi omlawuli webutho, onkosi yakhe, inkosi yase-Asiriya, emthume ukuba athuke uNkulunkulu ophilayo, lokuthi uzamthuka ngenxa yamazwi uThixo uNkulunkulu wakho ewazwileyo. Ngakho-ke khulekela insali elokhu iphila.”
37.5: Kwathi izithunywa zenkosi uHezekhiya sezifikile ku-Isaya,
37.6: u-Isaya wathi kuzo, “Tshelani inkosi yenu lithi, ‘Nanku okutshiwo nguThixo: Ungesabi lokhu okuzwileyo, amazwi lawana izinceku zenkosi yase-Asiriya ezingithuke ngawo.
37.7: Lalela! Ngizafaka umoya ozamenza athi nxa esizwa umbiko othile, afune ukubuyela elizweni lakhe, athi angafika khonale ngenze ukuba abulawe ngenkemba.’ ”
37.8: Kwathi lapho umlawuli webutho esezwile ukuthi inkosi yase-Asiriya yayisisukile eLakhishi, laye wasuka wayathola inkosi isilwa leLibhina.
37.9: USenakheribhi wemukela umbiko othi uThirihaka inkosi yaseKhushi, wayesiza ukuba amhlasele. Esezwe lokho wathumela izithunywa kuHezekhiya lombiko othi:
37.10: “Tshela uHezekhiya inkosi yakoJuda ukuthi: Ungavumi ukuthi unkulunkulu omthembileyo akukhohlise esithi, ‘IJerusalema kaliyikunikelwa enkosini yase-Asiriya.’
37.11: Ngempela usukuzwile okwenziwa ngamakhosi ase-Asiriya emazweni wonke, ewabhidliza okupheleleyo. Wena-ke uzaphepha na?
37.12: Onkulunkulu bezizwe ezatshabalaliswa ngokhokho bami bake bazikhulula na, onkulunkulu beGozani, iHarani, iRezefi kanye labantu base-Edeni ababeseThelasari?
37.13: Ingaphi inkosi yaseHamathi, inkosi yase-Ariphadi, angaphi amakhosi aseLayiri leSefavayimi, loba eyaseHena kumbe eyase-Iva?”
37.14: UHezekhiya wemukela incwadi eyeza lezithunywa wayibala. Emva kwalokho waya ethempelini leNkosi, wayichaya phambi kukaThixo.
37.16: “Thixo Somandla, Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli osebukhosini phakathi kwamaKherubhi, wena kuphela nguwe onguNkulunkulu wemibuso yonke yasemhlabeni. Nguwe owenza izulu lomhlaba.
37.17: Beka indlebe Thixo, uzwe; vula amehlo akho Thixo, ubone. Lalela uzwe wonke amazwi uSenakheribhi awathumele ukuzathuka uNkulunkulu ophilayo.
37.18: Kuliqiniso, Thixo, ukuthi amakhosi ase-Asiriya abatshabalalisa bonke lababantu kanye lamazwe abo.
37.19: Aphosele onkulunkulu bawo emlilweni abatshabalalisa, ngoba kungesibo onkulunkulu kodwa yizigodo lamatshe kuphela, okubunjwe ngezandla zabantu.
37.20: Khathesi, Thixo, Nkulunkulu wethu, sikhulule esandleni sakhe, ukuze imibuso yonke emhlabeni ibekwazi ukuthi wena Thixo, nguwe wedwa onguNkulunkulu.”
37.21: U-Isaya indodana ka-Amozi wathumela ilizwi kuHezekhiya elithi, “Nanku okutshiwo nguThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli: Ngenxa yokuthi ukhulekile kimi mayelana ngoSenakheribhi inkosi yase-Asiriya,
37.22: nanti ilizwi uThixo aselikhulume ngaye wathi:
37.33: Ngakho-ke mayelana lenkosi yase-Asiriya uThixo uthi:
37.36: Lapho-ke ingilosi kaThixo yasuka yayabulala abantu abalikhulu elilamatshumi ayisificaminwembili lanhlanu lezinkulungwane ezihonqweni zama-Asiriya. Kwathi lapho abantu bevuka ekuseni kwakhona bonke kwasekuyizidumbu kuphela!
37.37: Ngakho uSenakheribhi inkosi yama-Asiriya wasuka ezihonqweni wahamba. Wabuyela eNiniva wahlala khona.
37.38: Kwathi ngolunye usuku ekhonza ethempelini likaNisirokhi unkulunkulu wakhe, amadodana akhe u-Adrameleki loShareza ambulala ngenkemba asebalekela elizweni lase-Ararathi. U-Esarihadoni indodana yakhe yaba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.”

38.1: Ngalezonsuku uHezekhiya wagula eselengela ekufeni. Umphrofethi u-Isaya, indodana ka-Amozi waya kuye wathi, “Nanku okutshiwo nguThixo: Lungisa indlu yakho ngoba uzakufa, awuyikusila.”
38.2: UHezekhiya waphenduka wakhangela emdulini wakhuleka kuThixo esithi,
38.3: “Khumbula, Thixo, ukuthi ngihambe phambi kwakho ngokuthembeka langokuzinikela ngenhliziyo yami yonke, njalo ngenze okuhle emehlweni akho.” UHezekhiya wakhala kabuhlungu.
38.4: Emva kwalokho kwafika ilizwi likaThixo ku-Isaya lisithi:
38.5: “Yana kuHezekhiya uthi kuye, ‘Nanku okutshiwo nguThixo, uNkulunkulu kayihlo uDavida, uthi: Ngiwuzwile umkhuleko wakho, njalo ngizibonile lezinyembezi zakho. Ngizakwengezelela iminyaka elitshumi lanhlanu ekuphileni kwakho.
38.6: Njalo ngizakukhulula wena, kanye ledolobho leli ezandleni zenkosi yase-Asiriya. Ngizavikela idolobho leli.
38.7: Lesi yisibonakaliso sikaThixo kuwe sokuthi uThixo uzakwenza njengokuthembisa kwakhe:
38.8: Ngizakwenza umthunzi obangelwe lilanga ubuyele emuva amanyathelo alitshumi umthunzi owehle ngawo emakhwelelweni ka-Ahazi.’ ” Ngakho ukukhanya kwelanga kwabuyela emuva ngamanyathela alitshumi elaselikhothame ngawo.
38.9: La ngamazwi alotshwa nguHezekhiya inkosi yakoJuda emva kokuba esesilile ekuguleni kwakhe:
38.21: U-Isaya wayethe, “Lungisani isigaqa semikhiwa usifake phezu kwethumba, uzasila.”
38.22: UHezekhiya wayebuze wathi, “Kuyini okuzakuba yisibonakaliso sokuthi ngizakhwela ngiye phezulu ethempelini likaThixo na?”

39.1: Ngalesosikhathi uMerodakhi-Bhaladani indodana kaBhaladani inkosi yaseBhabhiloni, wathumela izincwadi lesipho kuHezekhiya, ngoba wayezwile ngokugula kwakhe lokusila kwakhe.
39.2: UHezekhiya wazamukela izithunywa ngokuthaba, wazitshengisa okwakusendlini yakhe yokugcinela impahla, isiliva, igolide, iziyoliso, amafutha acengekileyo, izikhali zakhe zonke, lakho konke okwakukhona enothweni yakhe. Akulalutho esigodlweni sakhe loba embusweni wakhe wonke angazitshengisanga khona.
39.3: Ngakho u-Isaya umphrofethi waya kuHezekhiya inkosi wambuza wathi, “Atheni amadoda lawana, njalo avela ngaphi?”
39.5: Ngakho u-Isaya wasesithi kuHezekhiya, “Zwana ilizwi likaThixo uSomandla lithi:
39.6: Isikhathi sizafika sibili lapho konke okusesigodlweni sakho lakho konke oyihlo abakugcinayo kusiyafika lolosuku, kuzathwalelwa eBhabhiloni. Akuyikusala lutho, kutsho uThixo.
39.7: Njalo abanye besizukulwane sakho, abenyama legazi lakho, abazazalwa nguwe, bazathathwa bayekuba ngabathenwa esigodlweni senkosi yaseBhabhiloni.”
39.8: UHezekhiya waphendula wathi, “Ilizwi likaThixo olikhulumileyo lilungile.” Ngoba wayenakana esithi, “Kuzakuba lokuthula lokuvikeleka ekuphileni kwami.”

40.12: Ngubani olinganise amanzi entendeni yesandla sakhe,
40.14: Ngubani owake wacelwa nguThixo ukuba ameluleke,
40.20: Umuntu ongumyanga onganelisiyo ukunikela ngomnikelo onjalo
40.22: UThixo uhlezi ebukhosini ngaphezu kwendingiliza yomhlaba,

41.1: “Thulani lithi zwi phambi kwami lina zihlenge!

42.8: Mina nginguThixo, lelo yilo ibizo lami!
42.11: Inkangala lamadolobho ayo kakuphakamise amazwi akho;
42.24: Ngubani owanikela uJakhobe ukuba abe yinto yokuthunjwa
42.25: Ngakho wathela ulaka lwakhe oluvuthayo phezu kwabo,

43.1: Kodwa khathesi, nanku akutshoyo uThixo uthi,
43.4: Njengoba wena uligugu njalo udumile ebusweni bami,

46.5: Ngubani elingangilinganisa laye kumbe limbale njengolingana lami na?

47.4: Umhlengi wethu uThixo uSomandla libizo lakhe

48.9: Ngenxa yebizo lami, ngiyaluphuzisa ulaka lwami;
48.11: Ngenxa yami, ngenxa yami, ngenza lokhu.

49.2: Wenza umlomo wami waba njengenkemba eloliweyo,
49.11: Izintaba zami zonke ngizazenza zibe yizindlela,
49.18: Phakamisa amehlo akho ukhangele emaceleni wonke,
49.26: Ngizakwenza abancindezeli bakho badle inyama yemizimba yabo;

50.11: Kodwa khathesi, lonke lina eliphemba imililo

52.5: Khathesi kuyini engilakho lapha?” kubuza uThixo.
52.6: Ngakho-ke abantu bami bazalazi ibizo lami,
52.8: Lalela! Abalindi bakho baphakamisa amazwi abo,

53.10: Ikanti kwakuyintando kaThixo ukumchoboza lokumenza ahlupheke,

55.11: linjalo lelizwi lami eliphuma emlonyeni wami:

56.5: ngizabanika, phakathi kwethempeli lami lemiduli yalo,

57.6: Izithombe eziphakathi kwamatshe abutshelezi emakhelekehleni yiso isabelo senu,
57.7: Wenze umbheda wakho phezu koqaqa oluphakemeyo,
57.8: Ngemva kwezivalo zakho langemva kwezinsika zomnyango wakho
57.12: Ukulunga kwakho lemisebenzi yakho ngizakuveza obala,

58.10: njalo nxa unika abalambayo ukudla kwakho,
58.13: Nxa ugcina inyawo zakho zingephuli iSabatha,

59.1: Ngeqiniso ingalo kaThixo kayimfitshane ukuba isindise,
59.2: Kodwa ububi benu sebulahlukanise loNkulunkulu wenu;
59.19: Kusukela entshonalanga abantu bazalesaba ibizo likaThixo,
59.21: “Mina lesi yiso isivumelwano sami labo,” kutsho uThixo. “Umoya wami okuwe, lamazwi ami engiwabeke emlonyeni wakho akuyikusuka emlonyeni wakho, kumbe emilonyeni yabantwabakho, loba emilonyeni yezizukulwane zabo kusukela ngalesisikhathi kuze kube nininini,” kutsho uThixo.

60.4: Phakamisa amehlo akho ukhangele amacele akho wonke:
60.12: Ngoba isizwe kumbe umbuso ongayikukukhonza uzatshabalala;
60.21: Lapho-ke bonke abantu bakho bazakuba ngabalungileyo,

62.6: Ngibeke abalindi phezu kwemiduli yakho wena Jerusalema;

63.9: Kukho konke ukuhlupheka kwabo laye waba losizi;
63.11: Lapho-ke abantu bakhe bakhumbula insuku zakudala,
63.17: Kungani, Thixo, usenza siphambuke ezindleleni zakho,

64.1: Awu, sengathi ungaqhekeza amazulu wehlele phansi
64.3: Ngoba wathi usenza izinto ezesabekayo esasingazilindelanga,
64.5: Uyeza ukuba usize labo abenza ukulunga ngokuthaba,
64.11: Ithempeli lethu elingcwele njalo elikhazimulayo lapho okhokho ababekudumisela khona,
64.12: Emva kwakho konke lokhu Thixo, uzazithinta na?

65.7: kokubili izono zenu lezono zabokhokho benu,”

66.8: Ngubani owake wezwa into enje na?
66.14: Lapho libona lokhu, inhliziyo zenu zizathokoza,
66.17: “Labo abazahlukanisayo, bazihlambulule ukungena emasimini belandela lowo ophakathi kwalabo abadla inyama yengulube lamagundwane kanye lezinye izinto ezinengisayo, isiphetho sabo sizafika sikhathi sinye,” kutsho uThixo.
66.18: Ngenxa yezenzo zabo lemicabango yabo, sekuseduze ukuthi ngizebutha izizwe zonke lezindimi zonke; njalo bazakuza babone inkazimulo yami.
66.19: “Ngizabeka isibonakaliso phakathi kwabo, ngithumele abanye balabo abasalayo ezizweni zeThashishi, kumaLibhiya, lamaLudi (alodumo ekusebenziseni imitshoko), eThubhali leGrisi lasezihlengeni ezikhatshana ezingakaluzwa udumo lwami kumbe zibone inkazimulo yami. Bazamemezela udumo lwami phakathi kwezizwe.
66.20: Njalo bazababuyisa bonke abafowenu entabeni yami engcwele eJerusalema njengomnikelo kuThixo bevela ezizweni zonke, bephezu kwamabhiza, izinqola zempi, imbongolo lamakamela,” kutsho uThixo. “Bazababuyisa njengabako-Israyeli beletha iminikelo yabo yamabele ethempelini likaThixo ngezitsha ezihlambulukileyo ngokomkhuba.
66.21: Ngizakhetha abanye babo ukuba labo babe ngabaphristi labaLevi,” kutsho uThixo.
66.22: “Njengamazulu amatsha lomhlaba omutsha engikwenzayo kuzakuma kokuphela phambi kwami,” kutsho uThixo, “ngokunjalo ibizo lakho lenzalo yakho izakuma kokuphela.
66.23: Kusukela ekuThwaseni kwenye iNyanga kusiya ekuthwaseni kwenye, njalo kusukela kwelinye iSabatha kusiya kwelinye abantu bonke bazakuza bakhothame phambi kwami,” kutsho uThixo.
66.24: “Bazaphuma babone izidumbu zabantu abangihlamukelayo; impethu yazo kayiyikufa, lomlilo wazo kawuyikucitshwa, njalo zizakwenyanyeka ebantwini bonke.”

1.1: Umbono Ka-Obhadaya.
1.2: “Khangela, ngizakwenza ube mncinyane phakathi kwezizwe;
1.3: Ukuzigqaja kwenhliziyo yakho sekukukhohlisile,
1.4: Lanxa uqonga njengengqungqulu
1.5: “Nxa amasela efike kuwe,
1.6: Kodwa yeka ukuphangwa okuzakwenziwa u-Esawu,
1.7: Bonke abamanyane lawe bazakuxotshela emngceleni;
1.8: Ngalolosuku,” kutsho uThixo,
1.9: Amabutho akho, wena Themani, azathuthumela,
1.10: Ngenxa yodlakela kumfowenu uJakhobe,
1.11: Ngosuku owema ngalo khatshana
1.12: Akumelanga weyise umfowenu
1.13: Akumelanga ungene ngamasango abantu bami
1.14: Akumelanga ume emahlukanandlela
1.15: Usuku lukaThixo selusondele
1.16: Njengokunatha elakwenzayo entabeni yami,
1.17: Kodwa phezu kweNtaba iZiyoni kuzakuba lokusindiswa;
1.18: Indlu kaJakhobe izakuba ngumlilo
1.19: Abantu abavela eNegebi
1.20: Lelibutho labako-Israyeli abathunjwayo abaseKhenani
1.21: Abakhululi bazakhwela iNtaba iZiyoni

1.1: Ngomnyaka wesithathu wokubusa kukaJehoyakhimi inkosi yakwaJuda, uNebhukhadineza inkosi yaseBhabhiloni wafika eJerusalema walihanqa.
1.2: UThixo wanikela uJehoyakhimi inkosi yakwaJuda ezandleni zakhe, kanye lezinye impahla zethempeli likaNkulunkulu. Konke wakuthwala wakusa ethempelini likankulunkulu wakhe eBhabhiloniya wakufaka endlini yenotho kankulunkulu wakhe.
1.3: Kwathi-ke inkosi yasilaya u-Ashiphenazi, induna yezikhulu zesigodlo sayo ukuthi alethe abanye bama-Israyeli besikhosini lasezikhulwini,
