48.33: Eceleni leningizimu, elizingalo eziyinkulungwane ezine lamakhulu amahlanu (4,500), kuzakuba lamasango amathathu: isango likaSimiyoni, isango lika-Isakhari lesango likaZebhuluni.”
48.34: Eceleni langentshonalanga, elizingalo eziyinkulungwane ezine lamakhulu amahlanu (4,500) ubude, kuzakuba lamasango amathathu: isango likaGadi, isango lika-Asheri lesango likaNafithali.
48.35: “Ubude obubhoda indawo yonke buzakuba zingalo eziyinkulungwane ezilitshumi lasitshiyagalombili (18,000).

1.1: Ilizwi likaThixo lafika kuHosiya indodana kaBheri ngezinsuku zemibuso yabo-Uziya, loJothamu, lo-Ahazi loHezekhiya amakhosi akoJuda, kanye lasezinsukwini zokubusa kukaJerobhowamu indodana kaJowashi inkosi yako-Israyeli.
1.2: Kwathi uThixo eseqalise ukukhuluma ngoHosiya, uThixo wathi kuye, “Hamba uyethatha umfazi oyisifebe ubelabantwana bobufebe, ngoba ilizwe lilecala lobufebe obubi kakhulu ngokweduka kuThixo.”
1.3: Ngakho wathatha uGomeri indodakazi kaDibilayimi, njalo wathatha isisu wamzalela indodana.
1.4: UThixo wasesithi kuHoseya, “Methe ibizo uthi nguJezerili, ngoba masinyane nje ngizayijezisa indlu kaJehu ngenxa yesihluku sokubulala abantu abanengi eJezerili, njalo ngizawuqeda umbuso wako-Israyeli.
1.5: Ngalolosuku ngizakwephula idandili lika-Israyeli eSigodini saseJezerili.”
1.6: UGomeri wathatha isisu futhi, wazala indodakazi. UThixo wasesithi, “Muphe ibizo uthi nguLo-Ruhama, ngoba kangisoze ngibe lothando futhi endlini ka-Israyeli, ukuba ngibathethelele.
1.7: Kodwa ngizakuba lothando endlini kaJuda, njalo ngizabakhulula, kungayisikho ngedandili, inkemba kumbe impi, loba ngamabhiza langabagadi bamabhiza, kodwa ngoThixo uNkulunkulu wabo.”
1.8: UGomeri eselumule uLo-Ruhama ebeleni, waba lenye indodana.
1.9: UThixo wasesithi, “Muphe ibizo lokuthi nguLo-Ami, ngoba lina kalisibo bantu bami, lami kangisuye uNkulunkulu wenu.
1.10: Kodwa abako-Israyeli bazakuba njengetshebetshebe ekhunjini lolwandle elingeke lilinganiswe kumbe libalwe. Endaweni lapho okwakuthiwe khona kubo, ‘Kalisibo bantu bami,’ bazabizwa ngokuthi, ‘bantwana bakaNkulunkulu ophilayo.’
1.11: Abantu bakoJuda labantu bako-Israyeli bazamanyana, njalo bazakhetha umkhokheli oyedwa baphume elizweni, ngoba luzakuba lukhulu usuku lukaJezerili.”

2.1: “Tshono kubafowenu uthi, ‘Bantu bami,’ ngabodadewenu uthi, ‘Bathandekayo bami.’ ”
2.2: “Mkhuze unyoko, mkhuze,
2.3: Funa ngimhlubule abe nqunu,
2.4: Kangiyikubonakalisa uthando lwami ebantwaneni bakhe,
2.5: Unina ubeyisifebe,
2.6: Ngakho-ke indlela yakhe ngizayivala ngamahlahla ameva;
2.7: Uzaxotshana lezithandwa zakhe kodwa angazifici,
2.8: Kavumanga ukuthi yimi engamnika amabele,
2.9: Ngakho-ke ngizawathatha amabele ami lapho esevuthiwe,
2.10: Ngakho khathesi ngizahlazulula ukuxhwala bakhe
2.11: Ngizayiqeda yonke imikhosi yakhe yokuthokoza:
2.12: Ngizatshabalalisa izivini zakhe lezihlahla zakhe zemikhiwa,
2.13: Ngizamjezisela insuku atshisela ngazo
2.14: “Ngakho sengizamhuga;
2.15: Lapho-ke ngizambuyisela izivini zakhe,
2.16: Ngalolosuku,” kutsho uThixo,
2.17: Ngizawasusa amabizo aboBhali ezindebeni zakhe;
2.18: Ngalolosuku ngizabenzela isivumelwano
2.19: Ngizakwendisela kimi kuze kube nininini;
2.20: Ngizakwendisa ngokuthembeka,
2.21: Ngalolosuku ngizasabela,”
2.22: lomhlaba uzasabela emabeleni
2.23: Ngizazihlanyelela yena elizweni;

3.1: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Hamba, utshengisele uthando lwakho kumkakho futhi, lanxa nje ethandwa ngomunye njalo eyisifebekazi. Mthande njengoThixo ethanda abako-Israyeli, lanxa baphendukela kwabanye onkulunkulu njalo bethanda amakhekhe ezithelo ezonyisiweyo.”
3.2: Ngakho ngamthenga ngamashekeli esiliva alitshumi lanhlanu langokwakuphosa kube lihomeri leletheki lebhali.
3.3: Ngasengisithi kuye, “Uzahlala lami insuku ezinengi; akumelanga ube yisifebe loba wembathe lenye indoda, lami ngizahlala lawe.”
3.4: Ngoba abako-Israyeli bazahlala insuku ezinengi bengelankosi kumbe inkosana, bengelamhlatshelo kumbe amatshe angcwele, bengelasembatho semahlombe kumbe isithombe.
3.5: Muva abako-Israyeli bazaphenduka bamdinge uThixo uNkulunkulu wabo kanye loDavida inkosi yabo. Bazakuza kuThixo beqhaqhazela kanye lasezibusisweni zakhe ensukwini zokucina.

4.1: Zwanini ilizwi likaThixo, lina bako-Israyeli
4.2: Kulokuthuka kuphela, lokuqamba amanga lokubulala,
4.3: Ilizwe liyalila ngenxa yalokhu,
4.4: Kodwa akungabi lamuntu omangalayo,
4.5: Liyakhubeka emini lebusuku,
4.6: abantu bami bachithwa yikungabi lolwazi.
4.7: Ngokwanda kwabaphristi,
4.8: Badla izono zabantu bami
4.9: Njalo kuzakuba kanje: Njengabantu, njengabaphristi.
4.10: Bazakudla kodwa bangasuthi;
4.11: ebufebeni,
4.12: Badinga izeluleko esithombeni sesigodo
4.13: Banikela imihlatshelo ezingqongweni zezintaba
4.14: Angiyikuwajezisa amadodakazi enu
4.15: Lanxa ufeba, we Israyeli,
4.16: Abako-Israyeli bayiziqholo,
4.17: U-Efrayimi uhlangene lezithombe;
4.18: Lalapho okunathwayo kwabo sekuphelile,
4.19: Isavunguzane sizabakhukhula,

5.1: “Zwanini lokhu, lina baphristi!
5.2: Abahlamuki batshonile ekubulaleni,
5.3: Mina ngazi konke ngo-Efrayimi;
5.4: Izenzo zabo kazibavumeli
5.5: Ukuzigqaja kuka-Israyeli kufakaza okubi ngaye;
5.6: Lapho behamba lemihlambi yezimvu zabo leyenkomo
5.7: Kabathembekanga kuThixo;
5.8: Khalisani icilongo eGibhiya,
5.9: U-Efrayimi uzachithwa
5.10: Abakhokheli bakoJuda
5.11: U-Efrayimi uncindezelwe,
5.12: Mina nginjengenondo ku-Efrayimi,
5.13: Kwathi u-Efrayimi ebona umkhuhlane wakhe,
5.14: Ngoba ngizakuba njengesilwane ku-Efrayimi,
5.15: Ngizabuyela endaweni yami

6.1: “Wozani sibuyele kuThixo.
6.2: Emva kwensuku ezimbili uzasivuselela;
6.3: Kasimamukeleni uThixo;
6.4: “Ngingenzani ngawe, Efrayimi na?
6.5: Ngakho ngaliqumaquma ngabaphrofethi bami,
6.6: Ngoba mina ngifuna isihawu, hatshi umhlatshelo,
6.7: Njengo-Adamu, sebesephule isivumelwano
6.8: IGiliyadi lidolobho labantu abaxhwalileyo.
6.9: Njengezigebenga zicathamela umuntu,
6.10: Sengibone into etshaqisayo endlini ka-Israyeli.
6.11: Lakuwe futhi Juda,

7.1: Lapho engizakwelapha khona u-Israyeli,
7.2: kodwa kabananzeleli
7.3: Bathokozisa inkosi ngobuxhwali babo,
7.4: Bonke bayizifebe,
7.5: Ngosuku lomkhosi wenkosi yethu
7.6: Inhliziyo zabo zinjengeziko,
7.7: Bonke batshisa njengeziko;
7.8: U-Efrayimi uxubana lezizwe;
7.9: Abezizweni bacikiza amandla akhe,
7.10: Ubuqholo buka-Israyeli bufakaza okubi ngaye,
7.11: U-Efrayimi unjengejuba,
7.12: Lapho sebehamba, ngizaphosa umambule wami phezu kwabo;
7.13: Maye kubo
7.14: Kabakhalazi kimi ngezinhliziyo zabo
7.15: Ngabafundisa ngabaqinisa,
7.16: Kabaphendukeli koPhezukonke

8.1: “Faka icilongo ezindebeni zakho!
8.2: U-Israyeli uyakhalaza kimi esithi,
8.3: Kodwa u-Israyeli ukwalile okuhle;
8.4: Babeka amakhosi kungekho mvumo yami;
8.5: Lahla isithombe sakho sethole, wena Samariya!
8.6: Bavela ko-Israyeli!
8.7: Bahlanyela umoya
8.8: U-Israyeli useginyiwe;
8.9: Ngoba sebeye e-Asiriya
8.10: Lanxa bezithengisile phakathi kwezizwe,
8.11: Lanxa u-Efrayimi wakha ama-alithare amanengi eminikelo yezono,
8.12: Ngabalobela izinto ezinengi zomthetho wami
8.13: Banikela imihlatshelo njengezipho kimi
8.14: U-Israyeli usemkhohliwe uMenzi wakhe

9.1: Ungathokozi, we Israyeli;
9.2: Iziza lezikhamelo zewayini kakuyikunika abantu ukudla;
9.3: Kabayikuhlala elizweni likaThixo;
9.4: Kabayikuthululela iminikelo yewayini kuThixo,
9.5: Lizakwenzani ngosuku lwemikhosi yenu emisiweyo,
9.6: Lanxa bengaphunyuka ekubhujisweni,
9.7: Insuku zokujeziswa ziyeza,
9.8: Umphrofethi, ekanye loNkulunkulu wami,
9.9: Batshone baphelela ekonakaleni,
9.10: “Ekufumaneni kwami u-Israyeli
9.11: Udumo luka-Efrayimi luzaphapha luhambe njengenyoni,
9.12: Loba bangaze bondle abantwana,
9.13: Ngimbonile u-Efrayimi, njengeThire,
9.14: Baphe, Oh Thixo
9.15: “Ngenxa yokuxhwala kwabo konke eGiligali,
9.16: U-Efrayimi udlekile,
9.17: UNkulunkulu wami ubalile

10.1: U-Israyeli wayelivini eliqhelayo,
10.2: Inhliziyo zabo ziyakhohlisa,
10.3: Ngakho bazakuthi, “Thina kasilankosi
10.4: Benza izithembiso ezinengi,
10.5: Abantu abahlala eSamariya bayesaba
10.6: Sizathwalelwa e-Asiriya
10.7: ISamariya lenkosi yakhona kuzabhujiswa
10.8: Izindawo zokukhonzela zobuxhwali zizachithwa,
10.9: “Kusukela ensukwini zaseGibhiya wenze isono, we Israyeli,
10.10: Lapho sengifuna, ngizabajezisa;
10.11: U-Efrayimi ulithokazi elifundisiweyo
10.12: Zihlanyeleleni ukulunga,
10.13: Kodwa lina lihlanyele ukuxhwala,
10.14: ukuhlokoma kwempi kuzakuba khona ebantwini bakini,
10.15: Kuzakwenzakala kanjalo lakuwe, wena Bhetheli,

11.1: “U-Israyeli esesengumntwana, ngangimthanda
11.2: Kodwa kwathi lapho u-Israyeli ngimbiza kanengi
11.3: Yimi engafundisa u-Efrayimi ukuhamba,
11.4: Ngabakhokhela ngentambo zomusa woluntu,
11.5: Kabayikubuyela eGibhithe na,
11.6: Izinkemba zizaphazima emadolobheni abo,
11.7: Abantu bami bazimisele ukungihlamukela.
11.8: Ngingakukhalela kanjani, Efrayimi?
11.9: Kangiyikwenza okwentukuthelo yami eyesabekayo,
11.10: Bazamlandela uThixo;
11.11: Bazakuza bevela eGibhithe
11.12: “U-Efrayimi usengizingeleze ngamanga,

12.1: U-Efrayimi udla umoya;
12.2: Kulecala uThixo azalethesa uJuda;
12.3: Esiswini wabamba isithende sikamfowabo;
12.4: Wabindana lengilosi wayehlula;
12.5: uThixo uNkulunkulu uSomandla,
12.6: Kodwa kumele ubuyele kuNkulunkulu wakho;
12.7: Umthengisi usebenzisa izikali zenkohliso;
12.8: U-Efrayimi uyazincoma esithi,
12.9: “Mina nginguThixo uNkulunkulu wenu
12.10: Ngakhuluma labaphrofethi,
12.11: IGiliyadi ixhwalile na?
12.12: UJakhobe wabalekela elizweni lase-Aramu;
12.13: UThixo wasebenzisa umphrofethi ekukhupheni u-Israyeli eGibhithe;
12.14: Kodwa u-Efrayimi umthukuthelise kabuhlungu;

13.1: Lapho u-Efrayimi ekhuluma, abantu bathuthumela;
13.2: Khathesi benza izono njalonjalo;
13.3: Ngakho bazakuba njengenkungu yekuseni,
13.4: “Kodwa mina nginguThixo uNkulunkulu wenu,
13.5: Ngalilondoloza enkangala,
13.6: Lapho ngibapha ukudla, basutha;
13.7: Ngizakwehlela phezu kwabo njengesilwane,
13.8: Njengebhele elithathelwe imidlwane yalo
13.9: Uchithiwe, wena Israyeli,
13.10: Ingaphi inkosi yakho, ukuba ikusize na?
13.11: Ngakho ngakunika inkosi ngithukuthele,
13.12: Icala lika-Efrayimi ligciniwe,
13.13: Ufikelwa yibuhlungu obunjengowesifazane ehelelwa,
13.14: Ngizabahlenga emandleni engcwaba;
13.15: lanxa ekhula phakathi kwabafowabo.
13.16: Abantu baseSamariya kuzamela balithwale icala labo,

14.1: Buyela, we Israyeli, kuThixo uNkulunkulu wakho.
14.2: Thatha amazwi
14.3: I-Asiriya ayingeke isikhulule;
14.4: “Ngizakwelapha ubuphakaphaka babo
14.5: Ngizakuba njengamazolo ku-Israyeli;
14.6: amahlumela akhe amatsha azakhula.
14.7: Abantu bazahlala njalo emthunzini wakhe.
14.8: Awu Efrayimi, kuyini futhi engingakwenza ngezithombe?
14.9: Ngubani ohlakaniphileyo? Uzazibona lezizinto.

1.1: UJakhobe inceku kaNkulunkulu leyeNkosi uJesu Khristu,
1.2: Bazalwane bami, lapho lisehlelwa yizilingo ezitshiyeneyo, kubaleni njengentokozo epheleleyo
1.3: ngoba liyakwazi ukuthi ukuhlolwa kokholo lwenu kukhulisa ukubekezela.
1.4: Ukubekezela kufanele kuwuqede umsebenzi wakho ukuze lina likhule njalo liphelele, lingasileli ngalutho.
1.5: Nxa omunye wenu eswela ukuhlakanipha kumele acele kuNkulunkulu onika bonke ngesihle engadinganga sici, ngempela uzakuphiwa.
1.6: Kodwa lapho ecela kumele akholwe angathandabuzi ngoba othandabuzayo unjengegagasi lolwandle eliphetshulwa ngumoya uliphose.
1.7: Umuntu lowo akumelanga acabange ukuthi kulolutho azaluthola eNkosini;
1.8: ungumuntu ongqondombili, kazinzanga kukho konke akwenzayo.
1.9: Umzalwane olesimo esiphansi kumele aziqhenye ngesikhundla sakhe esiphezulu.
1.10: Kodwa lowo onothileyo kumele aziqhenye ngesikhundla sakhe esiphansi, ngoba uzadlula njengeluba leganga.
1.11: Ngoba ilanga liphuma litshisa okuhangulayo libunise ihlumela, umqhakazo walo uwohloke lobuhle balo buphele. Ngokufanayo umuntu onothileyo uzanyamalala elokhu esawenza umsebenzi wakhe.
1.12: Ubusisiwe umuntu oqiniselayo ekulingweni, ngoba lapho esephumelele ekuhlolweni, uzaphiwa umqhele wokuphila, ukuphila uNkulunkulu akuthembisa labo abamthandayo.
1.13: Ekulingweni, kakho okumele athi, “UNkulunkulu uyangilinga.” Ngoba uNkulunkulu angeke alingwe yibubi, futhi kalingi muntu;
1.14: kodwa lowo lalowo ulingwa yinkanuko yakhe embi, lapho edonselwa kude ehugwa.
1.15: Ngakho-ke, nxa inkanuko isidaliwe izala isono; njalo isono lapho sesikhulile okugcweleyo, sizala ukufa.
1.16: Lingakhohliswa bazalwane bami abathandekayo.
1.17: Zonke izipho ezinhle lezipheleleyo zivela phezulu, zehlele phansi zivela kuYise wezibane zasezulwini, ongaguqukiyo njalo ongelathunzi lokuphenduka.
1.18: Wakhetha ukusizala ngelizwi leqiniso ukuze sibe luhlobo lwezithelo zakuqala kukho konke akudalayo.
1.19: Bazalwane bami abathandekayo, qaphelani lokhu: Umuntu wonke kumele aphange alalele, aphuze ukukhuluma, njalo aphuze lokuthukuthela
1.20: ngoba ukuthukuthela komuntu kakulethi ukuphila okulungileyo okufiswa nguNkulunkulu.
1.21: Ngakho-ke, lahlani amanyala wonke lobubi obande kangaka, lilamukele ngokuthobeka ilizwi elahlanyelwa kini, elingalisindisa.
1.22: Lingalaleli ilizwi nje kuphela, beselizikhohlisa ngalokho. Yenzani lokho elikutshoyo.
1.23: Loba ngubani olalela ilizwi kodwa angaze enza elikutshoyo unjengomuntu okhangela ubuso bakhe esibukweni
1.24: kuthi esezibukile asuke ahle akhohlwe ukuthi unjani.
1.25: Kodwa umuntu owukhangela ngenjongo umthetho opheleleyo oletha ukukhululeka, njalo aqhubeke esenza lokhu engakhohlwa asekuzwile, kodwa ekwenza, uzabusiswa kulokho akwenzayo.
1.26: Nxa umuntu ecabanga ukuthi uyakholwa kodwa engabambi ulimi lwakhe okuqinileyo, uyazikhohlisa njalo lokholo lwakhe luyize.
1.27: Ukukholwa okwamukelwa nguNkulunkulu uBaba okuhlambulukileyo njalo kungelasici yilokhu: ukugcina izintandane labafelokazi ekuhluphekeni kwabo, kanye lokuzigcina thina ngokwethu ekungcolisweni ngumhlaba.

2.1: Bazalwane bami, njengabakholwayo eNkosini yethu elenkazimulo uJesu Khristu, lingabandlululi.
2.2: Kasithi umuntu ufika emhlanganweni wenu egqize indandatho yegolide, egqoke lezigqoko ezinhle, besekungena umyanga egqoke izigqoko ezinithizelayo.
2.3: Nxa limnaka kakhulu lowo ogqoke izigqoko ezinhle lithi kuye, “Nansi isihlalo esingcono,” kodwa kongumyanga lithi, “Wena mana laphayana,” kumbe lithi, “Hlala phansi eduze kwezinyawo zami,”
2.4: Kambe kalibandlululanga njalo laba ngabahluleli abalemicabango emibi na?
2.5: Lalelani, bazalwane bami abathandekayo: Kanti uNkulunkulu kabakhethanga yini labo abangabayanga emehlweni omhlaba ukuba babengabanothileyo ekukholweni kanye lokudla ilifa lombuso awuthembisa labo abamthandayo na?
2.6: Kodwa lina libathukile abayanga. Abanothileyo akusibo yini abadinga inzuzo ngani? Akusibo yini abalihudulela emithethwandaba?
2.7: Akusibo yini abahlambaza ibizo lobukhosi elalowo lina elingabakhe na?
2.8: Nxa liwugcina sibili umthetho wobukhosi otholakala eMbhalweni othi, “Thanda umakhelwane wakho njengalokhu uzithanda,”2.8 ULevi 19.18 lenza okulungileyo.
2.9: Kodwa nxa libandlulula lenza isono njalo lilahlwa ngumthetho njengabephuli bomthetho.
2.10: Ngoba loba ngubani ogcina umthetho wonke, kodwa akhubeke endaweni eyodwa, ulecala lokuwephula wonke.
2.11: Ngoba yena owathi, “Ungafebi,”2.11 U-Eksodasi 20.14; UDutheronomi 5.18 wathi futhi, “Ungabulali.”2.11 U-Eksodasi 20.13; UDutheronomi 5.17 Nxa ungafebi, kodwa ubulala, usube yisaphulamthetho.
2.12: Khulumani njalo lenze njengalabo abazakwahlulelwa ngumthetho onika ukukhululeka,
2.13: ngoba ukwahlulela okungelasihawu kuzakuba kulowo obengelasihawu. Isihawu sinqoba ukwahlulela!
2.14: Kusizani bazalwane bami, nxa umuntu esithi ulokholo kodwa engelazenzo? Ukholo olunjalo lungamsindisa na?
2.15: Kasithi umfowenu loba udadewenu kalazigqoko lokudla kwansukuzonke.
2.16: Nxa omunye wenu esithi kuye, “Hamba, ngikufisela okuhle; hlala ufudumala njalo usutha,” kodwa angenzi lutho ngalezi zinswelo zakhe zomzimba, kusizani na?
2.17: Ngokunjalo, ukukholwa nje kuphela, nxa kungelamisebenzi kufile.
2.18: Kodwa omunye uzakuthi, “Wena ulokukholwa; mina ngilezenzo.”
2.19: Uyakholwa ukuthi kuloNkulunkulu oyedwa. Kulungile! Lamadimoni ayakukholwa lokhu njalo ayathuthumela.
2.20: Wena ndoda eyisiwula, ufuna ubufakazi bokuthi ukukholwa okungelamisebenzi kuyize na?
2.21: Kanje ukhokho wethu u-Abhrahama kabalwanga njengolungileyo ngenxa yalokhu akwenzayo lapho anikela indodana yakhe u-Isaka e-alithareni na?
2.22: Liyabona ukuthi ukukholwa kwakhe lezenzo zakhe kwakusebenza ndawonye, njalo ukukholwa kwakhe kwapheleliswa yilokho akwenzayo.
2.23: Njalo umbhalo wagcwaliseka othi, “U-Abhrahama wakholwa uNkulunkulu, njalo kwabalwa kuye njengokulunga,”2.23 UGenesisi 15.6 njalo wabizwa ngokuthi ngumngane kaNkulunkulu.
2.24: Liyabona ukuthi umuntu ulungiswa yilokho akwenzayo hatshi ngokukholwa kuphela.
2.25: Ngokunjalo, loRahabi isifebe konje kabalwanga njengolungileyo ngalokho akwenzayo lapho anika inhloli indawo yokulala wabuya wazikhupha ngenye indlela na?
2.26: Njengoba umzimba ongelamoya ufile, ngokunjalo ukukholwa okungelamisebenzi kufile.

3.1: Bazalwane bami, abanengi benu akumelanga babe ngabafundisi ngoba liyakwazi ukuthi thina esifundisayo sizakwahlulelwa kalukhunikazi.
3.2: Sonke siyakhubeka ngezindlela ezinengi. Nxa umuntu engakaze abelesici kulokho akutshoyo, ungumuntu opheleleyo, oyenelisayo ukuwubamba wonke umzimba wakhe.
3.3: Lapho sifaka amatomu emilonyeni yamabhiza ukuba asilalele, ibhiza singaliphendula lonke.
3.4: Kumbe lithathe imikhumbi njengesibonelo. Lanxa imikhulu kangaka njalo iqhutshwa ngumoya olamandla, iqondiswa ngophinyana oluncane loba kungaphi lapho umtshayeli afuna ukuya khona.
3.5: Ngokufanayo ulimi luyisitho esincane somzimba kodwa luyazincoma kakhulu. Cabangani ngehlathi elikhulu elithungelwa yinhlansi encane yomlilo.
3.6: Ulimi lalo lungumlilo, umhlaba wobubi phakathi kwezitho zomzimba. Lungcolisa lonke uqobo lomuntu, luyithungele ngomlilo yonke impilo yakhe, lalo luthungelwe yisihogo somlilo.
3.7: Zonke inhlobo zezinyamazana, izinyoni, lezihuquzelayo kanye lezidalwa zasolwandle ziyathanjiswa njalo sezathanjiswa ngumuntu,
3.8: kodwa akulamuntu ongathambisa ulimi, luyibubi obuyaluzelayo, lugcwele itshefu ebulalayo.
3.9: Ngolimi siyayibonga iNkosi uBaba, njalo ngalo sithuka abantu abenziwa ngomfanekiso kaNkulunkulu.
3.10: Emlonyeni munye kuphuma ukubonga lokuthuka. Bazalwane bami, lokhu akufanelanga.
3.11: Kambe amanzi amnandi lamanzi aletswayi angagobhoza mthombo munye na?
3.12: Bazalwane bami, umkhiwa ungathela ama-oliva na, kumbe ivini lithele imikhiwa na? Lomthombo oletswayi awungeke ukhuphe amanzi amnandi.
3.13: Ngubani ohlakaniphileyo loqedisisayo phakathi kwenu na? Kakubonakalise ngokuphila kwakhe kuhle, langezenzo ezenziwa ngokuzithoba okuvela ekuhlakanipheni.
3.14: Kodwa nxa ligcine umhawu lokulangazela kobukhwele ezinhliziyweni zenu, lingazincomi ngakho kumbe liphike iqiniso.
3.15: “Ukuhlakanipha” okunjalo kakwehli kuvela ezulwini, kodwa ngokwasemhlabeni, akusikomoya, ngokwamadimoni.
3.16: Ngoba lapho okulomhawu khona lokutshisekela kokuzisuthisa kulapho okutholakala khona ingxabangxoza kanye lezenzo zonke ezimbi.
3.17: Kodwa ukuhlakanipha okuvela ezulwini kuqala ngokuhlambuluka; besekuthanda ukuthula, kulozwelo, kuyazehlisa, kugcwele isihawu lezithelo ezinhle, kakukhethi njalo kuqotho.
3.18: Abalamuli abahlanyela ukuthula bathola isivuno sokulunga.

4.1: Kuyini okubangela ukulwa lengxabano phakathi kwenu na? Kakuveli ezinkanukweni zenu ezilwayo phakathi kwenu na?
4.2: Lifuna ulutho oluthile, kodwa kalilutholi. Liyabulala njalo lihawukele kodwa kalingeke likuthole lokho elikufunayo. Liyaxabana lilwe. Kalilalutho ngoba kaliceli kuNkulunkulu.
4.3: Lapho licela, kaliphiwa ngoba licela ngenjongo embi, ukuba lichithe lokho elikuzuzayo enjabulweni yenu.
4.4: Lina zifebe zabantu, kalikwazi yini ukuthi ubungane lomhlaba kuyikuzonda uNkulunkulu na? Umuntu okhetha ukuba ngumngane womhlaba uba yisitha sikaNkulunkulu.
4.5: Kumbe licabanga ukuthi umbhalo utsho kungelasizatho ukuthi umoya awenza ukuba uhlale phakathi kwethu ugebela ebukhweleni?
4.6: Kodwa yena usinika umusa owengeziweyo. Yikho-nje umbhalo usithi:
4.7: Ngakho-ke, zehliseni kuNkulunkulu. Menqabeleni uSathane, uzalibalekela.
4.8: Sondelani phansi kukaNkulunkulu laye uzasondela kini. Gezani izandla zenu lina zoni, lihlambulule lezinhliziyo zenu, lina abangqondombili.
4.9: Dabukani, lilile, likhale. Guqulani ukuhleka kwenu kube yikukhala, kuthi ukuthokoza kwenu kube yikudana.
4.10: Zithobeni phambi kweNkosi, izaliphakamisa.
4.11: Bazalwane, lingachothozani. Umuntu okhuluma kubi ngomzalwane wakhe, loba amahlulele, ukhuluma kubi ngomthetho awahlulele. Lapho lisahlulela umthetho, kaliwugcini kodwa liyawahlulela.
4.12: KuloMenzi wemithetho loMahluleli oyedwa kuphela, lowo olamandla okusindisa lokubhubhisa. Kodwa lina lingobani ukuba lahlulele omakhelwane benu na?
4.13: Lalelani lina elithi, “Lamhla loba kusasa sizakuya kuleli loba kuleliyana idolobho, siqede umnyaka khona, senze imisebenzi sizuze imali.”
4.14: Kungani ngoba phela kalikwazi okuzakwenzakala kusasa. Ukuphila kwenu kuyini na? Liyinkungu ebonakala okwesikhatshana ibe isinyamalala.
4.15: Kodwa kumele lithi, “Nxa kuyintando yeNkosi sizaphila senze lokhu loba lokhuyana.”
4.16: Okwakhathesi liyazincoma lizikhukhumeza. Konke ukuzincoma okunje kubi.
4.17: Ngakho-ke, loba ngubani okwaziyo okulungileyo okumele akwenze kodwa angakwenzi, wenza isono.

5.1: Lalelani lina bantu abanothileyo, khalani lilile ngenxa yosizi oluzayo phezu kwenu.
5.2: Inotho yenu isibolile, lezigqoko zenu sezidliwe linondo.
5.3: Isiliva legolide lenu sekuthombile. Ukuthomba kwakho kuzafakaza kubi ngani, kudle inyama yemizimba yenu njengomlilo. Libuthelele inotho ensukwini zokucina.
5.4: Khangelani! Imiholo elingayibhadalanga izisebenzi ezavuna amasimu enu iyalikhalela. Ukukhala kwabavuni sekufikile ezindlebeni zeNkosi uSomandla.
5.5: Emhlabeni lihlale ngentokozo langokuminza. Selikhuluphele ngenxa yokuhlaba imihla ngemihla.
5.6: Libagwebile lababulala abantu abamsulwa, ababengamelani lani.
5.7: Ngakho, bazalwane, bekezelani iNkosi ize ifike. Khangelani ukuthi umlimi uyilindela njani insimu ukuba ithele izilimo zayo eziligugu kanye lokuthi ukubekezelela njani ukuna kwezulu lentwasa.
5.8: Lani futhi, bekezelani liqine ngoba ukufika kweNkosi sekusondele.
5.9: Lingasolani bazalwane hlezi lahlulelwe. UMahluleli umi emnyango!
5.10: Bazalwane, njengesibonelo sokubekezela ekuhluphekeni, khumbulani abaphrofethi abakhuluma ngebizo leNkosi.
5.11: Njengoba lisazi, labo ababekezelayo sibabala njengababusisiweyo. Selezwa ngokubekezela kukaJobe njalo selikubonile okwalethwa yiNkosi ekucineni. INkosi igcwele isihawu esikhulu lomusa.
5.12: Phezu kwakho konke, bazalwane bami, lingafungi, kungaba ngezulu loba ngomhlaba kumbe ngolunye ulutho. “U-Yebo” wenu kabe nguyebo, lo “Hatshi” wenu abenguhatshi, hlezi lilahlwe.
5.13: Ukhona phakathi kwenu ohluphekayo na? Kakhuleke. Ukhona othokozayo na? Kahlabele izingoma zokudumisa.
5.14: Ukhona kini ogulayo na? Kumele abize abadala bebandla bamkhulekele njalo bamgcobe ngamafutha ebizweni leNkosi.
5.15: Umkhuleko owenziwe ngokukholwa uzakwenza lowomuntu ogulayo asile; iNkosi izamvusa. Nxa enze isono, uzathethelelwa.
5.16: Ngakho-ke, vumani izono zenu omunye komunye njalo likhulekelane ukuze lisiliswe. Umkhuleko womuntu olungileyo ulamandla njalo uyasebenza.
5.17: U-Elija wayengumuntu njengathi. Wakhuleka ngokutshiseka ukuba izulu lingani, lakanye kalinanga elizweni iminyaka emithathu lengxenye.
5.18: Wakhuleka futhi, amazulu aletha izulu, kwathi umhlaba lawo wathela izilimo zawo.
5.19: Bazalwane bami, nxa omunye wenu ephambuka eqinisweni, omunye ambuyisele,
5.20: khumbulani lokhu: Lowo onqanda isoni ekoneni kwaso uzasisindisa ekufeni, agubuzele izono ezinengi.

1.1: La ngamazwi kaJeremiya indodana kaHilikhiya, omunye wabaphristi base-Anathothi elizweni lakoBhenjamini.
1.2: Ilizwi likaThixo lafika kuye ngomnyaka wetshumi lantathu ekubuseni kukaJosiya indodana ka-Amoni inkosi yakoJuda,
1.3: njalo ekubuseni kukaJehoyakhimi indodana kaJosiya inkosi yakoJuda, kwaze kwaba yinyanga yesihlanu emnyakeni wetshumi lanye kaZedekhiya indodana kaJosiya inkosi yakoJuda, ngesikhathi sokuthunjwa kwabantu baseJerusalema.
1.4: Ilizwi likaThixo lafika kimi lisithi,
1.5: “Ngingakakubumbi esiswini ngakwazi,
1.6: Mina ngathi, “Awu Thixo Somandla; ukukhuluma angikwazi, ngoba ngingumntwana nje.”
1.7: Kodwa uThixo wathi kimi, “Ungaze wathi, ‘Ngingumntwana nje.’ Kumele uye kubo bonke engikuthuma kubo njalo utsho loba kuyini engikulaya khona.
1.8: Ungabesabi, ngoba mina ngilawe njalo ngizakuhlenga,” kutsho uThixo.
1.9: UThixo waseselula isandla sakhe wathinta umlomo wami wathi kimi, “Khathesi, sengifake amazwi ami emlonyeni wakho.
1.10: Khangela, lamhla ngikubeka phezu kwezizwe lemibuso ukuba usiphune udilize, ubhubhise njalo uchithe; ukuba wakhe njalo uhlanyele.”
1.11: Ilizwi likaThixo lafika kimi lathi, “Kuyini okubonayo, Jeremiya?”
1.12: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Ubone kuhle, ngoba ngilindele ukubona ukuthi ilizwi lami ligcwalisekile.”
1.13: Ilizwi likaThixo lafika kimi futhi: “Kuyini okubonayo?”
1.14: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Incithakalo evela enyakatho izakwehliselwa phezu kwabo bonke abahlala elizweni.
1.15: Sekuseduze ukuba ngibize bonke abantu bemibuso yasenyakatho,” kutsho uThixo.
1.16: Ngizamemezela ukwahlulela kwami ebantwini bami
1.17: Wena zilungiselele! Sukuma ubatshele lokho engizakulaya khona. Ungathuthumeliswa yibo hlezi ngikwenze uthuthumele phambi kwabo.
1.18: Lamhla sengikwenze waba lidolobho elivikelweyo, insika yensimbi lomduli wethusi ukuba umelane lelizwe lonke, umelane lamakhosi akoJuda, izikhulu zakhona, abaphristi bakhona kanye labantu bakhona.
1.19: Bazakulwa lawe, kodwa kabayikukwehlula, ngoba ngilawe njalo ngizakuhlenga,” kutsho uThixo.

2.1: Ilizwi likaThixo lafika kimi lisithi,
2.2: “Hamba umemezele iJerusalema lisizwa uthi:
2.3: U-Israyeli wayengcwele kuThixo,
2.4: Zwana ilizwi likaThixo, we ndlu kaJakhobe,
2.5: UThixo uthi:
2.6: Kababuzanga ukuthi, ‘Ungaphi uThixo,
2.7: Ngaliletha elizweni elivundileyo
2.8: Abaphristi kababuzanga ukuthi,
2.9: Ngakho-ke ngilethesa amacala futhi,”
2.10: Welani liye ngasemakhunjini aseKhithimi likhangele,
2.11: Isizwe sake santshintsha onkulunkulu baso na?
2.12: Mangalani lokhu, lina mazulu,
2.13: “Abantu bami benze izono ezimbili:
2.14: Kambe u-Israyeli yisisebenzi, isigqili ngokuzalwa na?
2.15: Izilwane zibhongile;
2.16: Njalo, labantu baseMemfisi leThahiphanesi
2.17: Lokhu kawukwehliselanga phezu kwakho
2.18: Khathesi kungani usiya eGibhithe
2.19: Ububi bakho buzakujezisa;
2.20: “Endulo wephula ijogwe lakho,
2.21: Ngikuhlanyele njengevini elikhethiweyo
2.22: Lanxa ugeza ngesepa
2.23: “Ungatsho kanjani na uthi, ‘Kangingcolanga,
2.24: ubabhemi weganga ojwayele inkangala,
2.25: Ungagijimi inyawo zakho zize zihlubuke
2.26: Njengokuyangeka kwesela nxa selibanjiwe,

3.1: “Indoda ingehlukana lomkayo
3.2: “Khangela emiqolweni elugwadule ubone.
3.3: Ngalokho imikhizo imisiwe,
3.4: Kawungibizanga khathesi nje wathi,
3.5: uzahlala uzondile kokuphela na?
3.6: Ekubuseni kwenkosi uJosiya, uThixo wathi kimi, “Ukubonile yini okwenziwe ngu-Israyeli ongathembekanga? Usekhwele phezu kwamaqaqa wonke aphakemeyo langaphansi kwezihlahla zonke eziluhlaza wafebela khona.
3.7: Ngacabanga ukuthi emva kokuba esenze konke lokhu uzaphinda eze kimi, kodwa kabuyanga, lodadewabo ongathembekanga uJuda wakubona lokho.
3.8: U-Israyeli ongathembekanga ngamnika incwadi yakhe yesehlukaniso ngamxotsha ngenxa yobufebe bakhe bonke. Kodwa ngabona ukuthi udadewabo ongathembekanga, uJuda, kesabanga, laye wasuka wayafeba.
3.9: Ngenxa yokuthi ububi buka-Israyeli babungatsho lutho kuye, wangcolisa ilizwe wakhonza amatshe lezihlahla.
3.10: Kukho konke lokhu, udadewabo ongathembekanga uJuda kabuyelanga kimi ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke, kodwa ngokuzenzisa nje kuphela,” kutsho uThixo.
3.11: UThixo wathi kimi, “U-Israyeli ongathembekanga ungcono kuloJuda ongelaqiniso.
3.12: Hamba, uyememezela ilizwi leli ngasenyakatho:
3.13: Vuma icala lakho nje kuphela,
3.14: “Phendukani, bantu abangathembekanga,” kutsho uThixo, “ngoba ngingumyeni wenu. Ngizalikhetha, oyedwa edolobheni lababili emulini ngililethe eZiyoni.
3.15: Lapho-ke ngizalinika abelusi abathandwa yimi, abazalikhokhela ngokwazi langokuqedisisa.
3.16: Ngalezonsuku, ubunengi benu sebande kakhulu elizweni,” kutsho uThixo, “abantu kabasayikuthi, ‘Ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaThixo.’ Kaliyikufika emicabangweni yabo kumbe likhunjulwe; kaliyikudingakala, njalo akuyikwenziwa elinye futhi.
3.17: Ngalesosikhathi iJerusalema bazalibiza ngokuthi yisiHlalo Sobukhosi sikaThixo, njalo izizwe zonke zizabuthana eJerusalema ukuba zihloniphe ibizo likaThixo. Kabasayikulandela inkani yezinhliziyo zabo ezimbi.
3.18: Ngalezonsuku indlu kaJuda izahlangana leka-Israyeli, njalo ndawonye, zivela elizweni elisenyakatho, zizakuza elizweni engalinika okhokho benu ukuba libe yilifa labo.
3.19: Mina ngokwami ngathi,
3.20: Kodwa njengowesifazane ongathembekanga kumkakhe,
3.21: Ilizwi liyezwakala emiqolweni elugwadule,
3.22: “Phendukani, bantu abangathembekanga,
3.23: Impela umsindo wokukhonza izithombe emaqaqeni
3.24: Kusukela ebutsheni bethu onkulunkulu abalihlazo
3.25: Kasilaleni phansi silenhloni,

4.1: “Nxa uphenduka, wena Israyeli, buyela kimi,”
4.2: njalo nxa uzafunga ngobuqotho,
4.3: Ebantwini bakoJuda labeJerusalema uThixo uthi:
4.4: Zisokeleni kuThixo,
4.5: “Bikani koJuda limemezele laseJerusalema lithi:
4.6: Phakamisani uphawu lokuya eZiyoni!
4.7: Isilwane sesiphumile esikhundleni saso,
4.8: Ngakho gqokani amasaka,
4.9: UThixo uthi,
4.10: Lapho-ke mina ngathi, “Awu, Thixo Wobukhosi, ubakhohlisile sibili abantu laba kanye leJerusalema ngokuthi, ‘Lizakuba lokuthula,’ inkemba yona isemiphinjeni yethu!”
4.11: Ngalesosikhathi abantu laba leJerusalema kuzathiwa kubo, “Umoya otshisayo ovela enkangala emiqolweni elugwadule uvunguza usiya ebantwini bami, kodwa kungayisikwela kumbe ukuhlungula,
4.12: umoya olamandla kakhulu uvela kimi. Khathesi-ke sengimemezela ukwahlulela kwami kubo.”
4.13: Khangela! Uyeza njengamayezi,
4.14: We Jerusalema, geza ububi obusenhliziyweni yakho usindiswe.
4.15: Ilizwi elivela koDani liyamemeza,
4.16: Izizwe zitshele lokhu,
4.17: Balihanqile njengabantu abalinda insimu,
4.18: “Ukuziphatha kwakho lezenzo zakho
4.19: Maye, ngobuhlungu, ubuhlungu engibuzwayo.
4.20: Incithakalo ilandela incithakalo,
4.21: Koze kube nini ngibona uphawu lwempi
4.22: “Abantu bami bayiziwula,
4.23: Ngakhangela umhlaba,
4.24: Ngakhangela ezintabeni,

5.1: “Yehla ukhwele ngemigwaqo yaseJerusalema,
5.2: Lanxa nje besithi, ‘Ngeqiniso elinjengoba uThixo ekhona,’
5.3: Awu Thixo, amehlo akho kawadingi qiniso na?
5.4: Ngacabanga ngathi, “Laba ngabayanga nje,
5.5: Ngakho-ke ngizakuya kubakhokheli
5.6: Ngakho isilwane esivela ehlathini sizabahlasela,
5.7: “Ngingalithethelela ngenxa yani na?
5.8: Bangamabhiza amaduna asuthayo, agcwele inkanuko,
5.9: Ngingabajezisi kulokhu na?”
5.10: Ngenani lidabule phakathi kwezivini zaso lizidlwengule,
5.11: Indlu ka-Israyeli lendlu kaJuda
5.12: Baqambe amanga ngoThixo
5.13: Abaphrofethi bangumoya nje,
5.14: Ngakho-ke uThixo uNkulunkulu uSomandla uthi:
5.15: UThixo uthi, “Wena ndlu ka-Israyeli,
5.16: Imixhaka yaso ifana lengcwaba elivulekileyo,
5.17: Bazatshwabadela amabele enu lokudla kwenu,
5.18: Ikanti langalezozinsuku,” kutsho uThixo, “angiyikuliqeda du.
5.19: Lapho abantu bebuza besithi, ‘Kungani uThixo uNkulunkulu wethu enze konke lokhu kithi?’ Batshele uthi, ‘Njengoba lingilahlile lakhonza onkulunkulu bezizweni elizweni lenu, ngokunjalo khathesi lizasebenzela abezizweni elizweni elingayisilo lenu.’
5.20: Memezela lokhu endlini kaJakhobe
5.21: Zwanini lokhu, lina zithutha zabantu abangelangqondo,
5.22: Akumelanga lingesabe na?”
5.23: Kodwa abantu laba balezinhliziyo ezilukhuni ezihlamukayo,
5.24: Kabatsho ezinhliziyweni zabo ukuthi,
5.25: Ukona kwenu kukuvimbele lokhu,

6.1: “Balekani ukuze liphephe, bantu bakoBhenjamini!
6.2: Indodakazi yaseZiyoni
6.3: Abelusi lemihlambi yabo bazakuza bamelane layo;
6.4: “Lungelani ukulwa layo!
6.5: Ngakho vukani, kasihlaseleni ebusuku
6.6: UThixo uSomandla uthi:
6.7: Njengomthombo ugobhoza amanzi awo,
6.8: Xwayiseka, we Jerusalema,
6.9: UThixo uSomandla uthi:
6.10: Ngubani engingakhuluma laye ngimxwayise na?
6.11: Kodwa mina ngiyafuthelana ngolaka lukaThixo,
6.12: Izindlu zabo zizanikwa abanye,
6.13: “Kusukela kwabancane kusiya kwabakhulu,
6.14: Babopha inxeba labantu bami
6.15: Bayayangeka na ngokuziphatha kwabo okwenyanyekayo?
6.16: UThixo, uthi:
6.17: Ngalibekela abantu bokulilinda ngathi,
6.18: Ngakho zwanini, lina zizwe,
6.19: Zwana, wena mhlaba,
6.20: Ngilani lempepha yaseShebha
6.21: Ngakho uThixo uthi:
6.22: UThixo uthi:
6.23: Bahlome ngamadandili langemikhonto,

7.1: Leli yilizwi elafika kuJeremiya livela kuThixo lisithi:
7.2: “Mana esangweni lendlu kaThixo umemezele ilizwi leli ukhonapho uthi:
7.3: UThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli uthi: Lungisani izindlela zenu lezenzo zenu, ukuze ngilivumele ukuba lihlale kule indawo.
7.4: Lingathembi amazwi akhohlisayo lithi, “Leli lithempeli likaThixo, ithempeli likaThixo, ithempeli likaThixo!”
7.5: Lingalungisa izindlela zenu lezenzo zenu sibili liphathane ngokulunga,
7.6: nxa lingancindezeli owezizweni, izintandane loba umfelokazi njalo lingachithi gazi elingelacala kule indawo, njalo nxa lingalandeli abanye onkulunkulu okuzalilimaza,
7.7: ngizalivumela ukuba lihlale kule indawo, elizweni engalinika okhokho benu ukuba libe ngelabo kuze kube nini lanini.
7.8: Kodwa khangelani, lina lithemba amazwi akhohlisayo angasizi lutho.
7.9: Kambe lizantshontsha njalo libulale, lifebe, lifunge amanga, litshisele uBhali impepha njalo lilandele abanye onkulunkulu elingakaze libazi,
7.10: beselisizakuma phambi kwami kuyonale indlu, eleBizo lami, lithi, “Sivikelekile,” livikeleka ukuba lenze zonke lezizinto ezenyanyekayo na?
7.11: Indlu le, eleBizo lami, seyaba lubhalu lwabaphangi na? Kodwa kade ngikhangele! kutsho uThixo.
7.12: Hambani khathesi endaweni yami eShilo lapho engenza khona kuqala indawo yokuhlala iBizo lami, libone engakwenza kuyo ngenxa yobubi babantu bami bako-Israyeli.
7.13: UThixo uthi, kwathi lapho lisenza lezizinto, mina ngakhuluma lani futhifuthi, kodwa kalingilalelanga, ngalibiza, kalaze lasabela.
7.14: Ngakho-ke, lokho engakwenza eShilo khathesi ngizakwenza kule indlu eleBizo lami, ithempeli elilithembileyo, indawo engalinika yona lina kanye labokhokho benu.
7.15: Ngizalixotsha phambi kwami, njengalokho engakwenza abafowenu bonke, abantu bako-Efrayimi.’
7.16: Ngakho abantu laba ungabakhulekeli loba ubakhulumele kumbe ubenzele isicelo; ungangincengi ngoba angiyikukulalela.
7.17: Abakwenzayo emadolobheni akoJuda lasemigwaqweni yaseJerusalema kawukuboni na?
7.18: Abantwana batheza inkuni, oyise babasa imililo, labesifazane baxova inhlama benzele iNdlovukazi yaseZulwini isinkwa. Bathelela abanye onkulunkulu iminikelo yokunathwayo ukuba bangithukuthelise.
7.19: Kodwa yimi abangithukuthelisayo na? kutsho uThixo. Kabazilimazi bona ngokwabo na, okulihlazo kubo?
7.20: ‘Ngakho uThixo Wobukhosi uthi: Ukuthukuthela kwami lolaka lwami kuzakwehliselwa kule indawo, phezu kwabantu lasezinyamazaneni, phezu kwezihlahla zeganga laphezu kwezithelo zomhlabathi; njalo kuzakutsha kungacitsheki.
7.21: UThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli uthi: Qhubekani, fakani iminikelo yenu yokutshiswa kweminye imihlatshelo yenu lidle inyama lina ngokwenu!
7.22: Ngoba ekukhupheni kwami okhokho benu eGibhithe ngikhuluma labo, angizange ngibanike imilayo nje kuphela ngeminikelo yokutshiswa lemihlatshelo,
7.23: kodwa ngabanika umlayo lo othi: Ngilalelani, njalo ngizakuba nguNkulunkulu wenu lina libe ngabantu bami. Hambani ngezindlela zonke engililaye zona, ukuze kulilungele.
7.24: Kodwa kabazange balalele kumbe banake; esikhundleni salokho, bona balandela inkani yentando yezinhliziyo zabo ezimbi. Baya emuva hatshi phambili.
7.25: Kusukela ngesikhathi okhokho benu besuka eGibhithe kuze kube khathesi, usuku ngosuku, njalonjalo ngalithumela izinceku zami abaphrofethi.
7.26: Kodwa kabangilalelanga kumbe banake. Babelentamo ezilukhuni njalo benza ububi obudlula obabokhokho babo.’
7.27: Lapho ubatshela konke lokhu, kabayikukulalela; lalapho ubabiza, kabayikusabela.
7.28: Ngakho batshele uthi, ‘Lesi yisizwe esingalalelanga uThixo uNkulunkulu waso kumbe sivume ukuqondiswa. Iqiniso selifile; kalisekho ezindebeni zabo.
7.29: Gelani inwele zenu lizilahlele khatshana; lenze isililo emiqolweni elugwadule, ngoba uThixo usesalile wasidela isizukulwane lesi esingaphanasi kolaka lwakhe.’ ”
7.30: “ ‘Abantu bakoJuda benze ububi phambi kwami, kutsho uThixo. Bamise izithombe zabo ezenyanyekayo endlini eleBizo lami balingcolisa.
7.31: Sebakhe izindawo eziphakemeyo zaseThofethi esigodini saseBheni-Hinomu ukuba batshisele khona amadodana lamadodakazi abo ngomlilo, into engingabalayanga yona, engazange ifike engqondweni yami.
7.32: Ngakho qaphelani, insuku ziyeza, kutsho uThixo, lapho abantu bengayikuyithi yiThofethi kumbe iSigodi saseBheni-Hinomu, kodwa iSigodi sokuBulala, ngoba abafileyo bazabangcwaba eThofethi kuze kusweleke indawo.
7.33: Lapho-ke izidumbu zabantu laba zizakuba yikudla kwezinyoni zasemoyeni lezinyamazana zomhlaba, njalo akuyikuba lomuntu ozazethusa.
7.34: Ngizaqeda imisindo yokuthokoza leyenjabulo emadolobheni akoJuda lasemigwaqweni yaseJerusalema, lokuthaba lelizwi lomlobokazi lelomyeni, ngoba ilizwe lizachitheka.’ ”

8.1: “ ‘Ngalesosikhathi, kutsho uThixo, amathambo amakhosi akoJuda lawezikhulu zakhona, amathambo abaphristi lawabaphrofethi, kanye lamathambo abantu baseJerusalema azakhutshwa emangcwabeni awo.
8.2: Azachaywa elangeni lasenyangeni lakuzo zonke izinkanyezi zasemazulwini, abakuthandayo bakukhonza njalo abakulandelayo bakubuza bakudumisa. Kawayikubuthwa loba angcwatshwe, kodwa azakuba njengezibi phezu komhlabathi.
8.3: Loba kungaphi engibaxotshela khona, bonke abasilayo balesisizwe esibi bazakhetha ukufa kulokuphila, kutsho uThixo uSomandla.’ ”
8.4: “Wothi kubo, ‘UThixo uthi:
8.5: Pho kungani abantu laba bedukile?
8.6: Ngilalele ngesineke,
8.7: Lengabuzane emoyeni
8.8: Lingatsho kanjani ukuthi, “Sihlakaniphile,
8.9: Abahlakaniphileyo bazayangiswa,
8.10: Ngakho abafazi babo ngizabapha amanye amadoda
8.11: Babopha inxeba labantu bami
8.12: Kambe bayayangeka na ngokuziphatha kwabo okunengisayo?
8.13: Ngizabemuka isivuno sabo,
8.14: Pho sihlaleleni lapha?
8.15: Sathemba ukuba lokuthula
8.16: Ukuthimula kwamabhiza esitha
8.17: “Khangelani, ngizathumela phakathi kwenu
8.18: Awu Mduduzi wami osizini,
8.19: Lalela ukukhala kwabantu bami
8.20: “Ukuvuna sekwedlule,
8.21: Njengoba abantu bami benqotshiwe lami nginqotshiwe,
8.22: Akulamuthi yini eGiliyadi?

9.1: Awu, sengathi ngabe ikhanda lami lingumthombo wamanzi,
9.2: Awu, sengathi ngabe enkangala
9.3: “Benza izindimi zabo zilunge
9.4: “Qaphela abangane bakho,
9.5: Umngane ukhohlisa umngane,
9.6: Lihlala phakathi kwenkohliso,
9.7: Ngakho uThixo uSomandla uthi:
9.8: Ulimi lwabo lungumtshoko olobuthi,
9.9: Kakufanele ngibajezisele lokhu na?”
9.10: Ngizakhala ngililele izintaba
9.11: “IJerusalema ngizalenza libe yinqumbi yonxiwa,
9.12: Nguphi umuntu ohlakaniphileyo ukuba akuzwisise lokhu? Ngubani ofundiswe nguThixo ongakuchaza? Kungani ilizwe litshabalalisiwe lachithwa njengenkangala ukuze kungadluli muntu kulo?
9.13: UThixo wathi, “Kungenxa yokuthi sebelahle umthetho wami engababekela wona; kabangilalelanga, lomthetho wami kabawulandelanga.
9.14: Esikhundleni salokho, bona balandele ubulukhuni bezinhliziyo zabo; balandele oBhali, njengokufundiswa kwabo ngoyise.”
9.15: Ngakho-ke, uThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli uthi: “Khangelani, abantu laba ngizabadlisa ukudla okubabayo ngibanathise lamanzi alobuthi.
9.16: Ngizabahlakazela ezizweni bona kanye laboyise abangazange bazazi, njalo ngizabalandela ngenkemba ngize ngibaqede du.”
9.17: UThixo uSomandla uthi:
9.18: Kabeze ngokuphangisa,
9.19: Ilizwi lokukhala liyezwakala livela eZiyoni:
9.20: Khathesi, lina abesifazane, zwanini ilizwi likaThixo,
9.21: Ukufa kukhwele kwangena ngamafastela ethu,
9.22: Tshono uthi, uThixo uthi,
9.23: UThixo uthi:
9.24: kodwa lowo ozincomayo,
9.25: UThixo uthi, “Insuku ziyeza, lapho engizabajezisa khona bonke abasoke enyameni kuphela,
9.26: iGibhithe, loJuda, lo-Edomi, lo-Amoni loMowabi labo bonke abahlala enkangala ezindaweni ezikhatshana. Ngoba izizwe zonke lezi kazisokanga, njalo lendlu yonke ka-Israyeli kayisokanga enhliziyweni.”

10.1: Zwana okutshiwo nguThixo kuwe, wena ndlu ka-Israyeli.
10.2: UThixo uthi:
10.3: Ngoba imikhuba yabantu iyize,
10.4: Bayasicecisa ngesiliva langegolide,
10.5: Njengezinto zokwethusa endimeni yamajodo,
10.6: Kakho ofana lawe, wena Thixo,
10.7: Ngubani ongeke akwesabe,
10.8: Bonke kabalangqondo njalo bayizithutha,
10.9: Isiliva esikhandiweyo siyalethwa sivela eThashishi
10.10: Kodwa uThixo unguNkulunkulu oqotho,
10.11: “Batshele lokhu uthi, onkulunkulu laba, abangawenzanga amazulu lomhlaba, bazabhubha emhlabeni langaphansi kwamazulu.”
10.12: Kodwa uNkulunkulu wenza umhlaba ngamandla akhe,
10.13: Lapho evungama, amanzi asemazulwini ayahlokoma,
10.14: Abantu bonke kabalangqondo njalo kabalalwazi,
10.15: Ziyize, izinto zenhlekisa nje,
10.16: Lowo oyiNgxenye kaJakhobe kafani lalaba,
10.17: Qoqani impahla yenu ukuba lisuke elizweni,
10.18: Ngoba uThixo uthi,
10.19: Maye mina ngenxa yokulimala kwami!
10.20: Ithente lami lidiliziwe,
10.21: Abelusi kabalangqondo
10.22: Lalelani! Umbiko uyeza,
10.23: Ngiyazi, Oh Thixo, ukuthi ukuphila komuntu akusikho kwakhe,

11.1: Leli yilizwi elafika kuJeremiya livela kuThixo lisithi:
11.2: “Zwana izimiso zesivumelwano lesi uzitshele abantu bakoJuda lalabo abahlala eJerusalema.
11.3: Batshele uthi uThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Uqalekisiwe umuntu ongalandeli izimiso zesivumelwano lesi,
11.4: izimiso engalaya ngazo okhokho benu ekubakhupheni kwami eGibhithe, esasiyisithando sokuncibilikisa insimbi.’ Ngathi, ‘Lalelani ilizwi lami lenze konke engililaya khona, lizakuba ngabantu bami, mina ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu.
11.5: Lapho-ke ngizagcwalisa isifungo sami engasifunga kubokhokho benu, ukubanika ilizwe eligeleza uchago loluju,’ ilizwe elihlezi kulo khathesi.”
11.6: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Memezela wonke amazwi la emadolobheni akoJuda lasemigwaqweni yaseJerusalema uthi: ‘Zwanini izimiso zesivumelwano lesi lizilandele.
11.7: Kusukela ekukhupheni kwami okhokho benu eGibhithe kuze kube lamhla, ngabalaya njalonjalo ngisithi, “Lalelani ilizwi lami.”
11.8: Kodwa kabazange balalele kumbe banake; esikhundleni salokho, bona balandela inkani yezinhliziyo zabo ezimbi. Ngakho ngabehlisela zonke izithuko zesivumelwano engangibalaye ukuba basilandele kodwa kabaze basigcina.’ ”
11.9: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Kulokuhlamuka okukhona ebantwini bakoJuda lakulabo abahlala eJerusalema.
11.10: Sebebuyele ezonweni zabokhokho babo, abalayo ukulalela amazwi ami. Balandele abanye onkulunkulu ukuba babakhonze. Indlu ka-Israyeli lendlu kaJuda, zombili zisephule isivumelwano engasenza labokhokho bazo.
11.11: Ngakho nanku akutshoyo uThixo: ‘Ngizabehlisela umonakalo abangeke baphephe kuwo. Lanxa sebekhala kimi kangiyikubalalela.
11.12: Amadolobho akoJuda labantu baseJerusalema bazakuyakhala kubonkulunkulu ababatshisela impepha, kodwa kabasoze babasize ngalutho lapho uhlupho selubehlela.
11.13: Wena Juda ubunengi babonkulunkulu bakho bunjengobamadolobho akho, njalo lama-alithare owakhele ukutshisela impepha kulowonkulunkulu olihlazo, uBhali, ubunengi bawo bunjengobemigwaqo yaseJerusalema.’
11.14: Abantu laba ungabakhulekeli kumbe ubakhulumele loba ubacelele, ngoba angiyikulalela lapho bekhala kimi esikhathini sokuhlupheka kwabo.
11.15: Othandekayo wami wenzani ethempelini
11.16: UThixo wakubiza ngokuthi uyisihlahla se-oliva
11.17: UThixo uSomandla, owakuhlanyelayo, usememezele umonakalo kuwe, ngoba indlu ka-Israyeli lendlu kaJuda zenze okubi zangithukuthelisa ngokutshisela uBhali impepha.
11.18: Ngenxa yokuthi uThixo waveza icebo labo kimi, ngalazi, ngoba ngalesosikhathi wangitshengisa ababekwenza.
11.19: Ngangifana lewundlu elithambileyo lisiwa ekuhlatshweni; ngangingazi ukuthi basebebumbe icebo ngami, besithi,
11.20: Kodwa, wena, Thixo Somandla,
11.21: Ngakho-ke nanku okutshiwo nguThixo mayelana labantu base-Anathothi abafuna ukukubulala besithi, “Ungaphrofethi ngebizo likaThixo funa sikubulale”
11.22: ngakho uThixo uSomandla uthi: “Ngizabajezisa. Amajaha akibo azabulawa yinkemba, amadodana lamadodakazi abo abulawe yindlala.
11.23: Akuyikuba khona osalayo kubo, ngoba ngizaletha incithakalo ebantwini base-Anathothi ngomnyaka wokujeziswa kwabo.”

12.1: Wena ulungile izikhathi zonke,
12.2: Ubahlanyele, njalo sebemilile;
12.3: Kodwa mina, Oh Thixo, uyangazi;
12.4: Koze kube nini ilizwe lomile
12.5: “Nxa ugijime labantu ngezinyawo
12.6: Abafowenu, abendlu yakwenu
12.7: Indlu yami ngizayitshiya,
12.8: Ilifa lami kimi selibe
12.9: Ilifa lami kimi kaselibe
12.10: Abelusi abanengi bazasichitha isivini sami
12.11: Izakwenziwa ugwadule,
12.12: Emiqolweni yonke engelalutho enkangala
12.13: Bazahlanyela ingqoloyi kodwa bavune ameva;
12.14: UThixo uthi: “Bonke omakhelwane bami ababi abathumba ilifa engalinika abantu bami bako-Israyeli, ngizabasusa emazweni abo ngisuse lendlu kaJuda phakathi kwabo.
12.15: Kodwa emva kokubasusa kwami, ngizaphinda ngibe lesihawu ngibuyisele omunye lomunye wabo endaweni eyilifa lakhe elizweni lakhe.
12.16: Bangazifunda kuhle izindlela zabantu bami njalo bafunge ngebizo lami besithi, ‘Ngeqiniso elinjengoba uThixo ephila’ lanxa nje bake bafundisa abantu bami ukufunga ngoBhali, bazahlaliswa phakathi kwabantu bami.
12.17: Kodwa nxa isizwe singalaleli, ngizasisusa ngokupheleleyo ngisibhubhise,” kutsho uThixo.

13.1: UThixo wathi kimi: “Hamba uyethenga ibhanti lelineni ubophe ukhalo lwakho ngalo, kodwa lingathinti amanzi.”
13.2: Ngakho ngathenga ibhanti, njengokulaya kukaThixo, ngabopha ukhalo lwami ngalo.
13.3: Ilizwi likaThixo labuya lafika kimi ngokwesibili lathi:
13.4: “Thatha ibhanti olithengileyo obophe ngalo ukhalo lwakho, uye eYufrathe, khathesi nje ulifihle khona eminkenkeni yamatshe.”
13.5: Ngakho ngahamba ngayalifihla eYufrathe, njengokutsho kukaThixo kimi.
13.6: Sekudlule insuku ezinengi uThixo wathi kimi, “Hamba khathesi eYufrathe uyethatha ibhanti engathi lifihle khona.”
13.7: Ngakho ngaya eYufrathe ngagebha lapho engangifihle khona ibhanti, kodwa laselonakele impela lingaselasizo.
13.8: Lapho-ke kwafika ilizwi likaThixo kimi lisithi:
13.9: “UThixo uthi: ‘Ngendlela efanayo ngizakuchitha ukuzigqaja kukaJuda lokuzigqaja okukhulu kweJerusalema.
13.10: Lababantu abangalunganga, abalayo ukulalela amazwi ami, abalandela ubulukhuni bezinhliziyo zabo badinge abanye onkulunkulu ukuba babasebenzele njalo babakhonze, bazakuba njengebhanti leli, bengelasizo loluncane!
13.11: Ngoba njengebhanti libopha ukhalo lomuntu, ngayibophela kanjalo kimi yonke indlu ka-Israyeli layo yonke indlu kaJuda, kutsho uThixo, ukuba babengabantu bami ngenxa yodumo lwami, ukubongwa lokudunyiswa. Kodwa kabalalelanga.’ ”
13.12: “Batshele uthi, ‘UThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli uthi, zonke izikhumba zewayini kumele zigcwaliswe ngewayini.’ Bona bangathi kuwe, ‘Kanti thina kasikwazi yini ukuthi izikhumba zonke kumele zigcwaliswe ngewayini?’
13.13: wena uthi kubo, ‘UThixo uthi: Ngizabenza badakwe bonke abahlala kulelilizwe, kanye lamakhosi ahlala esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaDavida, abaphristi, abaphrofethi labo bonke abahlala eJerusalema.
13.14: Ngizabamahlaza omunye komunye, oyise lamadodana ngokufananayo, kutsho uThixo. Angiyikuvumela isihawu loba umusa kumbe uzwelo ukuba kungivimbele ukubabhubhisa.’ ”
13.15: Zwanini lilalele,
13.16: Dumisani uThixo uNkulunkulu wenu
13.17: Kodwa nxa lingalaleli,
13.18: Tshono enkosini lasendlovukazini uthi,
13.19: Amadolobho aseNegebi azavalwa,
13.20: Phakamisani amehlo enu libone
13.21: Lizakuthini lapho uThixo esebabeka phezu kwenu
13.22: Njalo nxa uzibuza usithi,

14.1: Leli yilizwi likaThixo elafika kuJeremiya mayelana lokoma elizweni lisithi:
14.2: “UJuda uyalila,
14.3: Izikhulu zithuma izinceku zazo ukuyafuna amanzi;
14.4: Umhlabathi uqhekezekile
14.5: Lenyamazana ensikazi egangeni
14.6: Obabhemi beganga bema emiqolweni elugwadule
14.7: Lanxa izono zethu zifakaza kubi ngathi,
14.8: Oh Themba lika-Israyeli,
14.9: Kungani usiba njengomuntu ojunyiweyo,
14.10: Nanku okutshiwo nguThixo ngalababantu:
14.11: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Ungakhulekeli inhlalakahle yabantu laba.
14.12: Lanxa bezila ukudla, ukukhala kwabo angiyikukulalela; loba benikela iminikelo yokutshiswa kanye leminikelo yamabele, angiyikuyamukela. Esikhundleni salokho, ngizabaqeda du ngenkemba, ngendlala langezifo.”
14.13: Kodwa mina ngathi, “Awu Thixo Wobukhosi, abaphrofethi bahlezi bebatshela besithi, ‘Kaliyikubona inkemba loba libulawe yindlala. Impela, ngizalipha ukuthula okungapheliyo kule indawo.’ ”
14.14: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Abaphrofethi baphrofetha amanga ngebizo lami. Angibathumanga njalo angibakhethanga kumbe ngikhulume labo. Baphrofetha imibono yamanga kini, ukuhlahlula, ukukhonza izithombe lenkohliso yezingqondo zabo.
14.15: Ngakho-ke, nanku okutshiwo nguThixo ngabaphrofethi abaphrofetha ngebizo lami ukuthi: Kangizange ngibathume, kodwa bona bathi, ‘Akulankemba kumbe indlala ezathinta ilizwe leli.’ Bona labo abaphrofethi bazabhujiswa ngenkemba langendlala.
14.16: Abantu abaphrofetha kubo bazaphoselwa phandle emigwaqweni yaseJerusalema ngenxa yendlala lenkemba. Akulamuntu ozabangcwaba kumbe omkabo, amadodana abo loba amadodakazi abo. Ngizabehlisela ingozi ebafaneleyo.
14.17: Khuluma ilizwi leli kubo uthi:
14.18: Nxa ngingena elizweni,
14.19: UJuda usumlahle kokuphela na?
14.20: Awu Thixo, siyakuvuma ukona kwethu
14.21: Ngenxa yebizo lakho ungasenyanyi;
14.22: Zikhona yini izithombe eziyize zezizwe ezinganisa izulu na?

15.1: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Lanxa uMosi loSamuyeli bengema phambi kwami, inhliziyo yami ingeke iphendukele kulababantu. Basuse phambi kwami! Kabahambe!
15.2: Bangakubuza bathi, ‘Sizakuya ngaphi na?’ uthi kubo, uThixo uthi:
15.3: Ngizabathumela imihlobo emine yabachithi,” kutsho uThixo, “inkemba yokubulala lezinja zokuhudulela khatshana njalo lezinyoni zasemoyeni kanye lezinyamazana zeganga ukuba zidle zibhuqe.
15.4: Ngizabenza banengeke emibusweni yonke yasemhlabeni ngenxa yalokho okwenziwa eJerusalema nguManase indodana kaHezekhiya inkosi yakoJuda.
15.5: Ngubani ozakuba lesihawu kuwe wena Jerusalema?
15.6: Ungalile,”
15.7: Ngizabahlungula ngefologwe
15.8: Ngizakwenza abafelokazi babo bande kakhulu
15.9: Unina wabayisikhombisa uzaqaleka
15.10: Maye, wena mama, ngokuthi wangizala,
15.11: UThixo wathi,
15.12: Umuntu angayiqamula insimbi,
15.13: Inotho yakho lamatshe akho aligugu
15.14: Ngizakwenza ube yisigqili sezitha zakho
15.15: Uyazwisisa wena Thixo;
15.16: Ekufikeni kwamazwi akho, ngawadla;
15.17: Kangizange ngihlale enhlanganisweni yabazithokozisayo,
15.18: Kungani ubuhlungu engibuzwayo bungapheli
15.19: Ngakho uThixo uthi:
15.20: Ngizakwenza ube ngumduli kulababantu,
15.21: “Ngizakuhlenga ezandleni zababi

16.1: Ilizwi likaThixo lafika kimi futhi lisithi:
16.2: “Ungathathi mfazi ube lamadodana loba amadodakazi kule indawo.”
16.3: Ngoba mayelana lamadodana lamadodakazi azalelwe kulelilizwe kanye labesifazane abangonina lamadoda angoyise uThixo uthi:
16.4: “Bazakufa bebulawa yimikhuhlane eyesabekayo. Kabayikukhalelwa loba bangcwatshwe, kodwa bazakuba njengezibi emhlabathini. Bazabhubha ngenkemba langendlala, njalo izidumbu zabo zizakuba yikudla kwezinyoni zasemoyeni lezinyamazana zeganga.”
16.5: Ngoba nanku akutshoyo uThixo: “Ungangeni endlini elokudla kwesililo; ungayilila kumbe utshengisele uzwelo, ngoba isibusiso sami, lothando lwami kanye lesihawu sami, sengikususile kulababantu,” kutsho uThixo.
16.6: “Bonke abaphakemeyo labantukazana bazakufa kulelilizwe. Kabayikungcwatshwa kumbe bakhalelwe, njalo kakho ozazisika kumbe aphuce ikhanda lakhe ngenxa yabo.
16.7: Kakho ozabanika ukudla ukuba abaduduze labo abalilela ofileyo, loba kunguyise kumbe unina, kakho lozabanika amanzi ukuba abaduduze.
16.8: Njalo ungangeni endlini eledili ukuba uhlale phansi udle unathe.
16.9: Ngoba uThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: Phambi kobuso bakho njalo ensukwini zakho ngizawuqeda umsindo wentokozo lokuthaba kanye lamazwi abalobokazi labayeni kule indawo.
16.10: Lapho abantu laba ubatshela konke lokhu besebekubuza besithi, ‘Kungani uThixo esemise ukusehlisela inkemenkeme engaka na? Senze bubi bani na? Sono bani esisenze kuThixo uNkulunkulu wethu?’
16.11: wena wothi kubo, ‘Kungenxa yokuthi okhokho benu bangifulathela,’ kutsho uThixo, ‘njalo balandela abanye onkulunkulu babasebenzela, babakhonza. Bangifulathela njalo kabayigcinanga imithetho yami.
16.12: Kodwa lina selenze okubi kakhulu kulabokhokho benu. Khangelani ukuthi lowo lalowo wenu uyilandela njani inkani yenhliziyo yakhe embi esikhundleni sokuthi angilalele.
16.13: Ngakho ngizalilahlela ngaphandle kwalelilizwe elizweni lina loba oyihlo abangazange balazi, lapho elizakhonza khona abanye onkulunkulu emini lebusuku, ngoba angiyikuba lomusa kini.’ ”
16.14: UThixo uthi, “Kodwa insuku ziyeza lapho abantu bengayikuthi, ‘Ngeqiniso elinjengokuthi uThixo ukhona, yena owakhupha abako-Israyeli eGibhithe,’
16.15: kodwa bazakuthi, ‘Ngeqiniso elinjengokuthi uThixo ukhona, yena owakhupha abako-Israyeli elizweni lasenyakatho lakuwo wonke amazwe ayebaxotshele kuwo.’ Ngoba ngizababuyisela elizweni engalinika okhokho babo.”
16.16: UThixo uthi, “Kodwa khathesi ngizathumela abagoli benhlanzi abanengi, bazababamba. Emva kwalokho ngizathumela abazingeli abanengi, bazabazingela ezintabeni zonke lasemaqaqeni wonke njalo lasezingoxweni zamadwala.
16.17: Amehlo ami akuzo zonke izindlela zabo; kabafihlakalanga kimi, lesono sabo kasiwacatshelanga amehlo ami.
16.18: Ngizaphindisela ngokuphindiweyo ububi babo lesono sabo, ngoba bangcolise ilizwe lami ngezinto ezingaphiliyo zezifanekiso zabo ezingamanyala, bagcwalisa lelifa lami ngezithombe zabo ezinengekayo.”
16.19: Awu Thixo, mandla ami lenqaba yami,
16.20: Kambe abantu bayazenzela onkulunkulu babo na?
16.21: “Ngakho ngizabafundisa,

17.1: “Isono sikaJuda sidwetshwe ngensimbi,
17.2: Labantwababo bayawakhumbula
17.3: Intaba yami eselizweni
17.4: Ngenxa yezici zenu lizalahlekelwa
17.5: UThixo uthi:
17.6: Uzakuba njengesihlahlanyana enkangala;
17.7: Kodwa ubusisiwe umuntu othemba uThixo,
17.8: Uzakuba njengesihlahla esihlanyelwe eduze lamanzi
17.9: Inhliziyo iyakhohlisa okudlula izinto zonke
17.10: “Mina Thixo ngiyayihlola inhliziyo
17.11: Umuntu ozuza inotho ngezindlela ezimbi
17.12: Isihlalo sobukhosi, esikhazimulayo esaphakanyiswayo kusukela ekuqaleni,
17.13: Awu Thixo, themba lika-Israyeli,
17.14: Ngisilisa, Thixo, njalo ngizasiliswa;
17.15: Bahlala besithi kimi,
17.16: Angibalekanga ekubeni ngumelusi wenu;
17.19: UThixo wathi kimi: “Hamba uyekuma esangweni labantu, amakhosi akoJuda angena ngalo njalo aphume ngalo; ume futhi lakuwo wonke amanye amasango aseJerusalema.
17.20: Uthi kubo, ‘Zwanini ilizwi likaThixo, lina makhosi akoJuda labo bonke abantu abahlala koJuda kanye labantu bonke abahlala eJerusalema abangena ngala amasango.
17.21: UThixo uthi: Qaphelani lingathwali mthwalo ngosuku lweSabatha loba liwungenise ngamasango aseJerusalema.
17.22: Lingaphumisi mthwalo ezindlini zenu kumbe lenze loba yiwuphi umsebenzi ngosuku lweSabatha, kodwa ligcine iSabatha lingcwele, njengokulaya kwami okhokho benu.
17.23: Kodwa kabalalelanga loba banake; izintamo zabo zazilukhuni njalo kabalalelanga kumbe bamukele ukulaywa.
17.24: UThixo uthi: Kodwa nxa liqaphele ukungilalela, lingangenisi mthwalo ngamasango edolobho leli ngeSabatha, kodwa ligcina usuku lweSabatha lungcwele ngokungenzi msebenzi ngalo,
17.25: lapho-ke amakhosi ahlezi esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaDavida azangena lezikhulu zawo ngamasango edolobho leli. Wona lezikhulu zawo bazafika begade izinqola zempi lamabhiza, belabantu bakoJuda lalabo abahlala eJerusalema; bahlale kulo idolobho kuze kube nininini.
17.26: Abantu bazakuza bevela emadolobheni akoJuda lasemizini egqagqele iJerusalema, bevela elizweni lakoBhenjamini lasezintatshaneni zangasentshonalanga, bevela elizweni lamaqaqa laseNegebi, beletha iminikelo yokutshiswa lemihlatshelo, iminikelo yamabele, impepha kanye leminikelo yokubonga endlini kaThixo.
17.27: Kodwa nxa lingangilaleli ekuthini ligcine usuku lweSabatha lungcwele ngokungathwali mthwalo lapho lingena ngamasango aseJerusalema ngosuku lweSabatha, lapho-ke ngizaphemba umlilo ongacitshekiyo emasangweni eJerusalema ozaqothula izinqaba zalo.’ ”

18.1: Leli yilizwi elafika kuJeremiya livela kuThixo lisithi:
18.2: “Suka wehlele endlini yombumbi, lapho engizakutshelela khona ilizwi lami.”
18.3: Ngakho ngehlela endlini yombumbi, ngambona esebenza ngevili.
18.4: Kodwa imbiza ayeyibumba ngebumba yonakala ezandleni zakhe; ngakho umbumbi wayenza yaba ngenye imbiza, ngendlela ayibona ingcono kuye.
18.5: Ilizwi likaThixo laselifika kimi lisithi;
18.6: “Wena ndlu ka-Israyeli, ngingeze ngenza kuwe njengokwenziwa ngumbumbi lo na?” kutsho uThixo. “Njengebumba esandleni sombumbi lawe unjalo esandleni sami, wena ndlu ka-Israyeli.
18.7: Nxa ngimemezela langasiphi isikhathi ukuthi isizwe loba umbuso uzasuswa udilizwe, uchithwe,
18.8: kuthi isizwe leso engisixwayisileyo siphenduke ebubini baso, ngizaxola ngingabe ngisasehlisela ebesengimise ukusehlisela khona.
18.9: Njalo nxa ngesinye isikhathi ngimemezela ukuthi isizwe kumbe umbuso ngizawakha ngiwumise,
18.10: ube ususenza ububi emehlweni ami njalo ungangilaleli, ngizacabanga kutsha ngokuhle ebesengicebe ukukwenzela khona.
18.11: Ngakho khathesi tshela abantu bakoJuda lalabo abahlala eJerusalema uthi, ‘Nanku okutshiwo nguThixo: Khangelani! Ngilungisela ukulehlisela umonakalo njalo ngibumba lecebo ngani. Ngakho phendukani ezindleleni zenu ezimbi, omunye lomunye wenu, lilungise izindlela zenu lezenzo zenu.’
18.12: Kodwa bazaphendula bathi, ‘Akusizi lutho. Sizaqhubeka ngamacebo ethu; lowo lalowo wethu uzalandela ubulukhuni benhliziyo yakhe embi.’ ”
18.13: Ngakho uThixo uthi:
18.14: Ungqwaqwane waseLebhanoni
18.15: Kodwa abantu bami sebengikhohliwe;
18.16: Ilizwe labo lizatshabalaliswa,
18.17: Njengomoya ovela empumalanga,
18.18: Bona bathi, “Wozani sicebe amacebo amabi ngoJeremiya; ngoba ukufundisa kwabaphristi umthetho akusoze kuphuthe, kumbe ukweluleka kwezihlakaniphi, loba ilizwi elivela kubaphrofethi. Ngakho wozani, simhlasele ngemilomo yethu singananzi lutho alutshoyo.”
18.19: Ake ungizwe, awu Thixo;
18.20: Okuhle kuphindiselwa ngokubi na?
18.21: Ngakho-ke abantwababo banikele endlaleni;
18.22: Kakuzwakale ukukhala ezindlini zabo,
18.23: Kodwa uyawazi, wena Thixo,

19.1: Lokhu yikho akutshoyo uThixo: “Hamba uyethenga udiwo kumbumbi wezimbiza. Thatha abanye abadala babantu labanye babaphristi
19.2: uhambe labo esigodini seBheni-Hinomu, eduze lentuba yeSango loDengezi. Umemezele amazwi engikutshela wona,
19.3: uthi, ‘Zwanini ilizwi likaThixo, lina makhosi akoJuda lani bantu abahlala eJerusalema. UThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: Lalelani! Ngizaletha umonakalo kule indawo ozabanda indlebe zomuntu wonke owuzwayo.
19.4: Ngoba bangidelile kwathi indawo le bayenza eyabonkulunkulu bezizweni; kuyo batshisele imihlatshelo onkulunkulu abangabaziyo, bona labokhokho babo kanye lamakhosi akoJuda, njalo indawo le sebayigcwalisa igazi labantu abangelacala.
19.5: Sebakhele uBhali izindawo eziphakemeyo ukuba batshise amadodana abo emlilweni njengeminikelo yokutshiswa kuBhali, into engingazange ngibalaye kumbe ngitsho ukuthi bayenze, kumbe ukuthi ike ifike engqondweni yami.
19.6: Ngakho qaphelani, insuku ziyeza, kutsho uThixo, lapho abantu bengayikubiza indawo le ngokuthi Thofethi loba iSigodi seBheni-Hinomu kodwa iSigodi sokuBulala.
19.7: Kuyonale indawo ngizawachitha amacebo kaJuda laweJerusalema. Ngizabenza bafe ngenkemba phambi kwezitha zabo, lasezandleni zalabo abafuna ukubabulala, njalo ngizanikela izidumbu zabo ukuba zibe yikudla kwezinyoni zasemoyeni lezinyamazana zeganga.
19.8: Idolobho leli ngizalichitha ngilenze libe yinto yokwesatshwa lenhlekisa; bonke abadlula khona bazathuthumela njalo baklolode ngenxa yamanxeba alo wonke.
19.9: Ngizabenza badle inyama yamadodana abo leyamadodakazi abo, njalo labo bazadlana inyama ngesikhathi esinzima sokuvinjezelwa kwabo yizitha ezifuna ukubabulala.’
19.10: Emva kwalokho bulala udiwo labo abahamba lawe bekhangele,
19.11: ubususithi kubo, ‘UThixo uSomandla uthi: Ngizasiphahlaza isizwe lesi kanye ledolobho leli njengokuphahlazwa kodiwo lombumbi lolu olungeke lulungiswe futhi. Abafileyo bazabangcwaba eThofethi kuze kusweleke indawo.
19.12: Lokhu yikho engizakwenza kule indawo lakulabo abahlala lapha, kutsho uThixo. Idolobho leli ngizalenza lifanane leThofethi.
19.13: Izindlu zaseJerusalema kanye lezamakhosi akoJuda zizangcoliswa njengale indawo, iThofethi, zonke izindlu lapho abazatshisela khona impepha phezu kwezimpahla kuwo wonke amaxuku ezinkanyezi, bathelela abanye onkulunkulu umnikelo wokunathwayo.’ ”
19.14: UJeremiya wabuya evela eThofethi, lapho uThixo ayemthume ukuyaphrofetha khona, wasesima egumeni lethempeli likaThixo wathi ebantwini bonke,
19.15: “UThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Lalelani! Ngizakwehlisela kulelidolobho lasemizini elizungezileyo wonke umonakalo engawutshoyo, ngoba izintamo zabo zilukhuni njalo bayala ukulalela amazwi ami.’ ”

20.1: Kwathi uPhashuri umphristi indodana ka-Imeri, induna enkulu ethempelini likaThixo, ezwe uJeremiya ephrofitha lezizinto,
20.2: wenza ukuthi uJeremiya umphrofethi atshaywe njalo wamvalela esitokisini eSangweni laPhezulu koBhenjamini ethempelini likaThixo.
20.3: Ngosuku olwalandelayo, uPhashuri esemkhupha esitokisini, uJeremiya wathi kuye, “Ibizo lakho oliphiwe nguThixo akusiPhashuri, kodwa uMagori-Misabibi,
20.4: ngoba uThixo uthi: ‘Ngizakwenza ubelucuku ngokwakho lakubo bonke abangane bakho; uzababona ngamehlo akho besiwa ngenkemba yezitha zabo. UJuda wonke ngizamnikela enkosini yaseBhabhiloni, ezabathumba ibase eBhabhiloni loba ibabulale ngenkemba.
20.5: Yonke inotho yedolobho leli ngizayipha izitha zabo lazozonke izithelo zalo, zonke izinto zalo eziligugu kanye lemfuyo yonke yamakhosi akoJuda zizayithumba njengempango ziyithwalele eBhabhiloni.
20.6: Wena Phashuri, labo bonke abahlala endlini yakho lizathunjwa liye eBhabhiloni. Uzafela khonale, ungcwatshwe khonale, wena kanye labangane bakho bonke ophrofetha amanga kubo.’ ”
20.7: Awu Thixo, wangiyenga, ngayengeka;
20.8: Zonke izikhathi lapho ngikhuluma, ngiyakhala
20.9: Kodwa nxa ngisithi, “Kangiyikumqamba
20.10: Ngizwa abanengi benyenyeza besithi,
20.11: Kodwa uThixo ulami njengebutho elilamandla;
20.12: Awu Thixo Somandla, wena ohlola abalungileyo,
20.13: Hlabelani uThixo!
20.14: Kaluqalekiswe usuku engazalwa ngalo!
20.15: Kaqalekiswe umuntu owayabikela ubaba izindaba,

21.1: Ilizwi lafika kuJeremiya livela kuThixo lapho uZedekhiya inkosi wayethume kuye uPhashuri indodana kaMalikhija lomphristi uZefaniya indodana kaMaseya. Bathi:
21.2: “Ake usibuzele kuThixo khathesi nje, ngoba uNebhukhadineza inkosi yaseBhabhiloni uyasihlasela. Mhlawumbe uThixo angasenzela izimanga njengasezikhathini ezedlulayo ukuze asuke kithi.”
21.3: Kodwa uJeremiya wathi kubo, “Tshelani uZedekhiya lithi:
21.4: ‘UThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: Sekuseduze ukuthi ngiziphendulele kuwe izikhali zempi ezisezandleni zakho, ozisebenzisayo ekulweni lenkosi yaseBhabhiloni lamaKhaladiya angaphandle komduli ekuvimbezele. Njalo ngizawaqoqa phakathi kwalelidolobho.
21.5: Mina uqobo ngizakulwa lawe ngesandla eseluliweyo langengalo elamandla ngentukuthelo langokufuthelana kanye lolaka olukhulu.
21.6: Ngizabatshaya abahlala kulelidolobho, abantu lezifuyo njalo bazabulawa yisifo esesabekayo.
21.7: Emva kwalokho, kutsho uThixo, uZedekhiya inkosi yakoJuda, lezikhulu zakhe kanye labantu bakulelidolobho abaphepha emkhuhlaneni, enkembeni lasendlaleni, ngizabanikela kuNebhukhadineza inkosi yaseBhabhiloni lasezitheni zabo ezifuna ukubabulala. Uzababulala ngenkemba; kayikuba lomusa kumbe uzwelo loba isihawu.’
21.8: Phezu kwalokho, abantu batshele uthi, ‘UThixo uthi: Khangelani, ngiyalimisela phambi kwenu indlela yokuphila lendlela yokufa.
21.9: Loba ngubani osala kulelidolobho uzabulawa ngenkemba, yindlala loba ngumkhuhlane. Kodwa loba ngubani ophumayo kulo ayezinikela kumaKhaladiya alivimbezeleyo uzasila, aphunyuke lokuphila kwakhe.
21.10: Sengiqonde ukwenza okubi kulelidolobho hatshi okuhle, kutsho uThixo. Lizanikelwa ezandleni zenkosi yaseBhabhiloni, ezalitshabalalisa ngomlilo.’
21.11: Phezu kwalokho, wothi endlini yenkosi yakoJuda, ‘Zwanini ilizwi likaThixo;
21.12: lina abendlu kaDavida, uThixo uthi:
21.13: Ngimelane lawe, Jerusalema,
21.14: Ngizalijezisa njengokufanele izono zenu,

22.1: Nanku akutshoyo uThixo: “Hamba wehlele endlini yenkosi yakoJuda umemezele khona ilizwi leli uthi,
22.2: ‘Zwana ilizwi likaThixo, we nkosi yakoJuda, wena ohlala esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaDavida, wena lezikhulu zakho kanye labantu bakho abangena ngamasango la.
22.3: UThixo uthi: Yenzani okulungileyo lokuqondileyo. Mhlenge esandleni somncindezeli wakhe lowo ophangiweyo. Lingenzi okubi loba udlakela kowezizweni, intandane loba umfelokazi, njalo lingachithi igazi elingelacala kule indawo.
22.4: Ngoba nxa linanzelela ukulandela imilayo le, amakhosi ahlala esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaDavida azangena ngamasango ale indawo, egade izinqola zempi lamabhiza, elezikhulu zawo kanye labantu bawo.
22.5: Kodwa nxa imilayo le lingayilaleli, kutsho uThixo, ngifunga ngami ukuthi indawo le izakuba lunxiwa.’ ”
22.6: Ngoba mayelana lendawo yenkosi yakoJuda uThixo uthi:
22.7: Ngizakuthumela abachithi,
22.8: Abantu abavela ezizweni ezinengi bazadlula kulelidolobho babuzane besithi, ‘Kungani uThixo enze into enje kulelidolobho elikhulu na?’
22.9: Impendulo izakuthi: ‘Ngoba basidelile isivumelwano sikaThixo uNkulunkulu wabo bakhonza abanye onkulunkulu njalo babasebenzela.’ ”
22.10: Lingayikhaleli inkosi efileyo loba lililele ukulilahlekela kwayo;
22.11: Ngoba mayelana loShalumi indodana kaJosiya, owangena esikhundleni sikayise esiba yinkosi yakoJuda kodwa osesukile kule indawo: UThixo uthi, “Kasoze abuye futhi.
22.12: Uzafela kuleyondawo asiwa kuyo ethunjiwe; ilizwe leli kasoze alibone futhi.”
22.13: “Maye kuye owakha indlu yakhe yobukhosi ngokungalungi,
22.14: Uthi, ‘Ngizazakhela indlu enkulu yobukhosi
22.15: Ukuba lemisedari eminenginengi
22.16: Wavikela amalungelo abayanga labaswelayo,
22.17: “Kodwa amehlo akho lenhliziyo yakho
22.18: Ngakho mayelana loJehoyakhimi indodana kaJosiya, inkosi yakoJuda, uThixo uthi:
22.19: Uzangcwatshwa njengobabhemi,
22.20: “Qansa uye eLebhanoni umemeze,
22.22: Umoya uzabaxotshela khatshana bonke abelusi bakho,
22.24: UThixo uthi, “Ngeqiniso njengoba ngikhona, lanxa ngabe wena, Jehoyakhini ndodana kaJehoyakhimi inkosi yakoJuda, wawuyindandatho ebukekayo esandleni sami sokunene, ngangizakukhupha.
22.25: Ngizakunikela kulabo abafuna ukukubulala, labo obesabayo, uNebhukhadineza inkosi yaseBhabhiloni lakumaKhaladiya.
22.26: Wena kanye lonyoko owakuzalayo ngizaliphosela kwelinye ilizwe, lapho elingazalelwanga khona, lapho elizafela khona lobabili.
22.27: Kaliyikuphinda libuye elizweni elifisa ukuza kulo.”

23.1: “Maye kubelusi abachitha izimvu zedlelo lami njalo bezihlakaza!” kutsho uThixo.
23.2: Ngakho uThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi kubelusi abelusa abantu bami: “Ngenxa yokuthi lina lihlakaze umhlambi wami lawuxotshela khatshana kalaze lawunaka, ngizakwehlisela isijeziso phezu kwenu ngenxa yobubi elibenzileyo,” kutsho uThixo.
23.3: “Mina ngokwami ngizabutha insalela zezimvu zami emazweni wonke engangizixotshele kuwo ngizibuyisele edlelweni lazo, lapho ezizazalana khona zande.
23.4: Ngizazilethela abelusi abazazelusa, njalo kazisayikwesaba loba zithuthumele, loba enye yazo ilahleke,” kutsho uThixo.
23.5: UThixo uthi, “Ziyeza insuku,
23.6: Ensukwini zayo uJuda uzasindiswa,
23.7: UThixo uthi, “Ngakho-ke, insuku ziyeza, lapho abantu bengasayikuthi, ‘Ngeqiniso elinjengoba uThixo ekhona, yena owakhupha u-Israyeli eGibhithe,’
23.8: kodwa bazakuthi, ‘Ngeqiniso elinjengoba uThixo ekhona, yena owakhipha izizukulwane zika-Israyeli elizweni elisenyakatho lakuwo wonke amazwe abaxotshela kuwo.’ Lapho-ke bazahlala elizweni labo.”
23.15: Ngakho, mayelana labaphrofethi uThixo uSomandla uthi:
23.18: Kodwa nguphi wabo owake wema emhlanganweni kaThixo
23.25: “Ngikuzwile okutshiwo ngabaphrofethi abaphrofetha amanga ngebizo lami. Bathi, ‘Ngiphuphile! Ngiphuphile!’
23.26: Koze kube nini lokhu kuqhubeka ezinhliziyweni zalaba abaphrofethi abalamanga na?
23.27: Bacabanga ukuthi amaphupho abawatshelanayo azakwenza abantu bami bakhohlwe ibizo lami, njengabokhokho babo abakhohlwa ibizo lami ngenxa yokukhonza uBhali.
23.28: Akuthi umphrofethi ophupha iphupho kalitsho, kodwa lowo olelizwi lami kalikhulume ngobuqotho, ngoba amakhoba angenzani lamabele na?” kutsho uThixo.
23.29: “Ilizwi lami kalinjengomlilo,” kutsho uThixo, “lanjengesando esidabula idwala libe yizicucu na?”
23.30: UThixo uthi, “Ngakho, ngimelana labaphrofethi abantshontsha kwabanye amazwi okuthiwa avela kimi.
23.31: Yebo, ngimelana labaphrofethi abasebenzisa indimi zabo kodwa bathi, ‘UThixo uthi,’
23.32: Ngeqiniso, ngimelana lalabo abaphrofetha amaphupho amanga,” kutsho uThixo. “Bayawatsho baholele abantu bami ekulahlekeni ngamanga abo lamawala, ikanti angizange ngibathume kumbe ngibakhethe. Kababasizi ngalutho abantu laba,” kutsho uThixo.
23.33: “Nxa abantu laba, loba umphrofethi kumbe umphristi, bebuza besithi, ‘Izilo likaThixo kuyini?’ wothi kubo, ‘Izilo liphi? Ngizakulahla, kutsho uThixo.’
23.34: Nxa umphrofethi loba umphristi kumbe omunye umuntu esithi, ‘Leli lizilo likaThixo,’ lowomuntu ngizamjezisa kanye labendlu yakhe.
23.35: Lokhu yikho omunye wenu ohlala ekutsho kumngane wakhe loba isihlobo sakhe ukuthi: ‘Impendulo kaThixo ithini na?’ loba ‘UThixo utheni?’
23.36: Kodwa akumelanga lithi ‘izilo likaThixo’ futhi, ngoba umuntu wonke ilizwi lakhe liba lizilo lakhe ngoba liyawahlanekela amazwi kaNkulunkulu ophilayo, uThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu wethu.
23.37: Lokhu yikho elihlala likutsho kumphrofethi ukuthi, ‘Impendulo kaThixo kuwe ithini?’ loba ‘UThixo utheni?’
23.38: Lanxa lina lisithi, ‘Leli lizilo likaThixo,’ uThixo uthi: Lasebenzisa amazwi athi, ‘Leli lizilo likaThixo.’ Lanxa mina ngalitshela ukuthi lingabokuthi, ‘Leli lizilo likaThixo.’
23.39: Ngakho, ngeqiniso ngizalikhohlwa ngiliphosele khatshana lami kanye ledolobho engalinika lona lina labokhokho benu.

24.1: Emva kokuba uJekhoniya indodana kaJehoyakhimi inkosi yakoJuda lezikhulu, izingcitshi kanye lezisebenzi zakoJuda sebethunjwe eJerusalema basiwa eBhabhiloni nguNebhukhadineza inkosi yaseBhabhiloni, uThixo wangitshengisa izitsha ezimbili zomkhiwa zibekwe phambi kwethempeli likaThixo.
24.2: Esinye isitsha sasilomkhiwa omuhle kakhulu, njengovuthwa kuqala; esinye isitsha sasilomkhiwa omubi, ubolile ungeke wadleka.
24.3: UThixo wasesithi kimi, “Kuyini okubonayo, Jeremiya?”
24.4: Ilizwi likaThixo laselifika kimi lisithi:
24.5: “UThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli uthi, ‘Njengalo umkhiwa omuhle, ngibathatha njengabalungileyo abathunjwa bakoJuda, engabasusa kule indawo ngabasa elizweni laseBhabhiloni.
24.6: Amehlo ami azabakhangela kokuphela, njalo ngizababuyisa kulelilizwe. Ngizabakha ngingabadilizi; ngizabahlanyela ngingabasiphuni.
24.7: Ngizabapha inhliziyo yokungazi, ukuthi mina nginguThixo. Bazakuba ngabantu bami, mina ngibe nguNkulunkulu wabo, ngoba bazabuyela kimi ngenhliziyo yabo yonke.
24.8: Kodwa njengomkhiwa omubi, obolileyo ongeke udliwe,’ kutsho uThixo, ‘ngizamphatha kanjalo uZedekhiya inkosi yakoJuda, lezikhulu zakhe kanye labasindayo eJerusalema, langabe basele kulelilizwe loba baseGibhithe.
24.9: Ngizabenza bazondakale njalo babe yisinengiso kuyo yonke imibuso yasemhlabeni, insolo lesiga, into yokuhlekwa lokuthukwa, loba kungaphi engibaxotshela khona.
24.10: Ngizathumela inkemba, indlala lomkhuhlane baze babhujiswe baphele elizweni engabanika lona kanye labokhokho babo.’ ”

25.1: Ilizwi lafika kuJeremiya mayelana labantu bonke bakoJuda ngomnyaka wesine kaJehoyakhimi indodana kaJosiya inkosi yakoJuda, okwakungumnyaka wokuqala kaNebhukhadineza inkosi yaseBhabhiloni.
25.2: Ngakho uJeremiya umphrofethi wathi kubo bonke abantu bakoJuda lakubo bonke abahlala eJerusalema:
25.3: Okweminyaka engamatshumi amabili lantathu, kusukela ngomnyaka wetshumi lantathu kaJosiya indodana ka-Amoni inkosi yakoJuda kuze kube yilolusuku, ilizwi likaThixo lafika kimi njalo ngalikhuluma kini njalonjalo, kodwa kalilalelanga.
25.4: Lanxa uThixo wathumela zonke izinceku zakhe abaphrofethi kini njalonjalo, kalilalelanga njalo kalinakanga.
25.5: Bathi, “Phendukani khathesi, omunye lomunye wenu, ezindleleni zenu ezimbi lasezenzweni zenu ezimbi, lihlale elizweni uThixo alinika lona kanye labokhokho benu kuze kube nininini.
25.6: Lingalandeli abanye onkulunkulu ukuba libasebenzele njalo libakhonze; lingangithukuthelisi ngalokho okwenziwa yizandla zenu. Lapho-ke angiyikulehlisela okubi.”
25.7: “Kodwa kalingilalelanga,” kutsho uThixo, “njalo lingithukuthelisile ngokwenziwa ngezandla zenu, lazehlisela okubi.”
25.8: Ngakho uThixo uSomandla uthi: “Ngenxa yokuthi kalilalelanga amazwi ami,
25.9: ngizabiza bonke abantu basenyakatho lenceku yami uNebhukhadineza inkosi yaseBhabhiloni,” kutsho uThixo, “njalo ngizabaletha ukuba bamelane lelizwe leli labahlala kulo kanye lezizwe zonke eziseduze lalo. Ngizababhubhisa ngokupheleleyo ngibenze babe yinto eyesabekayo leyokuklolodelwa, lencithakalo yanini lanini.
25.10: Ngizasusa phakathi kwabo imisindo yokuthokoza lokuthaba, lelizwi lomlobokazi lelomyeni, lomsindo wamatshe okuchola kanye lokukhanya kwesibane.
25.11: Ilizwe leli lonke lizakuba yinkangala ephundlekileyo, lezizwe lezi zizasebenzela inkosi yaseBhabhiloni iminyaka engamatshumi ayisikhombisa.
25.12: Kodwa lapho iminyaka engamatshumi ayisikhombisa isiphelile, ngizayijezisa inkosi yaseBhabhiloni lesizwe sayo, ilizwe lamaKhaladiya, ngenxa yobubi babo,” kutsho uThixo, “njalo ngizalenza lichitheke kokuphela.
25.13: Ngizakwehlisela phezu kwelizwe lelo zonke izinto engazitshoyo ngalo, konke okulotshwe encwadini le okwaphrofethwa nguJeremiya ezizweni zonke.
25.14: Lazo uqobo zizathunjwa yizizwe ezinengi lamakhosi amakhulu; ngizaphindisela kubo mayelana lezenzo zabo langemisebenzi yezandla zabo.”
25.15: UThixo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli wathi kimi, “Yamukela esandleni sami inkezo le egcwele iwayini lolaka lwami unathise zonke izizwe engikuthuma kuzo.
25.16: Zingalinatha, zizadiyazela zihlanye ngenxa yenkemba engizayithumela phakathi kwazo.”
25.17: Ngakho ngayithatha inkezo esandleni sikaThixo ngazinathisa zonke izizwe ayengithume kuzo:
25.18: IJerusalema lamadolobho akoJuda, amakhosi akhona kanye lezikhulu, ukubenza babe yincithakalo lento eyesabekayo yokuklolodelwa lokuqalekiswa, njengoba benjalo lamhla;
25.19: uFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe, lezinceku zakhe, lezikhulu zakhe kanye labantu bakhe bonke,
25.23: eDedani, leThema leBhuzi labo bonke abasezindaweni ezikhatshana;
25.24: wonke amakhosi ase-Arabhiya lawo wonke amakhosi abantu bezizweni abahlala enkangala;
25.26: lawo amakhosi asenyakatho, eduze lakhatshana, elandelana, yonke imibuso esemhlabeni.
25.27: “Lapho-ke batshele uthi, ‘UThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli uthi: Nathani, lidakwe lihlanze, njalo liwe lingavuki futhi ngenxa yenkemba engizayithumela phakathi kwenu.’
25.28: Kodwa bangala ukwamukela inkezo esandleni sakho ukuba banathe, batshele uthi, ‘UThixo uSomandla uthi: Kumele liyinathe!
25.29: Khangelani, sengiqalisile ukuletha umonakalo edolobheni elileBizo lami, njalo lina lizaphutha impela ukujeziswa na? Kaliyikuphutha ukujeziswa ngoba ngizakwehlisela inkemba phezu kwabo bonke abahlala emhlabeni, kutsho uThixo uSomandla.’
25.30: Khathesi-ke phrofetha wonke amazwi la ngabo uthi kubo:
25.33: Ngalesosikhathi labo ababulewe nguThixo bazakuba sezindaweni zonke kusukela komunye kusiya komunye umkhawulo womhlaba. Kabayikukhalelwa loba babuthwe kumbe bangcwatshwe, kodwa bazakuba njengezibi emhlabathini.
25.35: Abelusi laba kabayikuba lalapho abangabalekela khona,

26.1: Ekuqaleni kokubusa kukaJehoyakhimi indodana kaJosiya inkosi yakoJuda, kwafika ilizwi leli livela kuThixo lisithi,
26.2: “UThixo uthi: Mana egumeni lendlu kaThixo ukhulume kubo bonke abantu basemadolobheni akoJuda abeza endlini kaThixo ukuba bakhonze. Batshele konke engakulaya khona, kungabi lelizwi olitshiyayo.
26.3: Mhlawumbe bazalalela omunye lomunye wabo aphenduke endleleni yakhe embi. Lapho-ke ngizadeda ngingabehliseli umonakalo ebengizawenza kubo ngenxa yobubi ababenzileyo.
26.4: Tshono kubo uthi, ‘UThixo uthi: Nxa lingangilaleli lilandele umthetho wami engalibekela wona,
26.5: njalo nxa lingalaleli amazwi ezinceku zami abaphrofethi, engabathuma kini njalonjalo (lanxa lingalalelanga),
26.6: ngizakwenza indlu le ibe njengeShilo ledolobho leli libe yinto yokuqalekiswa phakathi kwezizwe zonke zomhlaba.’ ”
26.7: Abaphristi, labaphrofethi kanye labantu bonke bamuzwa uJeremiya ekhuluma amazwi la endlini kaThixo.
26.8: Kodwa kwathi uJeremiya eqeda nje ukubatshela bonke abantu konke uThixo ayemlaye ukuba akutsho, abaphristi, labaphrofethi kanye labantu bonke bamphuthuma bathi kuye, “Kumele ufe!
26.9: Kungani uphrofetha ngebizo likaThixo usithi indlu le izakuba njengeShilo ledolobho leli lizachitheka abantu basuke kulo?” Abantu bonke bambuthanela uJeremiya endlini kaThixo.
26.10: Kwathi izikhulu zakoJuda sezizwe ngalezizinto, zaya endlini kaThixo zisuka esigodlweni senkosi zahlala ezindaweni zazo entubeni yeSango elitsha lendlu kaThixo.
26.11: Abaphristi, labaphrofethi basebesithi ezikhulwini lasebantwini bonke, “Umuntu lo kumele agwetshelwe ukufa ngoba uphrofetha kubi ngedolobho leli. Likuzwile ngezindlebe zenu!”
26.12: UJeremiya wasesithi ezikhulwini zonke lasebantwini bonke: “UThixo ungithumile ukuba ngiphrofethe kubi ngendlu le langedolobho leli zonke izinto elizizwileyo.
26.13: Ngakho lungisani izindlela zenu lezenzo zenu lilalele uThixo uNkulunkulu wenu. Ngalokho uThixo uzadeda angabe esalehlisela umonakalo abememezele ukuwehlisela kini.
26.14: Kodwa mina, ngisezandleni zenu; yenzani kimi loba kuyini lokho elikubona kukuhle, kufanele.
26.15: Kodwa likwazi, impela ukuthi lingangibulala, lizakwehlisela phezu kwenu icala legazi elimsulwa laphezu kwedolobho leli kanye laphezu kwabantu abahlala kulo, ngoba ngeqiniso uThixo ungithumile kini ukuba ngikhulume wonke amazwi la lani lisizwa.”
26.16: Izikhulu labantu bonke basebesithi kubaphristi lakubaphrofethi, “Umuntu lo akumelanga abulawe! Ukhulume kithi ngebizo likaThixo uNkulunkulu wethu.”
26.17: Abanye babadala baselizweni basondela phambili bakhuluma kulolonke ibandla labantu bathi,
26.18: 26.18 UMikha 3.12“UMikha waseMoreshethi waphrofitha ensukwini zikaHezekhiya inkosi yakoJuda. Wabatshela bonke abantu bakoJuda wathi, ‘UThixo uSomandla uthi:
26.19: Kanje uHezekhiya inkosi yakoJuda loba omunye umuntu nje wakoJuda wambulala na? UHezekhiya kamesabanga yini uThixo wacela umusa kuye? UThixo kadedanga wayekela ukubehlisela umonakalo ayewumemezele kubo na? Sekuseduze ukuthi sizehlisele umonakalo owesabekayo phezu kwethu!”
26.20: (U-Uriya indodana kaShemaya owaseKhiriyathi-Jeyarimi ungomunye umuntu owaphrofetha ngebizo likaThixo: waphrofitha izinto ezinjalo ngedolobho leli langelizwe leli njengoJeremiya.
26.21: Kwathi inkosi uJehoyakhimi lezinduna zakhe kanye lezikhulu zakhe besizwa amazwi akhe, bafuna ukumbulala. Kodwa u-Uriya wakuzwa lokho wasebalekela eGibhithe esesaba.
26.22: UJehoyakhimi inkosi, wathuma u-Elinathani indodana ka-Akhibhori lamanye amadoda eGibhithe.
26.23: Bamthatha u-Uriya eGibhithe bamusa kuJehoyakhimi inkosi wambulala ngenkemba isidumbu sakhe saphoselwa endaweni yokungcwabela abantukazana.)
26.24: Phezu kwalokho, u-Ahikhami indodana kaShafani wasekela uJeremiya, ngakho kanikezwanga ebantwini ukuba bambulale.

27.1: Ekuqaleni kokubusa kukaZedekhiya indodana kaJosiya inkosi yakoJuda, ilizwi leli lafika kuJeremiya livela kuThixo lisithi:
27.2: UThixo wathi kimi, “Yenza ijogwe ngemichilo langemigoqo uligaxe entanyeni yakho.
27.3: Ubusuthumela ilizwi enkosini yase-Edomi, leyaseMowabi, leyase-Amoni, eyeThire kanye leyaseSidoni ngezithunywa ezize eJerusalema kuZedekhiya inkosi yakoJuda.
27.4: Zinike ilizwi eliya emakhosini azo uthi, ‘UThixo uSomandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli uthi: Tshelani amakhosi enu lokhu ukuthi:
27.5: Ngamandla ami amakhulu langengalo yami eyeluliweyo ngenza umhlaba labantu bawo kanye lezinyamazana ezikuwo, njalo ngiwunika loba ngubani ngokuthanda kwami.
