6.18: Indwendwe zamakamela ziyaphambuka ezindleleni zazo;
6.19: Indwendwe zamakamela aseThema zidinga amanzi,
6.20: Bayadana ngoba bebekade bethembile;
6.21: Lani selitshengise ukuthi kalilancedo;
6.22: Sengake ngatsho yini ukuthi, ‘Ake lingihlawulele lokhu,
6.23: ngikhululani esandleni sesitha,

7.1: “Umuntu kakho ekutshikatshikeni okunzima yini emhlabeni?
7.2: Njengesigqili siloyisa amathunzi okuhlwa,
7.3: kanjalo ngibekelwe izinyanga ezingelambadalo,
7.4: Ngithi nxa ngilala ngicabange ngithi, ‘Kuzakusa nini na’?
7.5: Umzimba wami uphihlika impethu lamathuthuva,
7.6: Insuku zami ziyaphangisa kulosungulo lomaluki,
7.7: Khumbula, Oh Nkulunkulu, ukuthi impilo yami ngumoya nje;
7.8: Ilihlo elingibonayo khathesi alisayikuphinde lingibone futhi;
7.9: Njengeyezi elinyamalalayo liphele,
7.10: Kasoze lanini aphinde angene endlini yakhe;
7.11: Ngakho-ke kangizukuthula;
7.12: Ngilulwandle yini, kumbe ngiyisilo semanzini
7.13: Ngithi lapho ngicabanga ukuthi umbheda wami uzangiduduza
7.14: lakhona lapho liyangethusa ngamaphupho
7.15: okwenza ngiqome ukuklinywa lokufa,
7.16: Ngiyayeyisa impilo yami; kangiloyisi ukuphila okwaphakade.
7.17: Umuntu uyini ongaze uzihluphe kangaka ngaye,
7.18: uze umhlole ekuseni insuku zonke
7.19: Kawusoze uke ukhangele eceleni kwami na,
7.20: Aluba ngenze isono, kuyini engikwenzileyo kuwe,
7.21: Kungani ungaxoleli iziphambeko zami na,

8.1: UBhilidadi umShuhi wasephendula wathi:
8.2: “Koze kube nini ukhuluma izinto ezinjalo?
8.3: Kambe uNkulunkulu uyakuhlanekela ukulunga na?
8.4: Lapho abantwabakho besona kuye,
8.5: Kanti nxa wena uzakhangela kuNkulunkulu
8.6: nxa umsulwa ulungile,
8.7: Lapho owaqalisa khona kuzakhanya sekukuncinyane,
8.8: Buza izizukulwane ezingaphambili
8.9: ngoba thina sizelwe izolo nje, kasazi lutho,
8.10: Kambe kaziyikukulaya zikutshele na?
8.11: Konje imihlanga ingakhula ibe mide ingekho exhaphozini na?
8.12: Nxa leyonqodi isakhula ingakaqunywa
8.13: Sinjalo isiphetho sabo bonke abakhohlwa uNkulunkulu;
8.14: Lokho akuthembayo kufohlozeka lula;
8.15: Uyeyama kulobubulembu bakhe, kodwa bubhidlike;
8.16: Unjengesihlahla esithelelwa kakhulu sikhula elangeni,
8.17: sinxibanise impande zaso enqunjini yamatshe,
8.18: Kodwa singasitshulwa kuleyondawo,
8.19: Ngeqiniso impilo yaso iyabuna,
8.20: Ngeqiniso uNkulunkulu kamlahli umuntu ongelasici
8.21: Usazogcwalisa umlomo wakho ngohleko
8.22: Izitha zakho zizakwembathiswa ngehlazo,

9.1: Wasephendula uJobe wathi:
9.2: “Ngeqiniso ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kuliqiniso.
9.3: Loba umuntu ubengafisa ukuphikisana laye
9.4: Ukuhlakanipha kwakhe kujulile, amandla akhe makhulu.
9.5: Uyazidudula izintaba zona zingazi lutho,
9.6: Uyawunyikinya umhlaba endaweni yawo,
9.7: Uyalitshela ilanga ukuba lingakhanyi;
9.8: Nguye kuphela owelula amazulu,
9.9: UnguMenzi wezinkanyezi iNgulube leZinja,
9.10: Wenza imimangaliso engafinyelelekiyo,
9.11: Uthi nxa esedlula kimi, ngingamboni;
9.12: Nxa ehluthuna, ngubani ongamalela?
9.13: UNkulunkulu kalunqandi ulaka lwakhe;
9.14: Pho mina ngingaphikisana laye njani?
9.15: Laloba ngingelamlandu, ngeke ngimphendule;
9.16: Lanxa bengingambiza asabele,
9.17: Ubengangicobodisa ngesiphepho
9.18: Ubengasoze angiphe ithuba lokukhokha umoya
9.19: Nxa kungokwamandla, alamandla amakhulu!
9.20: Loba ngingabe ngimsulwa, umlomo wami ubungangilahla;
9.21: Lanxa ngingelacala,
9.22: Kuyafanana konke; yikho ngisithi,
9.23: Nxa isifo esibi sibulala ngokuphangisa,
9.24: Nxa ilizwe liwela ezandleni zababi,
9.25: Amalanga ami alesiqubu esidlula esesithunywa;
9.26: Antweza edlule njengezikepe zelala,
9.27: Nxa ngingathi, ‘Ngizakubeka eceleni ukusola kwami,
9.34: omunye nje ongasusa uswazi lukaNkulunkulu kimi,

10.1: “Senginengwa yimpilo yami;
10.2: Ngizakuthi kuNkulunkulu: Ungangilahli,
10.3: Kuyakuthabisa na ukungizwisa ubuhlungu,
10.4: Ulamehlo enyama na?
10.5: Insuku zakho ziyafanana lezabantu yini,
10.6: osungaze uphenye iziphambeko zami
10.7: loba wena ukwazi ukuthi angilacala
10.8: Izandla zakho zangibumba zangenza.
10.9: Khumbula ukuthi wangibumba njengomdaka.
10.10: Kawungichithanga yini njengochago
10.11: wangigqokisa ngesikhumba lenyama,
10.12: Wangipha ukuphila wangitshengisa umusa,
10.13: Kodwa lokhu yikho owakufihla enhliziyweni yakho,
10.14: Nxa ngona, ngabe wawungikhangele
10.15: Aluba ngilecala, maye mina!
10.16: Nxa ngingathi ngivusa ikhanda ungicwathela njengesilwane
10.17: Uletha ofakazi abatsha abangilahlayo,
10.18: Pho kungani wangikhupha esibelethweni na?
10.19: Aluba ngavele ngingabi ngophilayo,
10.20: Insuku zami ezilutshwane kaseziphelile nje?
10.21: ngingakayi lapho okungabuywa khona,
10.22: elizweni lobusuku obujule ngempela,

11.1: UZofari umNahama wasephendula wathi:
11.2: “Uthi amazwi wonke la angayekelwa ukuphendulwa na?
11.3: Umbhedo wakho lo ungenza abantu bathule na?
11.4: Uthi kuNkulunkulu, ‘Inkolo yami kayilansolo
11.5: Oh, ngize ngifise ukuthi ngabe uNkulunkulu uyakhuluma,
11.6: akuvulele imfihlo zokuhlakanipha,
11.7: Kambe ungayifinyelela yini imfihlakalo kaNkulunkulu?
11.8: Ziqongile ngaphezu kwamazulu, ungenzani kambe?
11.9: Ukulinganiswa kwazo kude kulomhlaba
11.10: Nxa engeza lapha akuphosele entolongweni
11.11: Liqiniso ukuthi uyababona abantu abakhohlisayo;
11.12: Kodwa umuntu oyisithutha ngeke ahlakaniphe
11.13: Kodwa nxa ugxilisa inhliziyo yakho kuye
11.14: nxa ulahla isono esisesandleni sakho
11.15: lapho-ke uzabuveza ubuso bakho ungelanhloni;
11.16: Uzalukhohlwa ngempela uhlupho lwakho,
11.17: Impilo izakhanya kulemini enkulu,
11.18: Uzavikeleka, ngoba ithemba likhona;
11.19: Uzazilalela, kungekho okwethusayo,
11.20: Kodwa amehlo ababi azafiphala,

12.1: Wasephendula uJobe wathi:
12.2: “Wo, lina yini elizibona kuyini abantu,
12.3: Kodwa lami ngilayo ingqondo njengani;
12.4: Sengiyinto yokuhlekisa ebanganini bami,
12.5: Abantu abahlezi kuhle bayakweyisa ukwehlelwa ngumnyama,

12.9: Yikuphi kwalezizinto okungaziyo na
12.10: Esandleni sakhe kulempilo yazo zonke izidalwa
12.11: Indlebe kayiwahloli yini wonke amazwi

13.1: “Amehlo ami asekubonile konke lokhu,

13.10: Ngempela angaligcona

13.14: Ngizifakelani engozini na
13.15: Lanxa engangibulala kodwa ngizakwala ngimethemba;

14.1: “Umuntu ozelwe ngumfazi ulensuku ezilutshwane

14.8: Impande zaso zingaguga phansi emhlabathini
14.9: kodwa singezwa amanzi siyahluma

14.22: Bezwa kuphela ubuhlungu bemizimba yabo

15.1: Wasephendula u-Elifazi umThemani wathi:
15.2: “Kambe indoda ehlakaniphileyo ingaphendula ngeze nje
15.3: Ingadaza inkani ngamazwi angatsho lutho,
15.4: Wena uze weyise ukulunga
15.5: Isono sakho sikhuthaza umlomo wakho;
15.6: Umlomo wakho yiwo okulahlayo, hatshi owami;
15.7: Nguwe yini umuntu wokuqala ukuzalwa?
15.8: Uyake ulalele yini enkundleni kaNkulunkulu?
15.9: Kuyini okwaziyo wena thina esingakwaziyo?
15.10: Asebezimpunga lamakhehla bavumelana lathi,
15.11: Induduzo zikaNkulunkulu kazikwanelisi yini,
15.12: Kungani uvumela ukufuqwa yinhliziyo na,
15.13: uze ubhodlise ulaka lwakho kuNkulunkulu
15.14: Umuntu uyini ukuthi abe ngohlanzekileyo na,

15.16: pho umuntu ongcolileyo ke, oxhwalileyo,
15.17: Lalela kimi ngikuchazele;
15.18: lokho osekwafakazwa yizihlakaniphi,
15.19: (abayibo kuphela abaphiwa ilizwe
15.20: Ngezinsuku zakhe zonke umuntu omubi uhlutshwa yizinhlungu,
15.21: Imisindo eyesabisayo iyagcwala ezindlebeni zakhe;
15.33: Uzaba njengevini eliphundlwe izithelo zalo zingakavuthwa,
15.34: Ngoba ixuku labangamesabiyo uNkulunkulu kalizukuba lezithelo,

16.2: “Sengezwa izinto ezinengi ezifana lalezi;
16.3: Zizaphela nini inkulumo zokubhuda kwenu lokhu?
16.4: Lami bengingakhuluma njengani
16.5: Kodwa umlomo wami ngabe uyaliqinisa;

16.7: Ngeqiniso, Nkulunkulu, usungiqede amandla;

16.9: UNkulunkulu uyanginxwanela angidlikize ngolaka lwakhe,

16.11: UNkulunkulu usenginikele ebantwini ababi
16.12: Konke kwakukuhle kimi, kodwa wangibhidliza;

16.16: Ubuso bami sebubomvu ngokukhala,

21.18: Kukangaki besiba njengomule emoyeni na,

21.26: Bobabili balaliswe ndawonye eceleni komunye othulini,

22.15: Wena-ke uzakwalela endleleni endala na

22.19: Abalungileyo bayakubona lokho bathokoze;
22.20: ‘Ngempela izitha zethu zichithiwe,

23.2: “Lalamuhla ukusola kwami kulokhu kubuhlungu kabi,

23.4: Bengizayibeka kuhle indaba yami phambi kwakhe
23.5: Bengizakuzwa ukuthi yena uphendula athini,

23.11: Inyawo zami bezilokhu zilandelana lezinyathelo zakhe;

23.16: UNkulunkulu usenze inhliziyo yami yaphela amandla;

24.7: Ngoba bengelazigqoko balala beze ubusuku bonke;
24.8: Bagxonxwa lizulu lezintabeni

24.10: Ngoba bengelazigqoko bahamba nqunu;
24.17: Bonke labo ubumnyama obukhulu buyikusa kubo;
24.19: Njengalokhu ukutshisa lokoma kuhangula ungqwaqwane oncibilikayo,
24.22: Kodwa uNkulunkulu uyazihudulela kude izikhulu ngamandla akhe.
24.25: Aluba lokhu kungenjalo, ngubani ongathi ngilamanga

25.4: Pho umuntu angaba ngolungileyo njani kuNkulunkulu na?
25.6: pho umuntu-ke usilela kanganani, oyimpethu nje,

26.4: Ngubani okuncedisileyo ukukhuluma amazwi la na?
26.14: Njalo le yimisebenzi yakhe engaphandle nje ekucineni;

27.5: Kangisoze ngivume ukuthi lina lilungile ngelikutshoyo;
27.8: Ngoba ulethemba bani ongakholwayo nxa esefile,
27.14: Loba bebanengi njani abantwabakhe, isabelo sabo yinkemba;
27.15: Isifo esibi sizabangcwaba labo abatshiywa nguye besaphila,
27.19: Uthi esiyalala enothile, kodwa kasayikuphinda njalo;

28.7: Kakukho nyoni edla inyama eyaziyo leyondlela efihlekileyo,
28.9: Isandla somuntu yiso esihlasela idwala eliyinsengetshe
28.17: Kungazake kulinganiswe legolide loba amatshe akhazimulayo,
28.18: Amatshe amahle ekhorali lejaspa lawo kawabalwa lapha;

29.3: lapho isibane sakhe sisakhanyisa phezu kwekhanda lami
29.6: lapho indlela yami ifafazwe ngolaza ledwala
29.11: Loba ngubani owangizwayo wakhuluma kuhle ngami,
29.22: Nxa sekukhulume mina, kungakhulumi omunye njalo;
29.25: Yimi engangibakhethela ukuthi benzeni ngoba ngisanduna kubo;

30.2: Amandla ezandla zabo ayengangisiza ngani mina,
30.9: Kodwa manje amadodana abo asengihaya ngengoma;
30.11: Khathesi njengoba uNkulunkulu eselithukulule idandili lami
30.18: Ngamandla akhe amakhulu uNkulunkulu unjengelembu kimi;
30.20: Ngikhala kuwe, Oh Nkulunkulu, kodwa kawuphenduli;
30.24: Ngempela kakho ombeka isandla umuntu oswelayo
30.26: Kodwa ngathi ngilindele ubuhle, kweza ububi;
30.28: Ngihamba nje ngimnyama kubi, kungesikutshiswa lilanga;

31.2: Siyini isabelo somuntu asabelwe nguNkulunkulu ophezulu na,
31.7: nxa izinyathelo zami zike zaphambuka endleleni,
31.9: Nxa inhliziyo yami ike yakhangwa ngowesifazane,
31.10: lapho-ke owami umfazi kacholele enye indoda,
31.14: ngizakuthini lapho uNkulunkulu esengibuza ngakho na?
31.15: Yena lowo owangenzayo esibelethweni kabenzanga labo na?
31.19: nxa ngike ngabona umuntu esifa ngokuswela izigqoko,
31.21: nxa ngike ngaphakamisa isandla sami phezu kwentandane,
31.22: nxa kunjalo kayikhumuke ingalo yami kusukela ehlombe,
31.24: Nxa ngifake ithemba lami phezu kwegolide,
31.29: Nxa ngike ngathokoza ngomnyama owehlele isitha sami
31.30: kangivumelanga umlomo wami ukuba wenze isono
31.31: nxa abantu bendlu yami bengakaze bathi,
31.33: nxa ngisithukuzile isono sami njengokwenziwa ngabantu,
31.39: nxa ngike ngadla izithelo zalo angaze ngabhadala
31.40: nxa kunjalo kakumile ameva esikhundleni sengqoloyi,

32.14: Kodwa uJobe kakaqondisisi amazwi akhe kimi,

33.19: Loba umuntu angajeziswa ngobuhlungu esembhedeni wakhe,
33.20: aze ezwe umzimba wakhe usunengwa yikudla
33.28: Wawuhlenga umphefumulo wami ukuze ungayi egodini,

34.17: Kambe lowo ozonda ukwahlulela ngokulunga angabusa na?

34.23: UNkulunkulu kasweli ukuthi aphinde abahlolisise abantu,
34.28: Benza ukukhala kwabayanga kweza phambi kwakhe,
34.29: Kodwa nxa elokhu ezithulele, ngubani ongamsola na?
34.33: Pho uNkulunkulu akuvuze ngokwentando yakho na,

35.3: Kodwa uyambuza uthi, ‘Kungisiza ngani lokhu na,
35.6: Ungaze wenze isono, lokho kumthinta ngani na?

35.8: Ububi bakho bulimaza kuphela umuntu onjengawe,
35.10: Kodwa kakho othi, ‘Ungaphi uNkulunkulu uMenzi wami na,
35.13: Ngempela uNkulunkulu kakulaleli ukuncenga kwabo kwamanga;
35.15: njalo futhi, ukuthi ulaka lwakhe kalujezisi
35.16: Yikho uJobe evula umlomo wakhe ekhuluma ize;

36.17: Kodwa manje usindwa yikwahlulelwa okulungele ababi;
36.19: Kambe inotho yakho loba konke ukutshikatshika kwakho
36.29: Ngubani ongakuzwisisa ukuthi uwendlala njani amayezi na,

37.4: Ngemva kwalokho kuza umdumo wokubhonga kwakhe;
37.7: Ukuze kuthi bonke abantu abadalayo bakwazi ukusebenza kwakhe,
37.12: Ngokuqondisa kwakhe ayaqhela embese umhlaba wonke
37.15: Uyakwazi na ukuthi uNkulunkulu uwalawula njani amayezi
37.16: Uyakwazi na ukuthi amayezi emi njani elengile,
37.19: Ake usitshele ukuthi pho sithini kuye;
37.23: USomandla asingeke simfinyelele njalo uphakeme ulamandla;

38.1: UThixo wasekhuluma loJobe ephakathi kwesiphepho. Wathi:
38.4: Wawungaphi lapho ngibeka izisekelo zomhlaba na?
38.5: Ngubani owamisa izilinganiso zawo na? Phela angithi uyazi!
38.6: Izinsika zawo zamiswa phezu kwani na,
38.9: lapho ngisenza amayezi aba yisembatho salo na
38.11: lapho engathi, ‘Ungeza uze ufike lapha kodwa ungedluli;
38.14: Umhlaba ubumbeka isimo njengebumba ufakwe uphawu;
38.17: Amasango okufa aseke abonakaliswa kuwe na?
38.19: Yiphi indlela eya ekhaya elihlala ukukhanya na?
38.24: Ingaphi indlela eya esigodlweni sokwaba umbane,

39.4: Amazinyane azo ayaqina akhule abe lamandla egangeni;
39.11: Ungayithemba yini ngenxa yamandla ayo amakhulu na?
39.12: Ungayithemba ukuthi izalayitsha amabele akho na
39.16: Amatsiyane ayo iyawakhahlameza, kube sengathi akusi wayo;
39.18: Kodwa nxa isiselula impiko zayo ukuthi igijime,
39.25: Konela ukuthi likhale icilongo lihwabhe lithi, ‘Aha!’

40.6: UThixo wasekhuluma loJobe ephakathi kwesiphepho wathi:
40.12: khangela wonke umuntu ozigqajayo umbeke phansi,

41.3: Uzabe elokhu ekuncenga yini ukuthi umzwele?
41.5: Ungamenza abe yisifuyo sokudlalisa njengenyoni na
41.10: Kakho ongaba lesibindi sokuthi alwe laye.
41.11: Ngubani engilomlandu kuye othi kangihlawule na?
41.14: Ngubani ongaqunga isibindi avule iminyango yomlomo wakhe,
41.25: Uthi nxa ephakama kwesabe amaqhawe ngokwawo;
41.31: Udunga inziki zamanzi ayabuke njengembiza enkulu ibila,

42.7: Kwathi uThixo esetshilo lezizinto kuJobe wathi ku-Elifazi umThemani, “Ngikuzondele wena kanye labangane bakho bobabili, ngoba kalikhulumanga ngami okulungileyo njengenceku yami uJobe.
42.8: Ngakho manje thathani inkunzi eziyisikhombisa lenqama eziyisikhombisa liye encekwini yami uJobe liyekwenza umnikelo wenu wokutshiswa. Inceku yami uJobe izalikhulekela, mina ngizawamukela umkhuleko wayo ngingaze ngalijezisa okufanele ubuthutha benu. Kalikhulumanga ngami okulungileyo njengenceku yami uJobe.”
42.9: Ngakho u-Elifazi umThemani, uBhilidadi umShuhi loZofari umNahama benza lokho abakutshelwa nguThixo; njalo uThixo wawemukela umkhuleko kaJobe.
42.10: UJobe esebakhulekele abangane bakhe, uThixo wamenza waphumelela njalo wamupha okunengi okuphindwe kabili kulokho ayelakho kuqala.
42.11: Bonke abafowabo labodadewabo kanye lobani owayemazi ngaphambili weza ukuzakudla laye endlini yakhe. Bamkhalela, bamzwela ngakho konke ukuhlupheka uThixo ayemehlisele khona, kwathi ngulowo lalowo wamupha ulutho lwesiliva kanye lesongo legolide.
42.12: UThixo wayibusisa impilo yokucina kaJobe ukwedlula eyokuqala. Waba lezimvu eziyizinkulungwane ezilitshumi lane, izinkulungwane eziyisithupha zamakamela, inkulungwane yezipani zenkabi labobabhemi abayinkulungwane.
42.13: Waphinda njalo waba lamadodana ayisikhombisa lamadodakazi amathathu.
42.14: Indodakazi yokuqala wayetha ibizo elithi Jemima, eyesibili yayinguKheziya, eyesithathu yaba nguKhereni-Haphutshi.
42.15: Kakuzange kube khona elizweni lonke abesifazane ababebahle njengamadodakazi kaJobe, njalo uyise wawabela ilifa kanye labanewabo.
42.16: Ngemva kwalokhu uJobe waphila iminyaka elikhulu lamatshumi amane; wababona abantwabakhe labantwababo kwaze kwaba yisizukulwane sesine.

1.1: Ekuqaleni wayekhona uLizwi, uLizwi wayeloNkulunkulu, njalo uLizwi wayenguNkulunkulu.
1.2: WayeloNkulunkulu ekuqaleni.
1.3: Izinto zonke zenziwa ngaye; ngaphandle kwakhe kube akukho okwenziwayo.
1.4: Kwakukhona ukuphila kuye, lokho kuphila kwakuyikukhanya kwabantu.
1.5: Ukukhanya kukhanya emnyameni, kodwa umnyama awukakuzwisisi.
1.6: Kwafika umuntu ethunywe nguNkulunkulu, ibizo lakhe wayenguJohane.
1.7: Weza njengomfakazi ezoqinisa mayelana lalokho kukhanya ukuze kuthi ngaye bonke abantu bakholwe.
1.8: Yena qobo lwakhe wayengesi lokho kukhanya; weza nje njengomfakazi wokukhanya lokho.
1.9: Ukukhanya okuliqiniso okunika ukukhanya emuntwini wonke kwakusiza emhlabeni.
1.10: Wayesemhlabeni, kodwa lanxa umhlaba wenziwa ngaye, umhlaba kawumazanga.
1.11: Weza kulokho okwakungokwakhe, kodwa khona kakumemukelanga.
1.12: Ikanti kulabo bonke abamamukelayo, kulabo abakholwayo ebizweni lakhe, wabapha ilungelo lokuba ngabantwana bakaNkulunkulu,
1.13: abantwana abangazalwanga ngokwemvelo, kumbe ngokukhetha komuntu, loba ngokufuna kwendoda kodwa bezelwe nguNkulunkulu.
1.14: ULizwi waba yinyama, wahlala phakathi kwethu. Siyibonile inkazimulo yakhe; inkazimulo yeNdodana eyiyo yodwa, eyavela kuYise, igcwele umusa leqiniso.
1.15: UJohane wafakaza ngayo. Wamemeza esithi, “Lo nguye engangikhuluma ngaye ngisithi, ‘Lowo oza ngemva kwami usengedlule ngoba wayevele ephambi kwami.’ ”
1.16: Ngenxa yokujula komusa wakhe sonke sesamukele umusa emuseni esasivele siwuphiwe.
1.17: Ngoba umthetho walethwa ngoMosi; umusa leqiniso kweza ngoJesu Khristu.
1.18: Kakho osewake wambona uNkulunkulu, kodwa iNdodana eyiyo yodwa, yona enguNkulunkulu njalo eseceleni eduze kukaYise, isimenze waziwa.
1.19: Lobu yibo ubufakazi bukaJohane lapho abakhokheli bamaJuda aseJerusalema abathuma khona abaphristi labaLevi ukuyambuza ukuthi wayengubani.
1.20: Kehlulekanga ukuzichaza, kodwa wazichaza ekhululekile wathi, “Kangisuye uKhristu.”
1.21: Bambuza bathi, “Pho ungubani na? Ungu-Elija yini?”
1.22: Bacina ngokuthi, “Ungubani? Siphe impendulo esizayisa kulabo abasithumileyo. Uzibiza ngokuthi ungubani na?”
1.23: UJohane wabaphendula ngamazwi ka-Isaya umphrofethi wathi, “Ngiyilizwi lalowo omemezayo enkangala lisithi, ‘Lungiselani iNkosi indlela iqonde.’1.23 U-Isaya 40.3”
1.24: Kwasekusithi abaFarisi ababethunyiwe
1.25: bambuza bathi, “Kungani pho ubhaphathiza nxa ungasuye uKhristu, kumbe u-Elija loba umphrofethi na?”
1.26: UJohane waphendula wathi, “Mina ngibhaphathiza ngamanzi, kodwa phakathi kwenu kumi elingamaziyo.
1.27: Nguye lowo ozayo ngemva kwami, mina engingafanelanga ukuthukulula imichilo yamanyathela akhe.”
1.28: Konke lokhu kwenzeka eBhethani ngaphetsheya kweJodani lapho uJohane ayebhaphathiza khona.
1.29: Ngelanga elilandelayo uJohane wabona uJesu esiza kuye wathi, “Khangelani, nanti iWundlu likaNkulunkulu elisusa isono somhlaba!
1.30: Nguye lo engangimutsho ngize ngithi, ‘Umuntu ozayo ngemva kwami usengedlule ngoba wayevele ephambi kwami.’
1.31: Mina ngokwami bengingamazi, kodwa okwenze ngeza ngibhaphathiza ngamanzi kwakuyikwenzela ukuthi abonakaliswe ku-Israyeli.”
1.32: UJohane waseletha lobubufakazi: “Ngabona uMoya esehla evela ezulwini enjengejuba wahlala phezu kwakhe.
1.33: Lami uqobo lwami ngangingamazi, kodwa lowo owangithumayo ukubhaphathiza ngamanzi wathi, ‘Lowomuntu ozabona uMoya usehla uhlala kuye nguye kanye ozabhaphathiza ngoMoya oNgcwele.’
1.34: Sengibonile yikho sengifakaza ukuthi lo ungoKhethiweyo kaNkulunkulu.”
1.35: Ngelanga elilandelayo uJohane wayekhonapho, elabafundi bakhe ababili.
1.36: Wathi ebona uJesu esedlula lapho wathi, “Khangelani, nanti iWundlu likaNkulunkulu!”
1.37: Abafundi ababili labo bathi bekuzwa lokhu basebelandela uJesu.
1.38: UJesu wathi enyemukula wababona bemlandela, wababuza wathi, “Lifunani na?”
1.40: U-Andreya, umfowabo kaSimoni Phethro wayengomunye wababili abezwayo okwakukhulunywa nguJohane njalo abayibo abalandela uJesu.
1.41: Into yokuqala ayenzayo u-Andreya yikudinga umfowabo uSimoni wamtshela wathi, “Sesimfumene uMesiya” (okutsho uKhristu).
1.43: Ngelanga elilandelayo uJesu wafuna ukusuka aye eGalile. Wabona uFiliphu wathi kuye, “Ngilandela.”
1.45: UFiliphu wadinga uNathaneli wamtshela wathi, “Sesimfumene lowo uMosi aloba ngaye eMthethweni, njalo abaphrofethi labo abaloba ngaye, uJesu waseNazaretha, indodana kaJosefa.”
1.46: UNathaneli wabuza wathi, “ENazaretha! Kulolutho oluhle olungavela khona na?”
1.47: Kwathi uJesu ebona uNathaneli eqhamuka laphaya wathi ngaye, “Nangu umʼIsrayeli oqotho, okungekho nkohliso kuye.”
1.49: UNathaneli wasefakaza wathi, “Rabi, uyindodana kaNkulunkulu; uyiNkosi ka-Israyeli.”
1.50: UJesu wathi, “Ukholwa ngoba ngithe ngikubone ngaphansi kwesihlahla somkhiwa. Usazobona izinto ezinkulu kulalokho.”
1.51: Waphinda wengeza wathi, “Ngikutshela iqiniso, uzabona izulu livuleka, lezingilosi zikaNkulunkulu zikhwela zisehlela eNdodaneni yoMuntu.”

2.1: Ngosuku lwesithathu kwaba khona umthimba eKhana laseGalile. Unina kaJesu wayekhona,
2.2: loJesu labafundi bakhe labo babenxusiwe emthimbeni.
2.3: Kwathi iwayini seliphelile unina kaJesu wathi kuye, “Sebephelelwe liwayini.”
2.4: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Mama, mina lawe singena njani kulokho na? Isikhathi sami kasikafiki.”
2.5: Unina wasesithi ezincekwini, “Libokwenza loba kuyini azalitshela khona.”
2.6: Eduze kwalapho kwakumi imbiza zamatshe eziyisithupha, uhlobo lolo amaJuda ayelusebenzisa enkonzweni yokuzihlambulula, imbiza yinye ingagcwala amalitha alikhulu kusiya ekhulwini elilamatshumi amahlanu.
2.7: UJesu wathi ezincekwini, “Zigcwaliseni amanzi imbiza lezi”; ngakho bazigcwalisa zathi phamu.
2.8: Wasezitshela wathi, “Khanini-ke liphe umphathi wedili.”
2.9: umphathi wedili wahubula wawanambitha amanzi ayesephendulwe abaliwayini. Kakwazanga ukuthi lavela ngaphi, kodwa izinceku ezaziwakhile amanzi zazisazi. Wasebizela umyeni eceleni
2.10: wathi, “Wonke umuntu uletha iwayini elimnandi kuqala, kuthi nxa izethekeli sezinathe kakhulu abesekhupha elibi; kodwa wena ugodle elimnandi kuze kube khathesi.”
2.11: Lo waba ngumangaliso wakhe wokuqala, uJesu awenza eKhana laseGalile. Wabonakalisa kanjalo inkazimulo yakhe, abafundi bakhe basebebeka ukholo lwabo kuye.
2.12: Ngemva komthimba wasuka waya eKhaphenawume wayahlala insukwana ezimbalwa elonina, labafowabo labafundi bakhe.
2.13: Kwasekuyisikhathi sePhasika lamaJuda eleminyaka yonke, uJesu wasesiya eJerusalema.
2.14: Emagumeni ethempeli wafumana abantu bethengisa inkomo, izimvu lamajuba, labanye behlezi ematafuleni bentshintsha izimali.
2.15: Waseseluka izintambo wenza isaswebhu wabadudula bonke emagumeni ethempeli, konke izimvu lenkomo; wayichithiza imali yabantshintshi bayo, wagenqula lamatafula abo.
2.16: Wathi kulabo ababethengisa amajuba, “Akhupheni lapha! Likuthatha ngaphi ukwenza indlu kaBaba umsika wokuthengiselana na?”
2.17: Abafundi bakhe bakhumbula ukuthi kulotshiwe ukuthi: “Ukunqinekela indlu yakho kuzangidla ngaphakathi.”2.17 AmaHubo 69.9
2.18: Lapho amaJuda asemncindezela ngokuthi, “Ungasitshengisa simangaliso bani ukubonisa amandla akho okwenza zonke lezizinto?”
2.19: Wabaphendula uJesu wathi, “Dilizani ithempeli leli, kodwa mina ngizalimisa njalo ngezinsuku ezintathu.”
2.20: AmaJuda aphendula athi, “Sekuthethe iminyaka engamatshumi amane lesithupha ukwakha ithempeli leli, kodwa wena ungalivusa ngezinsuku ezintathu na?”
2.21: Kodwa ithempeli ayekhulume ngalo kwakungumzimba wakhe.
2.22: Ngemva kokuvuswa kwabafileyo abafundi bakhe bakukhumbula lokho ayekukhulumile. Ngakho bawukholwa uMbhalo kanye lamazwi uJesu awakhulumayo.
2.23: Kwathi ngesikhathi eseMkhosini wePhasika eJerusalema, abantu abanengi bayibona imimangaliso ayeyenza basebekholwa ebizweni lakhe.
2.24: Kodwa uJesu kazange azidele kubo, ngoba wayebazi bonke abantu.
2.25: Wayengabudingi ubufakazi bomuntu ngoba wayekwazi okungaphakathi komuntu munye ngamunye.

3.1: Kwakulendoda engumFarisi eyayithiwa nguNikhodimasi, ililunga lomphakathi wamaJuda abusayo.
3.2: Yaya kuJesu ebusuku yathi, “Rabi, siyazi ukuthi ungumfundisi ovela kuNkulunkulu. Ngoba kakho obengayenza imimangaliso oyenzayo wena nxa uNkulunkulu engelaye.”
3.3: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Ngempela ngiqinisile ngithi kini, akakho ozawubona umbuso kaNkulunkulu ngaphandle kokuba azalwe kutsha.”
3.4: UNikhodimasi wathi, “Kanti umuntu angazalwa kanjani yena esemdala na? Ngeqiniso, angazake angene ngokwesibili esiswini sikanina ukuze azalwe!”
3.5: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Ngempela ngiqinisile ngithi, ngaphandle kokuthi umuntu azalwe ngamanzi langoMoya, angeke awungene umbuso kaNkulunkulu.
3.6: Inyama izala inyama, kodwa uMoya uzala umoya.
3.7: Ungamangaliswa yikuthi ngithi, ‘Kumele lizalwe kutsha.’
3.8: Umoya uphephethela loba kungaphi lapho othanda khona. Ungakuzwa ukuvunguza kwawo, kodwa ungeke utsho ukuthi uvela ngaphi loba ukuthi uya ngaphi. Ngakho kunjalo emuntwini wonke ozelwe ngoMoya.”
3.9: UNikhodimasi wabuza wathi, “Lokhu kungenzeka kanjani na?”
3.10: UJesu wathi, “Ungumfundisi wako-Israyeli, pho kungani ungazwisisi izinto lezi na?
3.11: Ngiqinisile ngithi sikhuluma ngesikwaziyo njalo sifakaza ngesikubonileyo, kodwa lina bantu kalibamukeli ubufakazi bethu.
3.12: Ngikhulume kini ngezinto zalapha emhlabeni, kodwa kalikholwa; pho lizakholwa kanjani nxa ngingakhuluma ngokwasezulwini?
3.13: Kakho osewake waya ezulwini ngaphandle kwalowo owavela ezulwini, iNdodana yoMuntu.
3.14: NjengoMosi owaphakamisa inyoka enkangala, ngokunjalo iNdodana yoMuntu kumele iphakanyiswe,
3.15: ukuze kuthi lowo lalowo okholwa kuyo abe lokuphila okungapheliyo.”
3.16: UNkulunkulu walithanda ilizwe kangaka waze wanikela iNdodana yakhe eyiyo yodwa ukuze kuthi loba ngubani okholwa kuyo angabhubhi, kodwa abe lokuphila okungapheliyo.
3.17: Ngoba uNkulunkulu kathumanga iNdodana yakhe emhlabeni ukuze iwulahle umhlaba, kodwa ukuze umhlaba usindiswe ngayo.
3.18: Loba ngubani okholwa kuyo kalahlwa, kodwa ongakholwayo uvele uselahliwe ngoba kakholwanga ebizweni leNdodana eyiyo yodwa kaNkulunkulu.
3.19: Nanku ukuqunywa kwecala: Ukukhanya sekufikile emhlabeni, kodwa abantu bathanda ubumnyama kulokukhanya ngoba imisebenzi yabo yayimibi.
3.20: Wonke umuntu owenza ububi uyakuzonda ukukhanya, njalo kezi ekukhanyeni ngoba esesaba ukuthi izenzo zakhe zizabekwa obala.
3.21: Kodwa loba ngubani ophila ngeqiniso uyeza ekukhanyeni ukuze kubonakale kamhlophe ukuthi lokho akwenzileyo ukwenze ngoNkulunkulu.
3.22: Ngemva kwalokhu uJesu labafundi bakhe basuka baya emaphandleni aseJudiya lapho ahlala labo okwesikhathi esithile ebhaphathiza.
3.23: Ngalesosikhathi uJohane laye wayebhaphathiza e-Ayenoni eduze leSalimi ngoba kwakulamanzi amanengi njalo abantu babethululeka kokuphela bezobhaphathizwa.
3.24: (Lokhu kwakumandulo kokuphoselwa kukaJohane entolongweni.)
3.25: Kwavuka ukuphikisana phakathi kwabanye abafundi bakaJohane lomunye umJuda mayelana lomkhuba wokuzihlambulula.
3.26: Beza kuJohane bathi kuye, “Rabi, indoda leyana eyayilawe ngaphetsheya kweJodani; yona leyana owafakaza ngayo; iyabhaphathiza bonke abantu sebesiya kuyo.”
3.27: Waphendula uJohane wathi, “Umuntu wamukela kuphela lokho akuphiwayo kuvela ezulwini.
3.28: Lina ngokwenu lingakufakaza ukuthi ngathi, ‘Kangisuye uKhristu, kodwa ngithunyiwe ukumandulela.’
3.29: Umtshakazi ngowomyeni. Umkhaphi womyeni uyamnakekela, amlalele, abelokuthokoza nxa esizwa ilizwi lomyeni. Lokho kuthokoza ngokwami njalo okwamanje sekuphelele.
3.30: Yena ufanele abemkhulu; mina kufanele kunciphe ukuqakatheka kwami.”
3.31: Lowo ovela phezulu ungaphezulu kwakho konke; lowo ovela emhlabeni ungowomhlaba, ukhuluma njengalowo ovela emhlabeni. Lowo ovela ezulwini ungaphezu kwakho konke.
3.32: Ufakaza ngalokho akubonileyo lakuzwileyo, kodwa kakho owamukela ubufakazi bakhe.
3.33: Lowomuntu obamukelayo usegcizelele ukuthi uNkulunkulu uqinisile.
3.34: Ngoba lowo uNkulunkulu amthumileyo ukhuluma amazwi kaNkulunkulu; yena uNkulunkulu umupha umoya kungelakulinganiswa.
3.35: UYise uyayithanda iNdodana njalo useyiphe amandla phezu kwezinto zonke.
3.36: Loba ngubani obeke ithemba lakhe eNdodaneni ulokuphila okungapheliyo, kodwa loba ngubani oyilahlayo iNdodana kazukuyibona leyompilo ngoba ulaka lukaNkulunkulu lohlala luphezu kwakhe.

4.1: UJesu wezwa ukuthi abaFarisi basebekuzwile ukuthi usebhaphathize abantu wabuye waba labafundi abanengi kuloJohane,
4.2: loba nje iqiniso kuyikuthi kwakungasuye uJesu owayebhaphathiza, kodwa kubhaphathiza abafundi bakhe.
4.3: Kwathi esekuzwile lokho, wasuka eJudiya wabuyela futhi eGalile.
4.4: Manje kwakumele adabule eSamariya.
4.5: Ngakho wafika emzini waseSamariya owawuthiwa yiSikhari, eduzane lesiqinti uJakhobe ayesinike indodana yakhe uJosefa.
4.6: Umthombo kaJakhobe wawukhonapho, uJesu wathi esediniwe ngohambo, wahlala phansi malungana lomthombo. Kwakusemini enkulu.
4.7: Kwathi umfazi waseSamariya efika ukuzakukha amanzi uJesu wathi kuye, “Ake unginathise.”
4.8: (Abafundi bakhe babeye emzini ukuyathenga ukudla.)
4.9: Umfazi waseSamariya wathi kuye, “UngumJuda, mina ngingumfazi waseSamariya. Pho ungacela kanjani ukuthi unathiswe yimi?” (Phela amaJuda kawadlelani lamaSamariya.)
4.10: UJesu wamphendula wathi, “Aluba ubusazi isipho sikaNkulunkulu lokuthi ungubani lowo ocela ukuthi umnathise, ngabe umcelile wakupha amanzi okuphila.”
4.11: Umfazi wathi, “Nkosi, wena kawulakho okokukhisa amanzi, futhi umthombo uyatshona. Ungawathatha ngaphi lawomanzi okuphila na?
4.12: Wena umkhulu na kulobaba uJakhobe owasipha umthombo lo laye wanatha kuwo kanye lamadodana akhe lezimvu zakhe kanye lezifuyo zakhe?”
4.13: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Wonke umuntu onatha amanzi la uzaphinda ome futhi,
4.14: kodwa lowo onatha amanzi engimnika wona, kasoze abuye ome lanini. Ngempela amanzi engimnika wona azakuba ngumfula ogelezela ekuphileni okungapheliyo.”
4.15: Umfazi wathi kuye, “Nkosi, ngipha lawomanzi ukuze ngingaphindi ngome, ngingabi ngilokhu ngisiza lapha ngizokukha amanzi.”
4.16: Wathi kowesifazane, “Hamba uyebiza umkakho uze laye lapha.”
4.17: Waphendula wathi, “Kangilandoda.”
4.18: Iqiniso yikuthi usube lamadoda amahlanu, futhi indoda le olayo khathesi kayisiyakho. Lokho okutshiloyo kuliqiniso.”
4.19: Owesifazane wathi, “Nkosi, sengibona ukuthi ungumphrofethi.
4.20: Okhokho bethu babekhonza phezu kwentaba le, kodwa lina maJuda lithi indawo okumele sikhonzele kuyo iseJerusalema.”
4.21: UJesu wathi, “nkosazana, ngikholwa, siyeza isikhathi lapho elingezukumkhonza uBaba entabeni kumbe eJerusalema.
4.22: Lina maSamariya likhonza elingakwaziyo; thina sikhonza lokho esikwaziyo, ngoba insindiso ivela kumaJuda.
4.23: Kodwa siyeza isikhathi, yebo manje sesifikile lapho abakhonzi beqiniso bezamkhonza uBaba ngomoya langeqiniso, ngoba yibo abakhonzi abanjalo uBaba abadingayo.
4.24: UNkulunkulu ungumoya, labo abamkhonzayo kumele bamkhonze ngomoya langeqiniso.”
4.25: Owesifazane wathi, “Ngiyakwazi ukuthi uMesiya (othiwa nguKhristu) uyeza. Esefikile uzasichazela konke.”
4.27: Ngalesosikhathi abafundi bakhe baphenduka, bamangala ukufumana uJesu ekhuluma lowesifazane. Kodwa kakho owabuzayo wathi, “Ufunani na?” kumbe athi, “Kungani ukhuluma lowesifazane na?”
4.28: Owesifazane watshiya inkonxa yakhe wabuyela emzini wakibo wathi ebantwini,
4.29: “Wozani lizobona indoda engitshele konke esengake ngakwenza. Kambe angaba nguye yini uKhristu?”
4.31: Kusenzakala konke lokhu abafundi bakhe bamncenga bathi, “Rabi, ake udle ulutho.”
4.32: Kodwa wathi kubo, “Ngilokudla engikudlayo elingakwaziyo lina.”
4.33: Abafundi babuzana bathi, “Kambe ngabe ukhona omlethele ukudla na?”
4.34: UJesu wathi, “Okwami ukudla yikwenza intando yalowo ongithumileyo lokuphelelisa umsebenzi wakhe.
4.35: Kanti angithi lithi, ‘Kusele izinyanga ezine ukuthi kufike isikhathi sokuvuna’? Ngithi vulani amehlo enu likhangele amasimu! Amabele aselungele ukuvunwa.
4.36: Khathesi lokhu, umvuni uvele usehle ezuza iholo lakhe, usebuthela amabele ekuphileni kwaphakade, ukuze umhlanyeli lomvuni bajabule ndawonye.
4.37: Ngakho ilizwi elithi, ‘Omunye uyahlanyela, omunye avune’ liliqiniso.
4.38: Ngalithuma ukuyavuna lokho elingakusebenzelanga. Abanye bawenzile umsebenzi onzima, lina selivune umvuzo womsebenzi wabo.”
4.39: AmaSamariya amanengi akulowomuzi akholwa kuye ngenxa yobufakazi bowesifazane owathi, “Ungitshele konke esengake ngakwenza.”
4.40: Ngakho amaSamariya esefike kuye amcela ukuthi ahlale labo, wasehlala insuku ezimbili.
4.41: Ngenxa yamazwi akhe abanengi baba ngamakholwa.
4.42: Bathi kowesifazane, “Kasisakholwa kuphela ngenxa yalokho okutshiloyo; manje sesizizwele thina ngokwethu, ngakho sesisazi ukuthi umuntu lo ngeqiniso unguMsindisi womhlaba.”
4.43: Ngemva kwalezonsuku ezimbili, uJesu wasuka waya eGalile.
4.44: (Phela uJesu yena ngokwakhe wayetshilo ukuthi umphrofethi kalalo udumo elizweni lakibo.)
4.45: Wathi efika eGalile, amaGalile amamukela ngokumthakazelela. Ayekubonile konke lokho akwenzayo eJerusalema, eMkhosini wePhasika, ngoba lawo ayekhona khonale.
4.46: Wabuya njalo wethekelela eKhana laseGalile, lapho aphendula khona amanzi abaliwayini. Kwakukhona lapho isiphathamandla sasesikhosini esasigulelwa yindodana yaso eKhaphenawume.
4.47: Kwathi indoda leyo isizwile ukuthi uJesu wayesefikile eGalile evela eJudiya, yaya kuye yamncenga ukuthi eze azosilisa indodana yayo eyayisibangwa lezibi.
4.48: UJesu wasitshela wathi, “Ngaphandle kokuthi lina bantu libone izibonakaliso ezididayo lezimangaliso kalisoze lafa lakholwa.”
4.49: Sathi isiphathamandla sasesikhosini, “Nkosi, woza umntanami engakafi.”
4.50: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Usungahamba. Indodana yakho izaphila.”
4.51: Yathi ilokhu isesendleleni, izinceku zayo zayihlangabeza zayibikela ukuthi indodana yayo yayisiluleme.
4.52: Isibuzile ukuthi kwakuyisikhathi bani lapho indodana yayo eyasila ngaso, zathi kuyo, “Umkhuhlane uyixolele izolo ngehola lakuqala emini.”
4.53: Uyise wananzelela ukuthi leso yiso kanye isikhathi uJesu atsho kuye ukuthi, “Indodana yakho izaphila.” Ngakho yena kanye labendlu yakhe bonke bakholwa.
4.54: Lo kwakungumangaliso wesibili uJesu awenzayo esefikile eGalile evela eJudiya.

5.1: Emva kwesikhathi esithile uJesu waya eJerusalema emkhosini wamaJuda.
5.2: EJerusalema kukhona ichibi eduze lesango leZimvu, elithiwa ngesi-Aramu yiBhethisayida, elalihonqolozelwe ngensika ezinhlanu ezibiyelweyo.
5.3: Khonapho abantu abayizilima abanengi babandise ukuhlala khona, iziphofu, abaqhulayo, abome imihlubulo [belindele ukudungwa kwamanzi;
5.4: ngoba kwakusithi ngezikhathi ezithile ingilosi yeNkosi yayisehlela echibini, idungadunge amanzi besekusithi umuntu oqalayo ukungena emanzini ngemva kokudungeka kwawo asiliswe loba kuwuphi umkhuhlane owawumbambile].5.4 Livesi kayikho kwamanye amaBhayibhili esiLungu.
5.5: Omunye owayelapho wayeyisigoga okweminyaka engamatshumi amathathu lesificaminwembili.
5.6: Kwathi uJesu embona elele khonapho njalo esetsheliwe ukuthi kade abanjalo okwesikhathi eside, wambuza wathi, “Uyafuna na ukusila?”
5.7: Oyisilima waphendula wathi, “Nkosi, kangilamuntu wokungisiza angingenise echibini lapho amanzi edungwa. Ngithi lapho ngizama ukungena omunye angingenele kuqala.”
5.8: UJesu wasethi kuye, “Sukuma! Thatha icansi lakho uhambe.”
5.9: Khonokho nje indoda yasila; yathatha icansi layo yahamba.
5.10: amaJuda asesithi endodeni eyayisilisiwe, “KuliSabatha; umthetho uyakwalela ukuthi uthwale icansi lakho.”
5.11: Kodwa yaphendula yathi, “Umuntu ongisilisileyo uthe, ‘Thatha icansi lakho uhambe.’ ”
5.12: Aseyibuza athi, “Ngubani yena lowo okutshele ukuthi uthathe icansi uhambe?”
5.13: Indoda leyo eyasiliswayo yayingafanisi lakufanisa ukuthi kambe ngabe wayengubani, ngoba uJesu wayesethe nyelele wangena phakathi kwabantu.
5.14: Emva kwalokho uJesu wayifumana ethempelini indoda leyo wathi kuyo, “Khangela-ke ususilile njalo. Khawula ukwenza isono funa okubi ukwedlula okokuqala kukwehlele.”
5.15: Indoda leyo yasuka yayatshela amaJuda ukuthi kwakunguJesu owayeyisilisile.
5.16: Ngakho amaJuda amkhahlameza uJesu ngoba wayesenza izinto lezi ngeSabatha.
5.17: UJesu wathi kubo, “UBaba uhlezi esemsebenzini wakhe kuze kube namuhla, lami njalo ngiyasebenza.”
5.18: Ngalesisizatho amaJuda azama kakhulu ukumbulala; wayengephuli iSabatha kuphela kodwa wayebiza uNkulunkulu ngokuthi nguYise, ezenza yena olingana loNkulunkulu.
5.19: UJesu wabanika impendulo le: “Ngiqinisile ngithi iNdodana ingeke yenze lutho ngokwayo; ingenza kuphela lokho ebona uYise ekwenza, ngoba loba kuyini uYise akwenzayo leNdodana iyakwenza.
5.20: Ngoba uYise uyayithanda iNdodana, uyitshengisa konke akwenzayo. Yebo, lizamangala ukuthi uzayitshengisa izinto ezinkulu kulalezi.
5.21: Njengalokhu uYise evusa abafileyo abaphe ukuphila, kanjalo iNdodana inika ukuphila kulabo ethanda ukubanika khona.
5.22: Okunye njalo, uYise kahluleli muntu, kodwa usebeke konke ukwahlulela ezandleni zeNdodana,
5.23: ukuze bonke bayidumise iNdodana njengalokhu bedumisa uYise. Lowo ongayidumisiyo iNdodana kamdumisi uYise oyithumileyo.
5.24: Ngiqinisile ngithi lowo owezwayo amazwi ami amkholwe lowo ongithumileyo ulokuphila okungapheliyo njalo kazukulahlwa; usechaphile wasuka ekufeni waya ekuphileni.
5.25: Ngiqinisile ngithi, isikhathi siyeza njalo sivele sesifikile lapho abafileyo bezalizwa ilizwi leNdodana kaNkulunkulu, kuthi bonke abezwayo baphile.
5.26: Njengoba uYise elokuphila kuye yena ngokwakhe, ngakho useyinikile iNdodana ukuba ibe lokuphila kuyo yona ngokwayo.
5.27: Njalo useyiphile amandla okwahlulela ngoba iyiNdodana yoMuntu.
5.28: Kakungalimangalisi lokhu ngoba siyeza isikhathi lapho bonke abasemathuneni abo bezalizwa ilizwi layo
5.29: baphume, labo abenze okuhle bazavuka baphile, lalabo abenze ububi bazavuka balahlwe.
5.30: Mina ngokwami ngingeke ngenze lutho; ngahlulela njengokutshelwa kwami, futhi ukwahlulela kwami kuqondile, ngoba kangidingi kuzithabisa, kodwa ukuthabisa lowo ongithumileyo.”
5.31: “Nxa ngizifakazela mina ngokwami ubufakazi bami kabuqinisekanga.
5.32: Ukhona omunye ofakaza kuhle ngami njalo ngiyazi ukuthi ubufakazi bakhe ngami buqinisekile.
5.33: Selike lathumela kuJohane yena walifakazela iqiniso.
5.34: Kakutsho ukuthi ngamukela ubufakazi bomuntu; kodwa ngikuthinta lokhu ukuze lisindiswe.
5.35: UJohane wayeyisibane esabhebhayo sanika ukukhanya, lakhetha ukuthokoza ngokukhanya kwakhe okwesikhatshana.
5.36: Ngilabo ubufakazi obulesisindo esikhulu kulobukaJohane. Ngoba umsebenzi uBaba anginike wona ukuba ngiwuqedise, wona engiwenzayo uyafakaza ukuthi uBaba ungithumile.
5.37: Njalo uBaba ongithumileyo usefakazile yena ngokwakhe ngami. Kalikaze lilizwe ilizwi lakhe kumbe libone isimo sakhe
5.38: njalo ilizwi lakhe kalihlali kini ngoba kalimkholwa lowo amthumileyo.
5.39: Liphenyisisa imibhalo liyihlola ngoba licabanga ukuthi ngayo lilakho ukuphila okungapheliyo. Yiyo le imibhalo efakaza ngami,
5.40: ikanti liyala ukuza kimi lizozuza ukuphila.
5.42: kodwa ngiyalazi lina. Ngiyazi ukuthi kalilalo uthando lukaNkulunkulu ezinhliziyweni zenu.
5.43: Ngibuye ngebizo likaBaba kodwa kalingamukeli; kodwa nxa omunye efika ngebizo lakhe, lizamamukela.
5.44: Lingakholwa kanjani nxa lisamukela udumo elizipha lona kodwa lingenzi mizamo yokuzuza udumo oluvela kuNkulunkulu onguye yedwa na?
5.45: Kodwa lingacabangi ukuthi ngizalethesa icala phambi kukaBaba. Umangaleli wenu nguMosi, okukuye elibeke khona amathemba enu.
5.46: Kube lamkholwa uMosi, ngabe liyangikholwa ngoba wabhala ngami.
5.47: Kodwa njengoba lingakukholwa lokho akubhalayo, lizakukholwa kanjani lokho engikutshoyo na?”

6.1: Ngemva kwalokhu uJesu wachaphela ngaphetsheya koLwandle lwaseGalile (kutshiwo uLwandle lwaseThibheriyasi),
6.2: njalo walandelwa lixuku elikhulu labantu ngoba babona imimangaliso ayeyenzile kwababegula.
6.3: UJesu wasesiya eceleni kwentaba wahlala khona labafundi bakhe.
6.4: UMkhosi wePhasika wamaJuda wawususondele.
6.5: UJesu wathi uyakhangela wabona ixuku labantu elikhulu lisiza kuye, wathi kuFiliphu, “Singasithenga ngaphi isinkwa ukuze abantu laba badle?”
6.6: Wabuza lokhu emlinga nje kuphela ngoba wayevele esekwazi ayezakwenza.
6.7: UFiliphu wamphendula wathi, “Amadenari angamakhulu amabili ngeke athenge isinkwa esenela ukuthi umuntu munye nje azuze ucezwana!”
6.8: Omunye wabafundi bakhe, u-Andreya, umfowabo kaSimoni Phethro wakhuluma wathi,
6.9: “Nangu umfana olezinkwa zebhali ezinhlanu lenhlanzi ezimbili ezincinyane, kodwa zingafika ngaphi ebantwini abanengi kangaka na?”
6.10: UJesu wathi, “Hlalisani abantu phansi.” Kwakulotshani obunengi kuleyondawo, asehlala phansi (amadoda ubunengi bawo bungaba zinkulungwane ezinhlanu).
6.11: UJesu wasezithatha izinkwa, wakhuleka, wasezabela labo abasebehlezi phansi, wabapha njengokufuna kwabo. Wenza njalo langenhlanzi.
6.12: Kwathi bonke sebesuthi, wasesithi kubafundi bakhe, “Buthani imvuthu eziseleyo. Kakungalahlwa lutho.”
6.13: Ngakho bazibutha bagcwalisa izitsha ezilitshumi lambili ngemvuthu zezinkwa zebhali ezatshiywa yilabo ababedlile.
6.14: Abantu sebewubonile umangaliso awenzayo uJesu baqalisa ukuthi, “Ngeqiniso lo nguye uMphrofethi ozafika emhlabeni.”
6.15: UJesu esazi ukuthi babeqonde ukuzomenza inkosi ngenkani, wathi nyelele wabuyela entabeni yedwa.
6.16: Kwathi kusihlwa abafundi behlela esizibeni,
6.17: lapho abawela khona isikepe bachapha isiziba baya eKhaphenawume. Ngalesosikhathi kwasekuhlwile, uJesu elokhu engakabuyi kubo.
6.18: Kwakuvunguza umoya omkhulu amanzi asequbuka kubi.
6.19: Sebegwedle okwamakhilomitha amahlanu loba ayisithupha bambona uJesu esiza esikepeni ehamba phezu kwamanzi; bethuka kakhulu.
6.20: Kodwa wathi kubo, “Yimi; lingesabi.”
6.21: Babefuna ukumngenisa esikepeni, kwathi masinyane isikepe sahle safika ekhunjini lapho ababeqonde khona.
6.22: Ngelanga elilandelayo ixuku labantu elalisele ekhunjini elinganeno lananzelela ukuthi kwakukade kulesikepe esisodwa, lokuthi uJesu kangenanga kuso kanye labafundi bakhe, kodwa babehambe bodwa.
6.23: Kwasekufika ezinye izikepe zivela eThibheriyasi zamiswa eduze lalapho abantu ababedlele khona isinkwa ngemva kokuba iNkosi isiqale yakhuleka.
6.24: Ixuku lonela ukunanzelela ukuthi uJesu kanye labafundi bakhe babengasekho lapho, bangena ezikepeni baya eKhaphenawume ukuyadinga uJesu.
6.25: Bathi sebemfumene ngaphetsheya kwechibi bambuza bathi, “Rabi, kanti ufike nini lapha?”
6.26: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Ngiqinisile ukuthi kalingidingi ngoba libone imimangaliso, kodwa ngoba lidle izinkwa lasutha.
6.27: Lingasebenzeli ukudla okubolayo, kodwa sebenzelani ukudla okuhlala okwempilo engapheliyo elizakuphiwa yiNdodana yoMuntu. UBaba uNkulunkulu usebeke kuyo uphawu lwakhe.”
6.28: Basebembuza bathi, “Kumele senzeni ukuze senze umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu na?”
6.29: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu yilo: ukukholwa kulowo amthumileyo.”
6.30: Basebembuza bathi, “Uzasitshengisa simangaliso bani esizasibona ukuze sikukholwe na? Kuyini ozakwenza?
6.31: Okhokho badla imana enkangala; njengoba kulotshiwe ukuthi: ‘Wabapha isinkwa sivela ezulwini ukuba badle.’6.31 U-Eksodasi 16.4; UNehemiya 9.15; AmaHubo 78.24-25”
6.32: UJesu wathi kubo, “Ngiqinisile ngithi, kakusuye uMosi olinike isinkwa sivela ezulwini, kodwa nguBaba olinika isinkwa seqiniso sivela ezulwini.
6.33: Ngoba isinkwa sikaNkulunkulu singulowo owehla ezulwini anike ukuphila emhlabeni.”
6.34: Bathi, “Nkosi, kusukela manje siphe lesisinkwa sokuphila.”
6.35: UJesu wachaza wathi, “Ngiyisinkwa sokuphila. Lowo ozayo kimi kasoze afa alamba, lalowo okholwa kimi kasoze aphinde ome.
6.36: Kodwa njengoba ngilitshelile selingibonile, kodwa lokhe lingakholwa.
6.37: Konke lokho uBaba anginika khona kuzakuza kimi njalo lowo oza kimi kangisoze ngimlahle.
6.38: Ngoba ngehlile ezulwini, hatshi ukuzokwenza eyami intando kodwa ukwenza intando yalowo ongithumileyo.
6.39: Intando yakhe ongithumileyo yile, ukuthi ngingalahlekelwa langokukodwa kwalokho anginike khona, kodwa ngibavuse ngosuku lokucina.
6.40: Ngoba intando kaBaba iyikuthi bonke abakhangela eNdodaneni bakholwe kuyo bazakuba lokuphila okungapheliyo njalo ngizabavusa ngosuku lokucina.”
6.41: Esizwa lokhu amaJuda aqalisa ukukhonona ngaye ngoba wathi, “Ngiyisinkwa esehlayo sivela ezulwini.”
6.42: Athi, “Kanti kasuJesu lo indodana kaJosefa na? Oyise lonina kasibazi na? Pho angakutsho kanjani manje ukuthi, ‘Ngehla ngivela ezulwini’?”
6.44: Kakho ongeza kimi ngaphandle kokuthi uBaba ongithumileyo amsondeze, mina-ke ngizamvusa ngosuku lokucina.
6.45: Kulotshiwe kubaphrofethi ukuthi: ‘Bonke bazafundiswa nguNkulunkulu.’6.45 U-Isaya 54.13 Wonke lowo olalela uBaba afunde kuye uyeza kimi.
6.46: Kakho osewake wambona uBaba ngaphandle kwalowo ovela kuNkulunkulu; nguye kuphela ombonileyo uBaba.
6.47: Ngiqinisile ukuthi lowo okholwayo ulokuphila okungapheliyo.
6.49: Okhokho benu bayidla imana enkangala, kodwa bafa.
6.50: Kodwa nansi isinkwa esehla sivela ezulwini, umuntu angasidla angabe esafa.
6.51: Ngiyisinkwa esiphilayo esehlela phansi sivela ezulwini. Nxa umuntu angasidla lesisinkwa, uzaphila laphakade. Lesosinkwa siyinyama yami engizayinikela ukuphila komhlaba.”
6.52: Lapho-ke, amaJuda aseqalisa ukuphikisana ngamandla esithi, “Umuntu lo angasipha kanjani inyama yakhe ukuba siyidle na?”
6.53: UJesu wathi kubo, “Ngiqinisile ngithi, ngaphandle kokuba lidle inyama yeNdodana yoMuntu, linathe igazi layo, kalilakuphila phakathi kwenu.
6.54: Lowo odla inyama yami njalo anathe igazi lami ulokuphila okungapheliyo njalo ngizamvusa ngosuku lokucina.
6.55: Ngoba inyama iyikhona kudla okuqotho legazi lami liyikunatha okuqotho.
6.56: Lowo odla inyama yami njalo anathe igazi lami uhlala kimi, lami kuye.
6.57: Njengoba uBaba ophilayo wangithuma njalo ngiphila ngenxa kaBaba, kanjalo lowo odla mina uzaphila ngenxa yami.
6.58: Lesi yiso isinkwa esehla sivela ezulwini. Okhokho benu badla imana, kodwa bafa, kodwa odla lesisinkwa uzaphila lanininini.”
6.60: Bathi bekuzwa lokhu abafundi bakhe abanengi bathi, “Le yimfundiso enzima. Kambe ngubani ongayamukela na?”
6.61: UJesu wathi ngokunanzelela ukuthi abafundi bakhe babekhonona ngalokhu wathi kubo, “Lokhu kuyalikhuba yini?
6.62: Kungaba njani pho nxa lingayibona iNdodana yoMuntu isenyuka ibuyela lapho eyayikhona ngaphambilini!
6.63: UMoya unika ukuphila; inyama kayisizi lutho. Amazwi engiwakhulume kini angumoya njalo ayikuphila.
6.64: Kodwa bakhona abanye benu abangakholwayo.” Ngoba uJesu wayevele esazi kusukela ekuqaleni ukuba yibaphi phakathi kwabo ababengakholwa lokuthi ngubani owayezamnikela.
6.65: Waqhubeka wathi, “Yikho ngalitshela ngathi kakho ongeza kimi ngaphandle kokuba ephiwe amandla nguBaba.”
6.66: Kusukela kulesosikhathi abafundi bakhe abanengi bamdela ababe besamlandela.
6.67: UJesu wabuza abalitshumi lambili wathi, “Lina kalifuni kudela lihambe na?”
6.68: USimoni Phethro wamphendula wathi, “Nkosi, sizakuya kubani na? Wena ulamazwi okuphila okungapheliyo.
6.69: Thina siyakholwa njalo siyazi ukuthi ungoNgcwele kaNkulunkulu.”
6.70: UJesu wasephendula wathi, “Kangilikhethanga yini, lina elilitshumi lambili na? Ikanti omunye wenu unguSathane!”
6.71: (Wayesitsho uJudasi, indodana kaSimoni Iskariyothi, owathi loba engomunye wabalitshumi lambili wamnikela.)

7.1: Ngemva kwalokhu uJesu wahambahamba eGalile, kazathanda ukuya eJudiya ngoba amaJuda alapho ayefuna indlela yokumbulala.
7.2: Kwathi uMkhosi wamaJuda weziHonqo ususondele
7.3: abafowabo bakaJesu bathi kuye, “Sekumele usuke lapha uye eJudiya ukuze abafundi bakho babone imimangaliso oyenzayo.
7.4: Kakho umuntu othi efuna ukuba lodumo asebenzele ensitha. Njengoba usenza izinto lezi ziveze emhlabeni.”
7.5: Ngoba labafowabo babengakholwa kuye.
7.6: Ngakho uJesu wabatshela wathi, “Kasikafiki isikhathi sami salokho; kini loba yisiphi isikhathi sililungele.
7.7: Umhlaba ngeke ulizonde, kodwa mina uyangizonda ngoba ngiveza ukuthi lokho okwenzayo kubi.
7.8: Hambani lina emkhosini. Mina kangikayi emkhosini lowo ngoba kimi kasikafiki isikhathi esifaneleyo.”
7.9: Esetsho lokhu wazihlalela eGalile.
7.10: Kodwa ngemva kokuba abafowabo sebehambile emkhosini laye waya khona, hatshi obala kodwa wahamba ensitha.
7.11: Khonapho emkhosini amaJuda ayemlindele ebuza esithi, “Ingaphi indoda leyana?”
7.12: Phakathi kwamaxuku abantu kwakulokunyenyezelana ngaye. Abanye bathi, “Ungumuntu olungileyo.”
7.13: Kodwa kakho owakhuluma ngaye obala ngokwesaba amaJuda.
7.14: Kwathi isikhathi somkhosi sesiphakathi laphakathi uJesu wasesiya egumeni lethempeli waqalisa ukufundisa.
7.15: AmaJuda amangala, abuza athi, “Indoda le yaluzuza kanjani ulwazi olungaka yona ingafundanga?”
7.16: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Imfundiso yami kayisiyami. Ivela kulowo ongithumileyo.
7.17: Nxa umuntu ekhetha ukwenza intando kaNkulunkulu uzabona ingabe imfundiso yami ivela kuNkulunkulu loba ngiyazikhulumela.
7.18: Lowo ozikhulumelayo wenzela ukuzizuzela udumo, kodwa lowo osebenzela udumo lwalowo omthumileyo ngumuntu weqiniso; kakulankohliso kuye.
7.19: UMosi kalinikanga yini umthetho? Kodwa kakho lamunye kini owugcinayo umthetho. Kungani lifuna ukungibulala na?”
7.20: Ixuku labantu laphendula lathi, “Ulamadimoni wena. Ngubani ofuna ukukubulala?”
7.21: UJesu wathi kubo, “Ngenza umangaliso owodwa lamangala kakhulu lonke.
7.22: Kodwa ngoba uMosi walipha ukusoka (loba iqiniso liyikuthi kakuvelanga kuMosi kodwa kubokhokho), liyamsoka umntwana ngeSabatha.
7.23: Manje-ke, nxa umntwana engasokwa ngeSabatha kungabi yikuwephula umthetho kaMosi, pho mina lingizondelani ngokuthi ngisilise umuntu ngokupheleleyo ngeSabatha na?
7.24: Khawulani ukusola ngokubona kwamehlo kodwa yahlulelani ngokuqondileyo.”
7.25: Ngalesosikhathi abanye abantu baseJerusalema babuza bathi, “Kanti kasuye yini umuntu lo abafuna ukumbulala na?
7.26: Nangu phela ekhuluma egcekeni kodwa kabatsho lutho kuye. Kambe iziphathamandla zingabe sezibone ukuthi nguye uKhristu na?
7.27: Kodwa siyakwazi thina lapha indoda le edabuka khona; nxa uKhristu esefika, kakho ozakwazi lapho avela khona.”
7.28: Kwathi uJesu elokhu esafundisa egumeni lethempeli, wamemeza wathi, “Yebo, liyangazi njalo liyakwazi lapho engivela khona. Kangizibuyelanga lapha kodwa lowo ongithumileyo uqinisile. Kalimazi
7.29: kodwa mina ngiyamazi ngoba ngivela kuye, nguye ongithumileyo.”
7.30: Besizwa lokhu bazama ukumbamba kodwa kakho owambeka isandla ngoba isikhathi sakhe sasingakafiki.
7.31: Loba kunjalo, abanengi exukwini labantu bakholwa kuye. Bathi, “Nxa uKhristu angafika, kambe uzakwenza imimangaliso okwedlula umuntu lo?”
7.32: AbaFarisi bezwa abantu benyenyeza izinto ezinjalo ngaye. AbaFarisi labaphristi abakhulu basebethuma amanxusa ethempelini ukuba ayembopha.
7.33: UJesu wathi, “Ngilani okwesikhathi esifitshane, besengihamba ngisiya kuye ongithumileyo.
7.34: Lizangidinga kodwa lingangifumani; lalapho engikhona lingeke lifike.”
7.35: AmaJuda abuzana athi, “Umuntu lo ufuna ukuya ngaphi lapho esingeke samfumana khona na? Uzakuya ebantwini bakithi abahlakazekileyo abahlala phakathi kwamaGrikhi, afundise amaGrikhi na?
7.36: Ubesitshoni esithi, ‘Lizangidinga, kodwa lingangifumani,’ njalo wathi, ‘Lapho engikhona lingeke lifike’?”
7.37: Ngelanga lokucina elaliqakatheke kakhulu emkhosini, uJesu wasukuma wakhuluma ngelizwi elikhulu wathi, “Nxa ekhona owomileyo keze kimi azonatha.
7.38: Loba ngubani okholwa kimi njengoba uMbhalo utshilo, imifula yamanzi aphilayo izageleza ngaphakathi kwakhe.”
7.39: Ngalokhu wayesitsho uMoya, okwakuzakuthi labo abakholwa kuye bamamukele ngesikhathi esizayo. Kuze kube yilesosikhathi uMoya wawungakathelwa ebantwini, njengoba uJesu wayengakakhazimuliswa.
7.40: Sebewazwile amazwi akhe abanye bathi, “Ngeqiniso umuntu lo nguye umphrofethi.”
7.42: UMbhalo kawutsho yini ukuthi uKhristu uzavela kusendo lukaDavida, eBhethilehema, umuzi lapho uDavida ayehlala khona.”
7.43: Kanjalo abantu badabukana phakathi ngenxa kaJesu.
7.44: Abanye babefuna ukumbamba, kodwa kakho owambeka isandla.
7.45: Amanxusa ethempelini acina esebuyela kubaphristi abakhulu labaFarisi athi, “Kungani lingezanga laye?”
7.46: Amanxusa afakaza athi, “Kakho osewake wakhuluma njengaloyamuntu.”
7.47: AbaFarisi bakhwaza bathi, “Litsho ukuthi lani uselikhohlisile?
7.48: Ukhona na kubabusi loba kubaFarisi osebeke ithemba lakhe kuye?
7.49: Hatshi! Kodwa inkunkuma yabantu le engazilutho ngezomthetho, iqalekisiwe.”
7.50: UNikhodimasi owayeye kuJesu mandulo, owayengomunye wabo wabuza wathi,
7.51: “Kanti umthetho wakithi uyamlahla na umuntu engaqalanga wabuzwa ukuthi yena uthini ngokwakhe?”
7.52: Baphendula bathi, “Lawe uvela eGalile yini? Ake ukudingisise, uzabona ukuthi kakulamphrofethi ongaphuma eGalile.”7.52 Ingwalo ezaqalayo kanye labanye ofakazi kabala UJohane 7.53 – 8.11. Ingwalo ezimbalwa zigoqela indinyana lezi, kungaba yingxenye yazo kumbe ngokugcweleyo UJohane 7.36, UJohane 21.25, ULukha 21.38 kumbe ULukha 24.53.
7.53: Ngakho bonke basuka baya emizini yabo.

8.1: Kodwa uJesu waya eNtabeni yama-Oliva.
8.2: Kwathi kusisa wabonakala njalo emagumeni ethempeli, abantu bonke babuthana kuye, wahlala phansi wabafundisa.
8.3: Abafundisi bomthetho labaFarisi baletha owesifazane owayebanjwe ephinga. Bamisa phambi kwabantu
8.4: bathi kuJesu, “Mfundisi, owesifazane lo ukhandwe efeba.
8.5: EMthethweni uMosi wasilaya ukuthi abesifazane abanjalo kabakhandwe ngamatshe. Manje wena uthini?”
8.6: Umbuzo lo wawungumjibila wabo ukuze bazuze izaba lokumbeka icala.
8.7: Kwathi ngoba belokhu bephikelela ngokumbuza wabakhangela wathi kubo, “Nxa ekhona phakathi kwenu ongelasono kaqale ukumkhanda ngamatshe.”
8.8: Waphinda wakhothama waloba phansi emhlabathini.
8.9: Esetshonjalo labo abezwayo baqala ukuthi nyelele munye ngamunye bahamba, kwaqala ngabadala bakhona, kwaze kwasala uJesu yedwa lowesifazane lowo elokhu emi khonapho.
8.10: UJesu wamkhangela wambuza wathi, “Mama, kanti sebeye ngaphi? Kasekho yini okwethesa icala?”
8.11: Owesifazane wathi, “Kabasekho, nkosi.”
8.12: Kwathi uJesu esekhuluma ebantwini njalo wathi, “Ngiyikukhanya komhlaba. Loba ngubani ongilandelayo kasoze ahambe ebumnyameni lanini kodwa uzakuba lokukhanya kokuphila.”
8.13: AbaFarisi bahle bamqaga bathi, “Nanko-ke, wena uyazifakazela; ubufakazi bakho kabulaqiniso.”
8.14: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Loba ngizifakazela mina, ubufakazi bami buqinisile ngoba ngiyakwazi lapho engavela khona lalapho engiyakhona. Kodwa lina kumnyama nje kini ukuthi ngivela ngaphi lokuthi ngiya ngaphi.
8.15: Lina lahlulela ngendlela yabantu; mina kangahluleli muntu.
8.16: Kodwa ngithi nxa ngingehlulela, izinqumo zami zilungile ngoba kangingedwa. Ngimi loBaba ongithumileyo.
8.17: Emthethweni wenu kulotshiwe ukuthi ubufakazi babantu ababili buqinisile.
8.18: Yimi ngokwami engizifakazelayo; omunye umfakazi nguBaba ongithumileyo.”
8.19: Basebembuza bathi, “Ungaphi uyihlo?”
8.20: Wawakhuluma amazwi la efundisa egumeni lethempeli eduze lalapho okwakubekwa khona iminikelo. Kodwa kakho owambambayo ngoba isikhathi sakhe sasingakafiki.
8.21: Waphinda njalo uJesu wathi kubo, “Ngiyasuka lapha, futhi lizangidinga, kodwa lizafela esonweni senu. Lapho engiyakhona alingeke lize khona.”
8.22: AmaJuda asebuzana athi, “Uzazibulala yini? Yikho yini esithi, ‘Lapho engiyakhona lingeke lize khona’?”
8.23: Kodwa waqhubeka wathi, “Lina lingabalapha phansi; mina ngivela phezulu. Lingabomhlaba; mina kangisiwalo umhlaba.
8.24: Ngilitshelile ukuthi lizafela ezonweni zenu; nxa lingakholwa ukuthi nginguye engithi nginguye, ngempela lizafela ezonweni zenu.”
8.26: Kunengi engingalahlulela ngakho. Kodwa lowo ongithumileyo uthembekile njalo lokho engikuzwileyo kusuka kuye ngikutshela umhlaba.”
8.28: Ngakho uJesu wasesithi, “Lapho seliyiphakamisile iNdodana yoMuntu lizakwazi ukuthi ngingubani lokuthi kangenzi lutho ngokwami kodwa ngikhuluma kuphela lokho uBaba angifundise khona.
8.29: Lowo ongithumileyo ulami; kangitshiyanga ngingedwa ngoba ngihlezi ngisenza lokho okumthokozisayo.”
8.30: Wathi esakhuluma lokhu abanengi bakholwa kuye.
8.31: UJesu wathi kumaJuda amkholwayo, “Nxa libambelela emfundisweni yami lingabafundi bami ngempela.
8.32: Ngakho lizalazi iqiniso, njalo iqiniso lizalikhulula.”
8.33: Amphendula athi, “Siyinzalo ka-Abhrahama futhi kasizange lanini sibe yizigqili zamuntu. Ukutsho kanjani pho ukuthi sizakhululwa?”
8.34: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Ngiqinisile ngithi wonke owenza isono uyisigqili sesono.
8.35: Phela isigqili kasilandawo emiyo emulini, kodwa oyindodana ungowakhona lanininini.
8.36: Ngakho-ke, nxa iNdodana ilikhulula, lizakhululeka ngempela.
8.37: Ngiyakwazi ukuthi lingabosendo luka-Abhrahama. Kodwa selizimisele ukungibulala ngoba ilizwi lami kalilandawo kini.
8.38: Ngilitshela lokho engikubone phambi kukaBaba kodwa lina lenza lokho elikuzwileyo ngoyihlo.”
8.40: Kodwa kunje nje lizimisele ukungibulala, mina muntu oselitshele iqiniso engilizwileyo livela kuNkulunkulu. U-Abhrahama kazenzanga izinto ezinjalo.
8.42: UJesu wathi kuwo, “Kube uNkulunkulu ubenguYihlo, belizangithanda ngoba ngavela kuNkulunkulu, okwamanje sengilapha. Kangizibuyelanga kodwa uNkulunkulu wangithuma.
8.43: Kungani lingaluzwisisi ulimi engilukhulumayo na? Ngoba liyehluleka ukuzwa engikutshoyo.
8.44: Lingabakayihlo uSathane ngakho lifuna ukusenza isifiso sikayihlo. Wavele waba ngumbulali mdabuko wakhe, kemanga eqinisweni ngoba uvele engelalo iqiniso. Uthi nxa ewaqamba amanga, akhulume ulimi lomdabuko wakhe ngoba ungusomangase loyise wamanga.
8.46: Ukhona na kini ongaveza ukuthi ngilecala lesono? Nxa ngikhuluma iqiniso kungani lingangikholwa na?
8.47: Lowo ongokaNkulunkulu uyakuzwa lokho uNkulunkulu akutshoyo. Isizatho sokuthi lingezwa yikuthi kalisibo bakaNkulunkulu.”
8.48: AmaJuda aphendula athi, “Siyalahleka yini nxa sisithi ungumSamariya njalo ulamadimoni?”
8.49: UJesu wathi, “Kangiladimoni mina, kodwa ngidumisa uBaba ikanti lina liyangigcona.
8.50: Kangizidingeli udumo mina kodwa ukhona olufunayo, yena ungumahluleli.
8.51: Ngiyaqinisa ngithi, nxa umuntu egcina ilizwi lami kasoze akubone ukufa lanini.”
8.52: Esizwa lokhu amaJuda ababaza athi, “Khathesi sesisazi ukuthi uledimoni! U-Abhrahama wafa kanye labo abaphrofethi kodwa wena uthi nxa umuntu egcina ilizwi lakho kasoze akuzwe ukufa lanini.
8.53: Wena umkhulu kulobaba u-Abhrahama na? Wafa, kanye labo abaphrofethi. Wena uzenza bani na?”
8.54: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Nxa ngizidumisa mina ngokwami, luyize udumo lwami. UBaba, elithi unguNkulunkulu wenu nguye ongidumisayo.
8.55: Lanxa lina lingamazi, mina ngiyamazi. Ngabe ngithe kangimazi, bengizabe ngingumqambi wamanga njengani kodwa ngiyamazi njalo ngiyaligcina ilizwi lakhe.
8.56: Uyihlo u-Abhrahama wathakazelela umnakano wokulubona usuku lwami; walubona wathokoza.”
8.57: AmaJuda athi kuye, “Kawukafikisi iminyaka engamatshumi amahlanu obudala, kodwa uthi usumbonile u-Abhrahama!”
8.58: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Ngilitshela iqiniso ukuthi u-Abhrahama engakazalwa, mina ngasengikhona!”
8.59: Besizwa lokhu badobha amatshe befuna ukumkhanda kodwa uJesu wasithela, waphunyuka wasuka emagumeni ethempeli.

9.1: UJesu wathi elokhu ehamba wabona indoda eyayiyisiphofu kusukela ekuzalweni kwayo.
9.2: Abafundi bakhe bambuza bathi, “Rabi, ngubani owenza isono, indoda le loba abazali bayo ukuze izalwe iyisiphofu na?”
9.3: UJesu wathi, “Kakusikho ukuthi abazali bayo loba yona indoda le yenza isono kodwa lokhu kwenzakala ukuze umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu ubonakaliswe empilweni yayo.
9.4: Nxa kulokhu kusemini kumele siwenze umsebenzi wakhe ongithumileyo. Ubusuku buyeza lapho kungelamuntu ongasebenza khona.
9.5: Nxa ngisesemhlabeni, ngiyikukhanya komhlaba.”
9.6: Esekutshilo lokhu wakhafulela emhlabathini, wavuba udaka ngamathe walunameka emehlweni endoda.
9.7: Wayitshela wathi, “Hamba uyegeza esizibeni saseSilowami” (ibizo leli litsho ukuthi “Ukuthunywa”). Ngakho indoda yahamba yayageza, yabuyela ekhaya isibona.
9.8: Omakhelwane bayo lalabo abahlezi beyibona icela babuza bathi, “Kakusiyo yini indoda le eyayihlala icela?”
9.9: Abanye baqinisa ukuthi kwakuyiyo. Abanye bathi, “Hatshi, lo ufana layo nje kuphela.”
9.10: Bamjinga ngemibuzo bathi, “Pho amehlo akho avuleke kanjani?”
9.11: Waphendula wathi, “Indoda abayithi nguJesu ivube udaka yalunameka emehlweni ami. Ingitshele yathi kangiye eSilowami ngiyegeza. Ngakho ngiyile ngayageza, ngasengibona.”
9.12: Bayibuza bathi, “Ingaphi leyondoda?”
9.13: Indoda leyo eyayikade iyisiphofu yalethwa kubaFarisi.
9.14: Usuku uJesu enza ngalo udaka wavula amehlo endoda leyo lwaluyiSabatha.
9.15: AbaFarisi baphinde bayibuzisisa ukuthi kwenziwani ukuze ibone. Indoda yaphendula yathi, “Uninde udaka emehlweni ami, ngageza, manje sengibona.”
9.16: Abanye abaFarisi bathi, “Umuntu lo kaveli kuNkulunkulu ngoba kaligcini iSabatha.”
9.17: Bacina sebephendukela endodeni eyayiyisiphofu njalo bathi, “Wena uthini ngaye? Ngamehlo akho awavulileyo.”
9.18: AmaJuda kawazange akholwe ukuthi indoda le yayikade iyisiphofu lokuthi yayisiyenziwe yabona kwaze kwabizwa abazali bayo.
9.19: Bababuza bathi, “Lo yindodana yenu yini? Nguye lo elithi wazalwa eyisiphofu? Sekwenzeke kanjani ukuthi khathesi usebona?”
9.20: Abazali baphendula bathi, “Thina sazi ukuthi uyindodana yethu, njalo siyakwazi ukuthi wazalwa eyisiphofu.
9.21: Kodwa ukuthi khathesi usebona lokuthi amehlo akhe avulwe ngubani kasikwazi. Mbuzeni. Usekhulile; uzazikhulumela.”
9.22: Abazali bakhe bakutsho lokhu ngoba babesesaba amaJuda, ngoba amaJuda ayesevele aquma ukuthi loba ngubani owayezakuthi uJesu nguKhristu wayezaxotshwa esinagogweni.
9.23: Yikho abazali bakhe bathi, “Usekhulile; mbuzeni yena.”
9.24: Aphinda ayibiza okwesibili indoda eyayiyisiphofu athi, “Nika udumo kuNkulunkulu. Siyakwazi ukuthi umuntu lo uyisoni.”
9.25: Yaphendula yathi, “Ukuthi uyisoni kumbe hatshi kangikwazi. Mina kunye engikwaziyo. Bengiyisiphofu kodwa manje sengibona!”
9.26: Aseyibuza athi, “Wenzeni kuwe na? Uwavule njani amehlo akho?”
9.27: Yaphendula yathi, “Sengilitshelile kodwa kalifunanga ukuzwa. Lifunelani ukukuzwa njalo? Lani lifuna ukuba ngabafundi bakhe na?”
9.28: Khonapho asemthuka esithi, “Ungumfundi walumuntu! Thina singabafundi bakaMosi!
9.29: Siyakwazi ukuthi uNkulunkulu wakhuluma kuMosi, kodwa umfokazi lo kasimazi lokuthi uvela ngaphi.”
9.30: Indoda yaphendula yathi, “Manje lokhu kuyamangalisa! Kalimazi lapho avela khona kodwa uwavulile amehlo ami.
9.31: Siyakwazi ukuthi uNkulunkulu kazilaleli izoni. Ulalela umuntu olobunkulunkulu, owenza intando yakhe.
9.32: Kakho osewake wezwa ngokuvulwa kwamehlo omuntu owazalwa eyisiphofu.
9.33: Aluba umuntu lo ubengaveli kuNkulunkulu ubengasoze enze lutho.”
9.34: Aphendula lokhu ngokuthi, “Wazalwa ucwile nya esonweni; ngeke sifundiswe nguwe thina!” Asemxotshela phandle.
9.35: UJesu wakuzwa ukuthi ayemxotshele phandle, wathi esembonile wathi kuye, “Uyakholwa eNdodaneni yoMuntu na?”
9.36: Indoda yabuza yathi, “Ingubani na, nkosi? Ngitshela ukuze ngikholwe kuyo.”
9.37: UJesu wathi, “Khathesi usuyibonile; iqiniso yikuthi yiyo le ekhuluma lawe.”
9.39: UJesu wathi, “Ngeza lapha emhlabeni ukuzakwahlulela, ukuze iziphofu zibone kuthi labo ababonayo babonakale beyiziphofu.”
9.40: Abanye abaFarisi ababelaye bamuzwa uJesu esitsho lokhu babuza bathi, “Uthini? Lathi siyiziphofu yini?”
9.41: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Kube beliyiziphofu ngabe kalilamlandu wesono. Kodwa umlandu wenu umi ngoba lizenza abakwaziyo abakwenzayo.”

10.1: “Ngikhuluma iqiniso ukuthi umuntu ongangeni ngesango esibayeni sezimvu kodwa akhwele kwenye indawo ulisela lomphangi.
10.2: Umuntu ongena ngesango nguye umelusi wezimvu.
10.3: Umlindi wesango uyamvulela, lezimvu ziyalilalela ilizwi lakhe. Izimvu zakhe uzibiza ngamabizo azikhokhele.
10.4: Nxa esezivulele zonke ezakhe, uhamba phambi kwazo, izimvu zakhe zimlandele ngoba ziyalazi ilizwi lakhe.
10.5: Kodwa kazisoze zilandele owemzini; iqiniso yikuthi zizambalekela ngoba kazilazi ilizwi lowemzini.”
10.6: UJesu wasebenzisa umzekeliso lo kodwa kabakuzwisisanga lokho ayebatshela khona.
10.7: Ngakho uJesu waphinda wathi, “Ngilitshela iqiniso ukuthi mina ngiyilo isango lezimvu.
10.8: Bonke asebake bafika phambi kwami babengamasela labaphangi kodwa izimvu kazibalalelanga.
10.9: Mina ngiyilo isango; loba ngubani ongena ngami uzasindiswa. Uzangena, aphume, afumane idlelo.
10.10: Isela lilanda ukweba lokubulala lokubhubhisa kuphela; mina ngilande ukuze zibe lokuphila, zibe lakho ngokugcweleyo.
10.11: Ngingumelusi olungileyo. Umelusi olungileyo unikela ukuphila kwakhe izimvu zakhe.
10.12: Oqhatshiweyo kasuye umelusi ongumnini wezimvu. Yikho nxa ebona iganyana lisiza, uyazitshiya izimvu abaleke. Iganyana beseliwuhlasela umhlambi liwuhlakaze.
10.13: Umuntu lo ubaleka ngoba eyisiqhatshwa, kazikhathaleli izimvu.
10.14: Mina ngingumelusi olungileyo; ngiyazazi izimvu zami njalo lezimvu zami ziyangazi
10.15: njengoba uBaba engazi lami ngiyamazi, nginikela ukuphila kwami ezimvini zami.
10.16: Ngilazo ezinye izimvu ezingasizo zalumhlambi. Lazo kumele ngizilethe. Lazo futhi zizalilalela ilizwi lami ukuze kube lomhlambi owodwa lomelusi oyedwa.
10.17: Isizatho sokuba uBaba angithande yikuthi ngiyayinikela impilo yami, ngizaphinde ngiyithathe futhi.
10.18: Kakho ongithathela yona kodwa ngiyinikela ngokufisa kwami. Ngilalo ilungelo lokuyinikela lelungelo lokuphinde ngiyithathe. Umlayo lo ngawamukela uvela kuBaba.”
10.19: Amazwi aphinda enza amaJuda adabuka phakathi.
10.20: Amanengi kuwo athi, “Uledimoni, uyawumana njalo uyahlanya. Limlalelelani?”
10.21: Kodwa amanye athi, “La kayisiwo mazwi omuntu oledimoni. Idimoni lingawavula njani amehlo esiphofu?”
10.22: Kwafika uMkhosi Wokuzinikela eJerusalema. Kwakusebusika,
10.23: uJesu esemagumeni ethempeli ezihambela eKhulusini likaSolomoni.
10.24: AmaJuda ayembuthanele athi kuye, “Kuzaze kube nini ulokhu usitshiya silengile na? Nxa unguye uKhristu, sitshele kuhle.”
10.25: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Ngalitshela kodwa kalikholwa. Imimangaliso engiyenzayo ngebizo likaBaba iyangifakazela,
10.26: kodwa kalikholwa ngoba kalisizo zimvu zami.
10.27: Ezami izimvu ziyalilalela ilizwi lami; ngiyazazi lazo ziyangilandela.
10.28: Ngizipha ukuphila okungapheliyo, kazisoze zabhubha; kakho ongazihlwitha esandleni sikaBaba.
10.29: UBaba wami yena ongiphe zona mkhulu kulakho konke, kakho ongazihlwitha esandleni sikaBaba
10.31: Aphinda njalo amaJuda adobha amatshe ukuba amkhande,
10.32: kodwa uJesu wathi kuwo, “Ngilitshengisile imimangaliso emikhulu eminengi evela kuBaba. Yiwuphi phakathi kwayo elingikhandela wona ngamatshe?”
10.33: “Kasikukhandeli misebenzi emihle oyenzileyo kodwa sikukhandela ukuhlambaza, ngoba wena, umuntu nje, uzenza uNkulunkulu.”
10.34: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Kakulotshwanga yini eMthethweni wenu ukuthi, ‘Ngitshilo ukuthi “lingonkulunkulu?”10.34 AmaHubo 82.6’
10.35: Nxa wababiza ngokuthi ‘ngonkulunkulu,’ bona labo ilizwi elafika kubo, njalo uMbhalo kawephulwa
10.36: pho-ke kungathiwani kulowo uBaba amkhethileyo ukuba ngowakhe wamthumela emhlabeni na? Kungani pho lingibeka icala lokuhlambaza ngoba ngithe ngiyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu?
10.37: Lingangikholwa ngaphandle kokuba ngenze okwenziwa nguBaba.
10.38: Kodwa nxa ngikwenza, lanxa lingangikholwa, kholwani ubufakazi bemimangaliso ukuze lifunde njalo lizwisise ukuthi uBaba ukimi, lami ngikuBaba.”
10.39: Baphinda njalo bazama ukumbamba kodwa waphunyuka.
10.40: UJesu wabuyela ngaphetsheya kweJodani kuleyondawo lapho uJohane ayebhaphathizela khona ensukwini ezedlulayo. Wahlala khona,
10.41: abantu abanengi beza kuye. Bathi, “Lanxa uJohane engazange enze umangaliso, kodwa konke lokho uJohane akutshoyo ngomuntu lo kwakuliqiniso.”

11.1: Kwakulendoda eyayithiwa nguLazaro eyayigula. YayingeyaseBhethani, umuzi okwakuhlala khona uMariya lodadewabo uMatha.
11.2: (UMariya lo olomnewabo uLazaro owayephethwe ngumkhuhlane nguye owathela amakha ezinyaweni zeNkosi wazesula ngenwele zakhe.)
11.3: Ngakho odadewabo laba bathumela ilizwi kuJesu bathi, “Nkosi, lowo omthandayo uyagula.”
11.4: UJesu esekuzwile lokhu wathi, “Ukugula lokhu kakuzukucina ngokufa. Kodwa kungokodumo lukaNkulunkulu ukuze iNdodana kaNkulunkulu idunyiswe ngakho.”
11.5: UJesu wayemthanda uMatha lodadewabo kanye loLazaro.
11.6: Kodwa loba esezwile ukuthi uLazaro wayegula wazihlalela khona lapho ayekhona okwezinye insuku ezimbili.
11.7: Wasesithi kubafundi bakhe, “Kasibuyeleni eJudiya.”
11.8: Bathi, “Oh, Rabi, muvana nje amaJuda ake azama ukukukhanda ngamatshe kodwa wena usubuyela khona futhi?”
11.9: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Kakusikho yini ukuthi kulamahola alitshumi lambili okukhanyisa kwelanga na? Umuntu ohamba emini kayikukhubeka ngoba ebona ngokukhanya kwalapha emhlabeni.
11.10: Ukhubeka nxa ehamba ebusuku ngoba kalakho ukukhanya.”
11.11: Esekutshilo lokhu wasebatshela wathi, “Umngane wethu uLazaro uselele kodwa ngiya khonale ukuyamvusa.”
11.12: Abafundi bakhe baphendula bathi, “Nkosi, nxa kuvuma ukuthi alale, uzabangcono.”
11.13: UJesu wayekhuluma ngokufa kwakhe kodwa abafundi bakhe babesithi kumbe utsho ukulala okujayelekileyo.
11.14: Wasebatshela ephumela egcekeni wathi, “ULazaro usefile,
11.15: kodwa ukuze lina likholwe, ngiyathaba ukuthi bengingekho lapho. Kodwa kasiyeni khona.”
11.16: UThomasi (othiwa nguDidimasi) wathi kwabanye abafundi, “Lathi kasihambeni ukuze siyekufa laye.”
11.17: Ekufikeni kwakhe uJesu uLazaro wayesehlale ethuneni okwensuku ezine.
11.18: EBhethani kwakungaphansi kwamakhilomitha amathathu usuka eJerusalema,
11.19: yikho amaJuda amanengi ayebuyile ukuzakhalela uMatha loMariya ngokulahlekelwa kwabo ngumnewabo.
11.20: Kwathi uMatha esizwa ukuthi uJesu wayesiza, waphuma wamhlangabeza kodwa uMariya wasala ngekhaya.
11.21: UMatha wathi kuJesu, “Nkosi, aluba ubukhonapha ngabe umnewethu kafanga.
11.22: Kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi lamanje uNkulunkulu uzakunika loba yini oyicelayo.”
11.23: UJesu wathi kuye, “Umfowenu uzavuka njalo.”
11.24: UMatha waphendula wathi, “Ngiyazi ukuthi uzavuka futhi ekuvukeni kwabafileyo ngosuku lokucina.”
11.25: UJesu wathi kuye, “Mina ngiyikuvuka kwabafileyo lokuphila. Lowo okholwa kimi uzaphila loba engafa;
11.26: njalo lowo ophilayo ekholwa kimi kasoze afa lanini. Uyakukholwa lokhu na?”
11.27: Waphendula wathi, “Yebo Nkosi, ngiyakholwa ukuthi unguye uKhristu, iNdodana kaNkulunkulu, ozabuya emhlabeni.”
11.28: Esekutshilo lokho wabuyela ngekhaya wabizela udadewabo uMariya eceleni wathi, “UMfundisi usekhona, uyakucela.”
11.29: UMariya wathi ekuzwa lokhu wasuka masinyane waya kuJesu.
11.30: UJesu wayelokhu engakangeni phakathi komuzi elokhu elapho ayehlangane khona loMatha.
11.31: Kwathi amaJuda ayeloMariya endlini emduduza esebonile ukuthi wasukuma masinyane njani ephuma, amlandela ecabanga ukuthi mhlawumbe wayesiya ethuneni ukuyakhalela khona.
11.32: UMariya wonela ukufika lapho uJesu ayekhona, wambona, wazilahla phansi ezinyaweni zakhe wathi, “Nkosi, kube ubukhona lapha, umnewethu ngabe kafanga.”
11.33: UJesu embona ekhala kanye lamaJuda ayemlandele wadabuka kakhulu emoyeni, wakhathazeka.
11.37: Kodwa amanye awo athi, “Kanti yena lo owavula amehlo endoda eyayiyisiphofu wehlulekile ukwenza ukuthi umuntu lo angafi na?”
11.38: UJesu waphinda njalo wadabuka, wasondela ethuneni. Ithuna lalilubhalu, kulelitshe elalivale intuba.
11.40: UJesu wasesithi, “Kangikutshelanga ukuthi nxa ukholwa uzabona inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu na?”
11.41: Ngakho balisusa ilitshe. UJesu wasekhangela phezulu wathi, “Baba ngiyakubonga ukuthi ungizwile.
11.42: Mina bengisazi ukuthi uhlala ungizwa, kodwa ngikutshela lokhu ngisenzela abantu abemi lapha ukuze bakholwe ukuthi ungithumile.”
11.43: Esekutshilo lokhu uJesu wamemeza ngelizwi elikhulu wathi, “Lazaro, phuma!”
11.44: Umuyi waphuma, izandla lenyawo zakhe zithandelwe ngamaqhele elineni, kulelinye ilembu elalembese ubuso bakhe.
11.45: Ngakho amaJuda amanengi ayeze ukuzakhalela uMariya esekubonile uJesu akwenzayo, amkholwa.
11.46: Kodwa amanye aya kubaFarisi bayabatshela lokho okwakwenziwe nguJesu.
11.47: Abaphristi abakhulu labaFarisi basebebiza umhlangano weSanihedrini.
11.48: Singamyekela aqhubeke ngalindlela, wonke umuntu uzakholwa kuye njalo amaRoma azakuza athathe indawo yethu lesizwe sethu.”
11.49: Kwasekusithi omunye wabo owayethiwa nguKhayifasi, owayengumphristi omkhulu ngalowomnyaka, wakhuluma wathi, “Kalazi lutho!
11.50: Kalikuboni lina ukuthi kungcono ukuba umuntu oyedwa afele abantu kulokuthi kubhubhe isizwe sonke.”
11.51: Lokhu kazikhulumelanga yena ngokwakhe, kodwa njengomphristi omkhulu kwabanye ngalowomnyaka waphrofitha ukuthi uJesu wayezafela isizwe samaJuda,
11.52: kungasisizwe leso sodwa, kodwa labantwana bakaNkulunkulu abahlakazekileyo ukuze balethwe ndawonye, benziwe babemunye.
11.54: Ngakho uJesu wayengasahambahambi obala phakathi kwamaJuda. Wasuka lapho waya emangweni owawuseduze kwenkangala, emzini owawuthiwa yi-Efrayimu, lapho ahlala khona labafundi bakhe.
11.55: Kwathi sekuzakuba yisikhathi sePhasika lamaJuda, abanengi baqubuka elizweni baya eJerusalema ukuyahlanjululwa ngokomkhuba kungakabi yiPhasika.
11.56: Babelokhu bethalaza befuna uJesu, kwathi bemi egumeni lethempeli babuzana bathi, “Licabangani? Ukuthi angaphutha yini emkhosini?”
11.57: Kodwa abaphristi abakhulu labaFarisi basebelayele ukuthi nxa ekhona owayekwazi ukuthi uJesu wayengaphi, ahle abike ukuze bambophe.

12.1: Kwasekusele insuku eziyisithupha ukuthi kufike iPhasika, uJesu waya eBhethani, lapho okwakuhlala khona uLazaro owayevuswe kwabafileyo nguJesu.
12.2: Kwaphekwa ukudla kwakusihlwa kuhlonitshwa yena uJesu. UMatha nguye owayedidizela, uLazaro ehlezi labanye etafuleni loJesu.
12.3: UMariya wasethatha amafutha enadi acengekileyo njalo adulayo kakhulu, ayengaba yingxenye yelitha, wawathela ezinyaweni zikaJesu wasezesula ngenwele zakhe. Indlu yagcwala ngephunga elimnandi lamakha lawo.
12.4: Kodwa omunye wabafundi bakhe, uJudasi Iskariyothi owayezamnikela wasola wathi,
12.5: “Kungani amakha la engathengiswanga imali yaphiwa abampofu? Intengo yawo ibinganela umholo womnyaka wonke.”
12.6: Kakutshongo lokhu ngoba ebanakekela abampofu, kodwa ngoba elisela; njengomgcinisikhwama wayandise ukuzisiza ngalokho okwakufakwa phakathi kwaso.
12.7: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Myekele. Kwakuqondwe ukuthi amakha la awabekele usuku lokungcwatshwa kwami.
12.8: Lizahlala lilabo abampofu phakathi kwenu kodwa mina kaliyikuhlala lilami.”
12.9: Ngalesosikhathi ixuku elikhulu lamaJuda lezwa ukuthi uJesu wayelapho, leza lingalandanga yena kuphela kodwa lokuthi libone uLazaro ayemvuse kwabafileyo.
12.10: Ngakho abaphristi abakhulu benza amacebo okuba bambulale laye uLazaro,
12.11: ngoba ngenxa yakhe amaJuda amanengi ayesiya kuJesu ebeka ukholo lwawo kuye.
12.12: Ngosuku olulandelayo ixuku elikhulu elalize emkhosini lezwa ukuthi uJesu wayesendleleni esiza eJerusalema.
12.13: Lathatha amagatsha elala laphuma ukuyamhlangabeza, limemeza lisithi,
12.14: UJesu wathola inkonyane kababhemi wayigada njengoba kulotshiwe ukuthi:
12.15: “Ungesabi, Oh Ndodakazi yeZiyoni;
12.16: Kuqala abafundi bakhe kabakuzwisisanga konke lokhu. Kwaze kwaba ngemva kokuba uJesu esekhazimulisiwe lapho abananzelela khona ukuba izinto lezi zazilotshwe ngaye lokuthi babezenzile kuye lezozinto.
12.17: Ngalesosikhathi ixuku elalilaye mhla ebiza uLazaro ethuneni wabuye wamvusa ekufeni laqhubeka lilifakaza ilizwi.
12.18: Abantu abanengi bahamba ukuyamhlangabeza ngoba basebezwile ukuthi wayewenzile umangaliso lo.
12.19: AbaFarisi bakhulumisana besithi, “Liyabona, into le izasitshiya esikhaleni. Khangelani ukuthi umhlaba wonke usuthe zalezale kuye!”
12.20: Kwakukhona amaGrikhi phakathi kwalabo abayakhonza emkhosini.
12.21: Beza kuFiliphu owayevela eBhethisayida eGalile lesicelo esithi, “Nkosi, sifuna ukubona uJesu.”
12.22: UFiliphu wayatshela u-Andreya; u-Andreya loFiliphu basebemtshela uJesu.
12.23: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Sesifikile isikhathi sokuba iNdodana yoMuntu ikhazimuliswe.
12.24: Ngilitshela iqiniso ukuthi ngaphandle kokuthi uhlamvu lwengqoloyi luwele emhlabathini lufe, lusala lulokhu luluhlamvu olulodwa. Kodwa lungaze lufe luthela inhlamvu ezinengi.
12.25: Umuntu othanda impilo yakhe izamlahlekela ikanti umuntu ozonda impilo yakhe kulo umhlaba uzayilondolozela ingunaphakade.
12.26: Lowo ongikhonzayo kumele angilandele, lalapho engikhona lesikhonzi sami sikhona. UBaba uzamdumisa lowo ongikhonzayo.
12.27: Khathesi inhliziyo yami ikhathazekile. Kambe ngingatsho na ngithi, ‘Baba, ngihlenga singafiki lesosikhathi’? Hatshi, kwakungenxa yalesisizatho ukuze ngingene kulesisikhathi.
12.29: Ixuku labantu elalilapho elalizwayo ilizwi lathi kube lomdumo wezulu; abanye bathi ingilosi yayikhulume laye.
12.30: UJesu wathi, “Ilizwi leli belingelokusiza lina, hayi mina.
12.31: Manje sekuyisikhathi sokwahlulela kulo umhlaba; manje inkosi yalo umhlaba isizaxotshwa.
12.32: Kodwa mina nxa sengiphakanyisiwe ngisuswa emhlabeni, ngizabadonsela kimi bonke abantu.”
12.33: Wakutsho lokhu eveza ukuthi wayezakufa ukufa okunjani.
12.34: Ixuku labhoboka lathi, “Sezwa eMthethweni ukuthi uKhristu uzahlala kokuphela, pho ukutsho kanjani ukuthi, ‘INdodana yoMuntu imele iphakanyiswe na’? Ingubani yona ‘iNdodana yoMuntu’ le?”
12.35: UJesu wabatshela wathi, “Lizakuba lakho ukukhanya okwesikhatshana esithile. Hambani liseselakho ukukhanya, ubumnyama bungakaligubuzeli. Umuntu ophumputha emnyameni kakwazi lapho aya khona.
12.36: Bekani ithemba lenu ekukhanyeni liseselakho ukuze libe ngamadodana okukhanya.” Wathi eseqedile ukukhuluma uJesu wasuka kubo wayazifihla.
12.37: Lanxa uJesu wayeseyenze yonke imimangaliso le emehlweni abo babelokhu bengakholwa kuye.
12.38: Lokhu kwakugcwalisa ilizwi lika-Isaya umphrofethi elithi:
12.39: Ngalesisizatho babengeke bakholwa ngoba u-Isaya uyatsho komunye umbhalo ukuthi:
12.41: U-Isaya wakutsho lokhu ngoba wayibona inkazimulo kaJesu njalo wayekhuluma ngaye.
12.42: Kodwa loba kunjalo, abanengi labanye abakhokheli bakholwa kuye. Kodwa ngenxa yabaFarisi kabalufakazanga ukholo lwabo besesaba ukuthi bazaxotshwa esinagogweni;
12.43: ngoba babethanda ukubukwa ngabantu okwedlula ukubukwa okuvela kuNkulunkulu.
12.44: UJesu wasememeza wathi, “Nxa umuntu ekholwa kimi, kakholwa kimi kuphela kodwa kuye lowo ongithumileyo.
12.45: Nxa ekhangela mina ubona yena lowo ongithumileyo.
12.46: Ngibuye emhlabeni ngiyikukhanya ukuze angabikhona okholwa kimi ozahlala ebumnyameni.
12.47: Nxa umuntu ewezwa amazwi ami kodwa angawagcini, angimahluleli mina. Phela kangilandanga ukuzowahlulela umhlaba kodwa ukuzowusindisa.
12.48: Ukhona umahluleli walowo ongalayo, ongawemukeliyo amazwi ami; lawomazwi engawakhulumayo uqobo azamlahla ngosuku lokucina.
12.49: Ngoba kangizikhulumelanga ngokwentando yami kodwa uBaba owangithumayo wangilaya ukuthi ngithini lokuthi ngikutsho kanjani.
12.50: Ngiyazi ukuthi umlayo wakhe uholela ekuphileni kwaphakade. Ngakho loba kuyini engikutshoyo yikho lokho uBaba angitshele khona ukuthi ngikutsho.”

13.1: Kwakuyisikhathi lapho uMkhosi wePhasika ususondele. UJesu wayekwazi ukuthi isikhathi sokuthi asuke kulumhlaba aye kuYise sasesisondele. Wayehlezi ebathanda abakhe abasemhlabeni, lesi kwasekuyisikhathi sokubatshengisa ukujula kothando lwakhe.
13.2: Kwathi kudliwa ukudla kwakusihlwa, uSathane wayevele esemtshutshisile uJudasi Iskariyothi, indodana kaSimoni, ukuthi anikele uJesu.
13.3: UJesu wayekwazi ukuthi uYise wayenikele zonke izinto emandleni akhe, lokuthi yena wayevela kuNkulunkulu njalo wayebuyela kuNkulunkulu,
13.4: ngakho wasukuma ekudleni, wakhulula isembatho saphezulu, wabophela ithawulo ekhalweni lwakhe.
13.5: Ngemva kwalokho, wathela amanzi enditshini waseqalisa ukugezisa inyawo zabafundi bakhe, wazesula ngethawulo leyo ayezibophe ngayo.
13.6: Wafika kuSimoni Phethro owathi kuye, “Nkosi, kambe wena nguwe ongagezisa inyawo zami na?”
13.7: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Kawukuzwisisi lokhu engikwenzayo khathesi kodwa uzakuzwisisa ngesikhathi esizayo.”
13.8: UPhethro wathi, “Hatshi, kawusoze lanini ugezise inyawo zami.”
13.9: UPhethro waphendula wathi, “Nkosi, nxa kunjalo, kakungabi zinyawo zami zodwa kodwa lezandla zami kanye lekhanda lami!”
13.10: UJesu waphendula wathi, “Lowo ogeze umzimba udinga ukugeza inyawo zakhe kuphela, ngoba umzimba wakhe wonke uhlanzekile. Njalo lina lihlanzekile loba nje kungayisini lonke elihlanzekileyo.”
13.11: Ngoba wayemazi lowo owayezamnikela, yikho wathi kakusibo bonke ababehlanzekile.
13.12: Eseqedile ukubagezisa inyawo, wagqoka isembatho saphezulu wasebuyela endaweni yakhe. Wababuza wathi, “Liyakuzwisisa na esengilenzele khona?
13.13: Lingibiza lithi ‘Mfundisi’ lokuthi ‘Nkosi,’ lisitsho liqondile, ngoba ngiyikho lokho.
13.14: Manje-ke njengoba mina, iNkosi yenu loMfundisi, sengigezise inyawo zenu, lani kumele ligezisane inyawo.
13.15: Sengilenzele isibonelo ukuthi lenze njengoba ngilenzele mina.
13.16: Ngempela ngiqinisile ngithi kini kakulanceku enkulu kulenkosi yayo, njalo isithunywa kasisikhulu kulalowo osithumileyo.
13.17: Lingaze lizazi lezizinto lizabusiswa nxa lizenza.”
13.18: AmaHubo 41.9
13.19: Ngilazisa khathesi kungakenzakali, ukwenzela ukuthi lapho sekusenzakala, likholwe ukuthi ngiNguye.
